Title: Skilled Seducer of the Month, February 2025: Atlas IV | Girls Chase
content:

But definitely, we really connected and it was quite a surreal experience meeting him in the flesh, just meeting someone who has got such incredible—someone who’s been working on their fundamentals for so long and in the game for so long. And, you know, his mind is like a library of knowledge. I learned a lot just from being in his presence.

CHASE AMANTE:

That’s cool. So now, how did you get your start with seduction?

ATLAS IV:

Well, I kind of envy some of the guys on the forum like James D. and Teevster who got started really early because it’s such a blessing if you get started really early with seduction. But I started when I was about 25. So, before that, I’d always kind of ended up in monogamous relationships where I wasn’t really happy. I didn’t really choose the partners. It was more that they were the best ones that I could get with the ways that I knew, like from meeting girls, because I didn’t know anything about talking to girls, cold approach, night game, none of that.

I would like DM random girls on Instagram, or WeChat, or whatever and hope for the best, basically. That was my strategy. Spray and pray. And I got lucky with a couple of them. They were quite nice, but they were never exactly—I was never satisfied. There were never relationships where I was fully happy. And I knew that they weren’t going to be forever. So, part of my reason for learning different languages was—I mean, I never wanted to admit this to myself, but like part of it was this idea that I thought I would get hotter girls and better dating opportunities by going to other countries, which is true to an extent, but I kind of soon realized that there was something missing, that just speaking a language and just going to another country in itself is not going to get you tons of hot girls. There’s no such thing as pussy paradise, despite what a lot of guys think.

Even in the so-called easiest places in the world, you still need game if you want to get consistent results. So anyway, I was, yeah, kind of frustrated going through these relationships. And eventually, I learned Spanish because I had fantasies about Latin America, beautiful, bronzed, Latina babes. I thought if I just speak a bit of Spanish and I go to Mexico and Colombia, they’ll just be all over me and my life will be completely different. This was my fantasy for quite a while. So I learned Spanish, and I went to Mexico, and I had a great time there. But I was traveling there for a few months. I was getting girls, but I wasn’t getting that many great girls. It was still kind of just scraps.

And I reached a point where I was in, I think, Guadalajara. And it was kind of a moment of desperation where I started to look up on the Internet, like, how do you meet girls? Why can’t I get this? Why am I still not getting the kinds of girls that I want in my life? And I went on to Reddit. That was my first stop, I think, the Seduction subreddit, which is kind of a cesspool in itself, but it had some information. And then on one thread, some guy made a comment. And it was like it wasn’t upvoted at all. It was at the very bottom of the page. And it just said, “You should check out this website. It’s called Girls Chase. You might find it interesting.” And I clicked that link. And it was like going—it was like taking the pill. I wouldn’t call it the red pill, the Girls Chase pill, coming out of the Matrix. And my life changed forever from that point.

CHASE AMANTE:

That’s neat. You know, something that I noticed about that experience, before we got on the call, we’re talking about guys passing a point where suddenly they become open to learning about seduction, whereas before they were not. What I noticed about you is you already had this mentality of like, okay, I’ve got to do something to get girls. And in your case, it was like, okay, I’ve got to learn these languages. If I learn these languages, then I’m going to get the girls I want. And you learn the languages, and then you still weren’t getting the results you wanted. So then you’re like, okay, I’ve got to do something else to get the girls I want. And you start looking around, you find seduction, and you find Girls Chase. But it’s interesting that that arc, like I’m going to try this, that didn’t work, I’m going to try something else, this kind of experimenter’s mindset.

ATLAS IV:

I mean, it was sort of a fantasy that I had this idea that learning a foreign language and being the high value guy in a foreign country would automatically get me lots of girls. It definitely helps, but it’s nothing compared to what you will learn in seduction. That’s really the skill that will change everything.

CHASE AMANTE:

I think this idea of being the high value guy is very appealing to most men. And if you look at most of the stuff that most guys do, what’s behind a lot of it’s like, okay, once I do this, I’m gonna be really high value. And then women are just gonna be throwing themselves at me. The panties are gonna be hitting the floor, and I’m gonna be lined up. I’m gonna become this great musician. I have all these groupies. Every girl’s gonna know who I am. Once I get all these muscles, or once I get all the money, or whatever it is, whatever the guy’s pursuing, there’s that sex drive fantasy behind it, which that stuff can all help, but—

ATLAS IV:

It helps with getting them like interested initially, like curious about you, I think, but it doesn’t necessarily translate to attraction.

CHASE AMANTE:

Yeah. And kind of one of the weird things about seduction is you don’t have to be the high value guy. And I think that’s something that guys also have trouble with because you’re like I don’t want to be that guy. That guy’s not high value. He’s just walking up and like he just bones these girls. He’s tricking them into bed or whatever it is. How do they not realize that he’s not as high value as a guy like me is? So there’s this whole— Yeah, it’s kind of a weird mental thing going on there. That needs a shift in the mindset.

ATLAS IV:

Maybe it’s the sigma-alpha thing.

CHASE AMANTE:

Yeah.

ATLAS IV:

You don’t have to be the alpha to get the girls. The sigma can do just as well.

 

Atlas Starts Seducing

CHASE AMANTE:

Yep. But there’s this appeal of, if I can be the alpha male, then I’ll be the guy, the center of attention, the leader, everybody listens to me, the women obey. You called yourself a sucker and you said that you didn’t completely want to be in that relationship, which sounds like what you’re just saying about the girls that met off of Instagram, or WeChat, or what have you. It’s kind of just ended up in relationships with, I guess, whoever you’re able to get in contact with. So what happened there with that relationship?

ATLAS IV:

That one, yeah, there was a lot of drama. We were together for like two years. It came at a time where like— I mean, I went through what happens, like— So I came across Girls Chase like five, six years ago. 2019 was the first time. And I’ve noticed a pattern in my life where I’ll go through a period of like six or seven months of gaming, and improving, and reading a lot, and focusing on getting girls. And then I meet a great girl, and I end up stuck in a relationship with her for a year or so. Then we break up. I go back to the game. Another five, six months’ stretch. Then get into another relationship. Yada, yada. So this was kind of like the latest round of that cycle.

And I would say that she was the best girlfriend I’ve had since that time. But it was sort of we got together around the middle of COVID and we just kind of ended up— A lot of bad things happened to me at that time. And I was kind of just clinging to security. And so, I thought I wasn’t really in a mood to game at that time. So I thought I’ll just stick with her and see where it goes. But I knew deep down it was never going to satisfy me. And now, I’m back in that mindset where I’m like I’m definitely not going to go back into another relationship. I don’t see any foreseeable point where I actually will, unless it’s something where I can dictate the terms for myself. Cannot be monogamous for sure because I’m not going to keep going back into that cycle. I have to actually level up my skills.

CHASE AMANTE:

It’s a common thing in the seduction community. Guys will go through this [cycle] where they get in, they start getting some skills, and then they meet a girl and they’re like, okay, get into the relationship. And then that ends up being less than ideal. And then they go out again. But then a lot of times they’ve accumulated all this rust. And not every guy comes back from that, but it’s neat to see that you have. Some guys will come back, some guys bounce back, some guys have a really hard time. It’s almost a weird thing. I’ve seen a lot of guys where they’re pretty good seducers, they get a girlfriend, and then a year or two later they come out and then they just can’t get it going on.

Like one guy I knew, he was banging girls that he met in clubs. He’d pull them out and bang them in the park, on the bench, in the mud. He’d take them to bathrooms. And then he got a girlfriend. He was with her for like a year and a half. And he came out and he just kept messing up with every single girl for a year. Couldn’t get laid for a year. He’d have girls making out with him, but he’d be over-gaming them in clubs. And he was like I don’t know what’s going on. And we finally figured out that before the girlfriend, he kind of just saw women as like almost like objects.

Then he got this girlfriend that he had this great connection with and he developed all this empathy. And he’s like, aww, I really feel for her. And then every time he would approach a woman after they broke up, he’d go deep into his empathy and he couldn’t even look at her as like a sex object. So he’d be tripping over his feet. But guys go through these. These changes sometimes mess them up. Didn’t seem to happen with you.

ATLAS IV:

Yeah. I mean, I got quite lucky with that first lay just because I happened to run into a girl who was super DTF. I think the pickup gods decided to throw me a bone. But I noticed in those first few months, it was really tough because I was still in this relationship mindset. I think when you’re in a long-term relationship, especially one that’s monogamous, it kind of wears you down and turns you into—it like domesticates you, so that when you go out into the field again, it’s like you’re a dog who’s been fed all this time. And now, you have to go back and rely on your hunting skills again. You’ve kind of forgotten how to do it all. And it doesn’t just come back. It takes a lot of grind.

CHASE AMANTE:

Yeah. They find the guys in long-term relationships, their testosterone levels drop noticeably. And the only ones that doesn’t happen to are the guys that either are actively trying to cheat, hook up with other chicks or that at least have it in their mind like, okay, I’m looking for girls, I’m looking for girls. And those guys, their testosterone levels will stay up. So probably what’s happening is you get monogamous, testosterone levels go down. Now, suddenly you’re not monogamous, but your testosterone level is still lower. And then you’ve got to get it back up again. But there’s this period of changing your outlook again, being a bachelor and getting those levels back up to where they should be so that you’re a hot, red-blooded male again.

ATLAS IV:

Yeah. Yeah.

So you said sex talking to her about threesomes, that worked like voodoo and put her in a completely different state. Did you want to talk about some of that? Maybe your early experience using that?

So I think it’s probably no coincidence that Alek has also done a lot of game in France. I think French girls would probably respond a lot to these sorts of sexually liberating gambits. It was kind of a corner of seduction that I’d neglected.

He’s a guy every time he writes, you can tell he’s got this— We’re talking earlier about Ricardus having an encyclopedic knowledge of game and Chad Tyrone gives you that kind of same feeling. Like he’s just got this… He’s got it all mapped out in his head. I’m not surprised he’s got gambit after gambit and then lays the girl. Just run right through them!

Yeah. Amazing. But yeah, I think gambits are a really powerful tool when used right, but yeah, they’re an advanced thing.

I think they got a bad name because they had all the guys that were beginners and not socially calibrated going out and using them in weird ways. And girls were like, ah, what’s this guy doing? You gotta be smooth about that.

Yeah, yeah, yeah, for sure.

And we did a bit of day game at some malls, and I got to see the great Ricardus in action.

CHASE AMANTE:

That’s neat. He’s still around, still kicking.

I don’t know. It’s like giving them permission to say that they like skinship and also maybe affirmation or conversation. Giving them two options is good for that. So yeah, I did that.

CHASE AMANTE:

Skinship is just touch, right? ‘Cause I saw that in your report and I was like I’ve never heard that word before. Skinship, you know, the love language. I see love languages, but I hadn’t seen that word.

ATLAS IV:

Oh yeah. Maybe it is a Gen Z word, but yeah, basically touch.

CHASE AMANTE:

Gotcha. Skinship. It’s kind of cool. So, if we go back to a little bit earlier in the date, you said that when you met her for that date, you were waiting for her at the Metro, and she was 30 minutes late. Now, a lot of guys would bail before then. They would consider it disrespect, etc. You stuck it out through and you ended up banging her, not on the first date, but on the next one. You kind of have to expect that girls are going to be late in Brazil ‘cause it’s super normal. In fact, there probably will be more late than they will be on time. I don’t know, if you take a super punctual approach to it, you’re going to just lose a lot of girls, I think. The better approach is to, if you have several girls in your pipeline, it’s kind of stack your dates a little bit or at least have multiple dates kind of potentially lined up in the same timeframe so that if one girl flakes or doesn’t come or shows up super late, then you’ll have a plan B. But definitely like Latin America is kind of famous for being probably the least punctual continent on planet.

CHASE AMANTE:

Yeah, that makes sense. Gotta have the cultural perspective. So back to that, that same Rio cafe girl with the big boobs, you were having trouble getting a sexual vibe going on the second date, but then you pulled out an Alek Rolstad gambit. So you pulled out the eight types of orgasms and then you claimed to her that it came from 50 Shades of Grey, which it doesn’t, but she doesn’t know that. And then you said that saved the day and gambits are really holding it down for you in those early reports. And we’re just talking about that. Is sex talk still your go-to for sexualizing things?

ATLAS IV:

It is. So this is interesting ‘cause I’ve been thinking a lot about this recently. In those earlier report, I mean, I’ve been using these gambits pretty much for the past year. They’ve kind of been my focus and I think they are very powerful, but I’m not 100% sure that they are the reason that I laid all these girls that I laid. I think a much bigger component is like if we talk about the Gunwitch framework, the Three Keys, there’s the social frame, emotional stimulation or I would call it even emotional connection, more so than just stimulation, sexual arousal.

And obviously, the sex talk gambits can help with some of those things. But if your fundamentals are not conveying and not building on those three keys, then the gambits aren’t going to do anything more than that, I think. Like they’re almost like a buff or a spell that you can use that will, take a gaming analogy, that will give you a boost. But if you don’t have those fundamental stats in place, then they’re not going to be effective. And I’ve kind of recently come to the realization that I think perhaps I’ve been focusing too much on the gambits when in fact my fundamentals are not perfect yet.

And that’s actually the reason that I haven’t gotten as much results as I wanted and that I’m also facing this LMR, because when you focus too much, like too intensely on things like gambits, it can distract you from the things that you should be working on with your fundamentals. So I still use them and I have used them like pretty much for all my dates since that time, since like last year when I first got back into game, but I think they’re just one piece of the puzzle.

 

How Atlas’s Approach Has Evolved

CHASE AMANTE:

It’s a good perspective. Gotta have that holistic approach. You know, lots of different things matter and get too focused on one thing. It’s good to focus on certain things for a while and then really get those nailed down, but always multiple things that are playing into how a seduction plays out. The framework matters, the gambits matter, the fundamentals matter.

It all just kind of blends together into this— What’s the word? This cauldron of seductive success. So, we just talked about this a little bit, but I would like to run through your game a bit. What does a typical approach and pickup look like for you right now?

ATLAS IV:

Right now? So I’ve actually kind of moved away from these like canned openers that I was using before, like Gunwitch’s “you look like my ex-girlfriend, only there’s a different energy behind your eyes.” There was like a double compliance opener, which I was experimenting with, which was like first question, how old are you? She answers. Second question, are you single? And then, hi, I’m Atlas.

I was using that for a while. I find that after a certain point, like these canned openers are great for when you are trying to overcome approach anxiety. Now, I kind of more freestyle it because I came to realize that it doesn’t matter so much what you say. It’s about how you say it. And it’s about your momentum, your state, and your fundamentals. Again, like it always comes back to fundamentals. That’s like the number one. It’s like 90% of it, I think. So my approaches now, they depend a lot on my state. So a big part of my focus now is trying to get into state, which is like being present. You know, StrayDog posted this really good thread just a couple of days ago about The Power of the Slow Walk.

CHASE AMANTE:

Yeah, I saw it.

ATLAS IV:

It’s got a couple of [examples]. This one by John Travolta from Saturday Night Fever, doing this strut down the street. And he tries to cold approach a girl and she kind of blows him off. Yeah, I love that.

And all those little things are super important, I think, like all the little— your eye contact, the way that you compose yourself, your presence, the way you walk, the way you smile at a girl, the angle with which you come at her, your tonality and your voice. All that is way more important than whatever you say. So I don’t even know what I’m going to say when I go to open a girl. I just open her first and then the words kind of come out, which I think that comes after a certain period of time of having used the canned openers to overcome approach anxiety. But yeah, that’s how I open pretty much.

 

I follow Tom Torero’s London Day Game model. He was another inspiration for me. Pretty unfortunate the way he ended up, but he was a really great day gamer and had a lot of really great material, great infields. And so, in his model, you sort of start out with assumptions stacking. Making assumptions about her based on, I don’t know, her fashion or what she might be doing, making some story out of it. Like you look like you were just on the way to some meeting with the head of fashion or, I don’t know, some crazy thing. It could be totally not even realistic. The goal is just to like get her kind of hooking without asking too much questions. So I just try to do that. I try to improvise a little bit.

Then after she hooks, kind of dial it down a bit. Try to lock in, which is a really important article that Alek wrote about. Every guy should read this. And then I’ll kind of lean against the railing, and she’s positioned kind of looking at me and I’m kind of forward, so it’s like the frame’s reversed. Really powerful trick that I think it completely changes the dynamic of the approach.

CHASE AMANTE:

You’re looking out towards the crowd. You could be distracted. She’s totally focused on you. You’ve got the wall at your back. And to any outside observer, it looks like she’s the one that’s hitting on you because you’re laying back chill and she’s just standing there, hovering in space, talking to you. And she can feel the difference too and so can you.

ATLAS IV:

Exactly. Exactly. Yeah. Yeah. So yeah, get into that position, then do a bit of just kind of dial the vibe down a bit, but I might like fold my arms and just kind of relax a little bit and kind of poke a face, neutral expression, kind of me qualifying her asking some just basic questions. But if you’re not going for an Instadate, then say, in the future, let’s get something, and then don’t ask for her number, just like if she says yes, which I just get out my phone and say, do you have WhatsApp or whatever? Yeah, that’s a typical approach for me.

CHASE AMANTE:

Cool. Smooth. And it’s interesting. So I’ve heard the London Day Game model numerous times. I didn’t know that was to do a bunch of assumptions because that’s something that you kind of— especially if you’re day gaming a lot, you kind of sort of end up gravitating towards that, because if you start asking girls questions, they’re not in social mode when you just stop her and engage her. But if you start asking questions, it’s weird, like why did you stop her? If you’re wrong, she corrects you. If you’re right, she’s like, wow, how did you know that? And either way, it’s fun.

ATLAS IV:

Yeah, exactly. Or you can just do like what Hector does and what he teaches. It’s just what are you up to, what are you doing, and then just talk about something like that, you know. It doesn’t have to be complicated. It’s really all about the vibe.

There was a report on the forum that you found from a guy talking about 11 lays he had in 40 days in South America; you mentioned it a few times, and then finally you commented on it very recently. It was actually the first comment on that report. I felt kind of bad reading it for that guy. I was like, ah, it was a great report, but nobody replied back in the day when he posted it. Could you tell me what kind of influence that report had on you?

Title: Social Circle Escalation Windows Are SHORT; Be Ready to Pounce! | Girls Chase
content:
You may think because you know a girl she’ll cut you some slack. But if you’re at a party or a bar with her, the windows she offers you may only be quick!

This post by RDawg originally appears on our forum here.

Social Circle is something that I have been really trying to “nail down” lately and I’ve noticed a few things about it.

 

Social Circle Escalation Windows: So Short!

Firstly, escalation windows are so SHORT. Seriously, like shorter than you can say the word ‘short’. When you have a girl in social circle that you are trying to pick up and an escalation window presents itself, you have very little time to react and take advantage.

For example: last night I was out on a pub crawl and there was a girl on this pub crawl that is part of my social circle/extended social circle. I’ve made out and messed around with this girl a bit back in the day at bars and parties (prior to Girlschase) but never escalated to sex.

Anyways, she came up to me at some point in the night while I was standing at the bar and started flirting with me. She was touching me just above my hip while saying, “Hey Rdawg, how have you been? It’s been a while since I’ve seen you,” followed by a little more small talk/compliments for maybe a minute or two and then for her to only walk away.

As you see above, I failed to act quickly and moved too slow, which led her to just walk away.

However, another escalation window presented itself with this same girl about 20 minutes later. This same girl’s best friend was flirting with me and playing with my hair and as soon as she saw her best friend flirting with me, she had to come join and play with my hair as well and flirt with me again. Escalation window presented itself quickly and it closed just as quick as it opened. I again failed to act quickly.

This process somewhat repeated throughout the night. She would present another escalation window but the more windows she presented, the smaller they got. The escalation window may have started at 2 minutes from the first one she presented, all the way to the last one being maybe a few seconds.

You may be asking me, why aren’t I hitting these escalation windows, even if I know there present? Well, social circle game hasn’t been something that I have practiced much, at least not until recently when I have been trying to hit it hard. So, when it comes to social circle, I’ve been thrown off a bit by the whole process of social circle pick up. My issue actually may be a bit of a mindset problem as well.

 

Should You Text Social Circle Girls You Missed Escalation Windows With?

I woke up this morning and thought of sending her a message along the lines of...

Hey XYZ, it was nice seeing you out last night, let’s catch up and grab some drinks!

However, I went against it based on the instinct of a common response I tend to see to a text like this with girls in social circle or missed escalation windows. If I were to send that message, the response most likely would have been:

Hey Rdawg, it was nice see you too! Well, I’m kind of busy the next few weeks with school and work but maybe I’ll see you downtown or at a party!

The response seems to be common and the underlying message behind it is: “Hey Rdawg, you kind of missed your opportunity already but I still think you’re attractive and I would probably still fuck you but maybe at a party or bar if we were to run into each other.”

Ahh ya.. never a good position to be held in because you’re being held to a lower standard/value. At some point, if a girl sent a text like this, it practically means she may have held you to a very high standard but you dropped off pretty quick and are just subpar to her now.

 

Dealing with Missed Escalation Windows in Social Circle
Just keep going out, being social, and odds are you will run into her again and another chance will appear!

So how do you handle a situation like this in social circle? Well, you move on to try and pick up other girls, while hoping to run into that girl again at some point.

It’s not the worst situation to be in because that girl will technically always be there since she is in your social circle. It’s just a matter of running into her again at that party, bar, or social event and capitalizing on that escalation window quickly when it presents itself.

The purpose of this post was to show that when an escalation window presents itself from a girl in social circle, you must begin moving things quickly. The only advantage of a girl in social circle that you are trying to pick up is that if you do miss an escalation window, you’re more than likely going to get another opportunity at some point, whether that is later in the night or another day.

Secondly, the other purpose of this post was to show the type of texts you may receive from girls if you were to text them after failing to hit those escalation windows from girl’s in social circle.

Note: All of this stuff is covered in Peter Fontes and Chase’s articles on social circle. It’s just nice to see this firsthand and break it down from another perspective. Also, I just kind of wanted to add the “text” portion in, if you were to text a girl from social circle after failing to hit escalation windows.

Title: Tactics Tuesdays: Prefacing | Girls Chase
content:
Prefacing lets you approach women or issues in ways that they’d push back on otherwise… yet, with you, thanks to you prefacing, they accept (& even enjoy!).

Tiny little tactic here that lets you get away with lots.

Generally there are some subjects in conversation you cannot touch. Certain sensitivities, criticisms, or, alternately, certain proposals. Things that if you accuse someone of them or suggest them raise so many hackles it can blow the whole conversation up.

Sometimes, too, you’ll meet hot-tempered people quick to jump to conclusions every time you manage to utter more than a few syllables. These individuals can be particularly hard to talk to, as they personalize nearly everything you say.

Finally, there are things you might say – including many of the openers you deliver to women during cold approach – that might be hard to swallow on their own. They seem incongruent or hard to believe. A woman might think you’re just yanking her chain.

The one tactic you can use to route around each and every one of these problems is prefacing; where you use a short prefacing statement to pace your listener’s understanding before diving into the juicy stuff.

 

Prefacing Examples

Let me start with an example just so make the tactic clear.

Let’s say you’re talking to a girl and she seems a bit anal-retentive and hasn’t bitten so far on any of the sexual topics you’ve floated. You want to try a little gambit about being ‘sexually stiff’ to see if that loosens her up. However, you suspect if you just accuse her of it or talk about it on its own, without prefacing, she’ll reject it. For instance:

YOU: You know, I’ve noticed certain people tend to be pretty ‘sexually stiff’. They have a lot of rules they follow and are generally a lot more suspicious of sexual things. It’s my belief these people cut themselves off from a lot of themselves.

HER: I don’t know what you’re talking about. I don’t think that’s true at all.

She will reject it because she feels like you’re accusing her without accusing her. Your statement doesn’t name her, so she’d look defensive if she just blurted out “Not me!”; instead she simply rejects the premise whole cloth; a kind of ‘nuke it from orbit’ move.

What if instead you tell her directly you’re talking about her, still without prefacing?

YOU: You know, it seems like you might be one of the people I judge to be pretty ‘sexually stiff’. Such people have a lot of rules they follow and are generally a lot more suspicious of sexual things. It’s my belief these people cut themselves off from a lot of themselves.

HER: You’re wrong. You don’t know anything about me.

A direct accusation runs a high risk of turning the girl defensive and causing her to reject your suggestion. Once again, the approach does not work.

What can we do if we want to use this gambit? We can preface it… by telling the girl it is not about her.

YOU: I’m not saying this is you, but I’ve noticed certain people tend to be pretty ‘sexually stiff’. They have a lot of rules they follow and are generally a lot more suspicious of sexual things. It’s my belief these people cut themselves off from a lot of themselves.

HER: I think that’s true. Some people are just not as comfortable with sexual things.

And now you’re in and can talk about being easier-going sexually. Because you prefaced it by telling her you are “not saying this is” her, you avoid the kneejerk “I’m being accused!” reaction… and now she reacts toward it differently.

Also, because you’ve extended her the benefit of the doubt (by “not assuming” anything about her), she is socially obligated to do the same to you, extending you the benefit of the doubt as your observation extended her (that your statement is about “certain people” more generally) and not dismissing it out-of-hand.

The reaction most of the time is either going to be:

She agrees that it is true and certain people are sexually unconfident, OR

She starts to qualify herself: “Yes, and just to be clear I am really not that way” or “I actually am that way a little bit”

Each of those responses works to your benefit: her agreeing with the statement opens it up for conversation; her qualifying herself puts you firmly in the lead.

But why would adding just a few little words of prefacing completely change the way a statement is received?

 

The Power of Similarity & Attainability
The more similar she feels to you, and the more attainable, the more being with you is like being with a nice, warm, fluffy pillow she can snuggle right up to — instead of a cold, unfeeling man she needs to stay away from.

We use prefacing before anything we say that might make a girl feel we are too dissimilar to her and thus unattainable for her.

If you’re talking to a girl and out of the blue accuse her of sexual woodenness, she will very likely be offended, feel like you do not ‘get’ her, feel like your and her values are too dissimilar, and begin to auto-reject you.

If you approach a woman cold and jump right into a too-polished opener, she will think you must do this all the time, feel like you and her are completely different (SHE would certainly never go around talking to lots of strangers all the time! It’s just weird!), feel like your and her values are too dissimilar, and begin to auto-reject you.

Readers of my book How to Make Girls Chase are intimately familiar with how big a role attainability plays in the success or failure of your seductions. If a woman starts to feel that you are not attainable to her – i.e., that you do not really respect her, that the interaction is not actually ‘real’ in some way, or that a girl like her cannot actually get a guy like you – she will auto-reject you to protect her ego.

One Date owners know how vital it is to maintain a feeling of shared underlying attitudes with women you’re talking to. So long as she feels the two of you share similar attitudes toward life, she will trust you, and the interaction flows smoothly along. But if she begins to suspect that your and her attitudes are too dissimilar, trust erodes, you become unattainable, and the interaction falls apart.

Prefaces allow you to avoid ‘accidental similarity/attainability damage’ with statements and approaches that are otherwise ‘too out there’ from a girl’s usual point of view. That is how you’re able to get away with things you otherwise could not by prefacing.

As an example: say you approach a girl on the street and tell her, “Excuse, but you’re REALLY pretty and I had to meet you. I’m Liam.” Now, she may be flattered, and she may stop and talk. Nevertheless, it’s so out-of-the-blue and un-prefaced that she is going to wonder who does that? Who just walks up to a random stranger to compliment her like that?

Well, most of the guys who have done it to her in the past were thirsty guys, desperate guys, or horny guys, so she’ll be tempted to throw you into their lot. Unless she’s a little thirsty and horny herself, that is going to make her feel like you and her are on different wavelengths. -attainability -similarity and you’re already starting off on the wrong foot.

But if instead you preface your opener, you can have a completely different effect:

YOU: Excuse me… [authoritative voice tone; 2-3 second pause to let her to wonder what you have to say; curious smile as if there is something very interesting about her] but I saw you sitting here, and I simply HAD to come tell you, that… [1-2 second pause + genuine interest nose crinkle] you have the sunniest disposition I have seen all day. Like I can just feel the sunbeams pouring off of you. I’m Chase. [handclasp]

Just opening her with, “Excuse me, but you have such a sunny disposition,” while shorter, simply does not have the level of grounding and sincerity as you get with a properly paced and prefaced opener.

(you can still use short, non-prefaced openers in situations where that will be congruent; namely, in situations where either opening is so low effort you don’t need a great reason to do it; or where the girl has obviously put in a lot of effort herself into getting you to open, so the two of you are on even footing effort-wise)

Basically, we use prefacing on openers to explain the level of effort invested in meeting her, which is going to seem unusual much of the time unless she also runs around investing a lot of effort into approaching random people; meanwhile we use prefacing on other statements to avoid women taking them as accusations and dismissing or rejecting them.

This keeps us feeling to her as if the values we share are similar (if she can understand why we’re doing something, it means she relates to it!), and keeps us attainable to her.

 

How to Preface Properly

You’ll use prefacing for anything where you feel like a girl MIGHT:

Feel like what you’re saying is insincere, or

Feel like what you’re saying is an accusation

The preface ‘takes the edge off’ things that might otherwise cause you dissimilarity or auto-rejection issues. Anything where you suspect her default reaction will be to push back and tell you “No way!” or “No thanks.”

Some examples of non-opener prefaces:

“I’m not saying this is you, but”

“Now don’t take this the wrong way, however”

“I’m going to talk about XYZ but that’s not an accusation”

“I’m not saying we need to do this, but WHAT IF…”

For instance:

You’re talking to a girl at a party who is moody and difficult. You tell her, “I’m not saying this is you, but have you noticed how some people go out to have fun but then they don’t let themselves have fun? Why do you think that is?”

She can:

Comment on how OTHER people do that… and now she will feel social pressure to also display (through lightening up her behavior) how she herself is NOT that way.

Acknowledge that she IS doing it, tell you WHY, then still feel social pressure (now that she’s admitted to it) to lighten up a bit and not be so pouty.

(bonus: there’s an implicit conformity frame embedded there, as you suggest that the “thing everybody does” at parties is have fun, but she by not doing it is the odd one out)

Or let’s say you’re sitting in a park talking with a girl. The conversation is pleasant but platonic. This girl has an amazing posterior though and you keep glancing at it / thinking about it. You feel like it’d be better to just say something rather than say nothing and let this keep on being platonic. But you don’t want to sound like a complete horndog. So, you preface:

“Now, don’t take this the wrong way, however you have just an amazing ass. Just throwing that out there!”

If she likes you, she is going to laugh and engage with this. She may well start to be a lot more flirtatious with you, as she may not have realized before that it was supposed to be a flirtation, that she was ‘allowed’ to flirt, or that you even liked her that way (maybe you seemed a bit too high value and did not seem attainable to her. Suddenly you share that you like her ass, in a not-boorish way, and she realizes you are attainable! Now she can safely flirt!).

Now imagine this scenario: you’re hours into a seduction with a girl, and it’s going well but beginning to feel stale. You want to propose a move but she’s been a little resistant compliance-wise and you’re not certain she’ll go for it. Of course if she rejects a big compliance move on your part it’ll be negative compliance momentum and you’ll be in some trouble. Prefacing to the rescue!

“I’m not saying we need to do this,” you say, “but what if we took a stroll over to the lake, removed all our clothes, and went skinny dipping?”

This is a wild, out-of-left-field, sexually charged suggestion, especially considering the context (compliance-resistant girl you’ve been talking to for hours). Had you just told her, “Let’s go to the pond and go skinny dipping,” it would not have matched the dynamic, would feel like you are not attuned to her ‘resistant’ wavelength at all, and would hurt both similarity and attainability. But because you preface it as a ‘crazy idea’ that you are simply floating rather than demanding, she can either laugh it off as a joke or accept it as a thing to do.

If she laughs it off as a joke (“You’re crazy!”) it nevertheless implants a sexual frame in her head and at the same time suggests that you want to get things moving, so she’d better quit dragging her feet.

If she accepts it (“You know what… why not. Okay!”) then you break out of the rut you were in and stand an excellent chance of nailing this chick naked in the lake.

 

Prefacing in Relationships

You can also use prefacing in relationships.

Any time you need to discuss a prickly issue with a woman that she has a lot of resistance to discussing, or that she has had bad reactions to in the past, prefacing can save the day.

For instance, say you’re with a girl who’s been wearing shoes without socks so now her shoes smell bad (fun fact: if you wear shoes without socks, a lot more sweat seeps into the shoe interior; warmth from your feet + moisture from the sweat + an environment that never gets cleaned is the perfect home for fungus to grow and emanate a lot of nasty odors). I actually had a chick like this… great in every way except that when she’d come over and take her shoes off suddenly the whole apartment stunk. I made her start leaving her shoes in the hallway outside just to not stink the place up!

Let’s say you brought it up a few times already but she hasn’t fixed it and gets defensive when you bring it up. You need to figure out what she’s feeling accused of being, then preface that you are NOT accusing her of that, then tell her WHAT you want her to do.

For instance:

YOU: Hey can you start wearing socks please? And get some new shoes? That smell is awful.

HER: I hate that you make me feel dirty all the time!

Okay, she feels accused of being dirty… then wants to not comply because if she complies it’s like an admission she’s dirty. Now that we know what she doesn’t like being accused of, let’s use a preface to isolate the problem – normally you would do this another time rather than immediately after she has just resisted your first attempt (i.e., give her time to cool off and reset so she is not in a defensive mode):

YOU: Hey, first off, I am NOT calling you dirty. The rest of you is totally clean. However, is it too much to ask you to change your shoes and get some socks? That ONE part of you is actually dirty and it’s a pretty easy fix.

HER: [laughs] Okay fine I will get new shoes and start wearing socks.

By prefacing that you are not accusing her of whatever it is she prickles at being accused of, you maintain similarity and attainability, then can isolate the problem for her to address.

(with that girl I was seeing, fortunately she got the message right away, and as soon as she knew that not wearing socks was the cause of her stinky shoe problems she bought new shoes, bought a bunch of socks, and the problem was instantly solved. Who doesn’t wear socks when wearing shoes? I don’t know… but until I met her this girl didn’t!)

 

Wrap Up
Preface your statements, and make it all go down easier.

I’m not saying you always have to use this, or that you need to use it in every situation.

But, for what it’s good for, prefacing can be very powerful.

(did you notice I prefaced just there?)

Prefacing allows you to glide right past scenarios that trigger feelings of dissimilarity and low attainability to instead implant ideas or suggestions, or pull off openers, or handle relationship issues, in high similarity / high attainability ways.

As with any tactic, calibration is key. Even with prefacing, if you try pushing something on a girl at the wrong moment, or without enough of a connection built up, she can still take it wrong and opt to just reject it or leave.

Yet preface properly, and you can smoothly pull off many things that for other, non-preface-using men would be difficult or impossible to pull off.

Chase

Title: Operant Conditioning: Response Size & Big Picture Focus | Girls Chase
content:
Operant conditioning (or behavior shaping) lets you modify how people act through rewards and punishments. But in ‘mixed case’ scenarios things get tricky…

I first wrote about operant conditioning a dozen years ago in my article on using for behavior shaping inside romantic relationships. If you haven’t read that one, or it’s been a while, read it first, because this article builds upon it.

The quick summary is that through rewards and punishment, you can direct another person’s behavior. Reward her, and you’ll get more of that behavior. Punish her, and you’ll get less of it.

Today’s article focuses on some nuance in operant conditioning. Namely: how the size of your response affects reinforcement/discouragement… plus the importance of focusing on the big picture too rather than exclusively the small one.

 

Big vs. Little Picture Behavior Shaping

Oftentimes in behavior shaping, you will encounter complex situations.

For instance, a woman may make a mistake inside the broader context of doing something aimed at helping you.

Here’s an example: let’s say you want to take a day trip together. You task her with planning it out. She eagerly handles the planning, happy to invest in your relationship this way. The big day comes, and the two of you drive far out of town. After a fun day of touring about, you arrive at the hotel she planned out… only to discover the place no longer exists. It was demolished two years ago. It is now nighttime, you’re in the middle of nowhere, tired from a day of trekking, and there are no other hotels nearby.

Making things worse, you’ve heard of highwaymen in the area setting up traps for lonely travelers driving the dark roads at night. People have been rolling along, only to come upon a truck parked in the middle of the road, blocking it. Sometimes someone may be laying on the road, seemingly injured. Meanwhile, other robbers lie in wait along the shoulder of the road, hiding themselves until the victims exit their vehicle to investigate.

You’re thinking about all this, tired, stressed, and your woman is starting to panic to boot. What is the right response from an operant conditioning perspective?

She needs punishment to avoid future situations like this (i.e., not ensuring a crucial destination still, in fact, exists).

However, that is not the only consideration here, because there is both a BIG picture and a SMALL one.

The small picture is “your woman brought you to a hotel in the middle of nowhere that no longer exists.”

The big picture is “your woman did a lot of research to put this entire day trip together, investing in you and the relationship.”

If you punish severely (such as getting extremely annoyed at her), you punish BOTH the mistake of bringing you to the missing hotel AND the investment of planning out the whole day trip.

You will teach her to be more careful, yes.

However, you will also condition her to not be so eager to invest in you or the relationship.

The latter is a big problem you probably did not intend – but will give yourself to deal with regardless!

 

Response Size Affects Attribution

I have not seen tests on this, but my experience has led me to conclude that the bigger the response, the bigger the attribution.

That is to say, if you give the day trip-planning girl a small, measured punishment, she will tie that to the immediate thing (missing hotel), and likely learn to plan trips more carefully in the future.

However, if you give her a LARGE, SEVERE punishment, she will tie that to the big picture item (her planning out the entire day trip), and learn to turn down opportunities to invest in the relationship like this instead of eagerly take them on.

In other words:

You sigh deeply and say, “This is trouble. We’re in the middle of nowhere, in a region that has bandits, we’re tired, it’s dark, and this hotel does not exist. The rest of the trip was excellent, but this is not good.” She gets specific, measured punishment that makes her more likely to be careful in her research in the future. OR

You freak out, yelling, screaming, and ranting, banging your hands on the steering wheel, cursing, totally out of control. Maybe you loudly ask, “Why did I ever leave this to you?” making her feel as if the entire trip has been a complete disaster. She gets large, severe punishment that she is going to tie to the entire trip, making her more likely to avoid planning day trips in the future, wanting to go on day trips, or really invest in the relationship with you more generally.

If the response is large, the attribution moves to the BIG PICTURE.

That’s no problem when both big picture and little picture are both bad. For instance, if she went out partying without you, then got drunk and you had to call her a taxi. When she got to your place you were furious. The message she gets is not “getting drunk when I go out is painful” (little picture) but rather “going out to party without my man is painful” (big picture). That serves your aims too – unless you want your girl going out to party without you (maybe some dudes do?).

However, when the situation is mixed – such as when the big picture is good (she was doing something to be helpful) but the little picture is bad (she messed up) – you must be very careful what response size you use IF you do not want to discourage the big picture good behavior.

 

Why People Tune Out of Relationships
A precipitating factor in why people leave.

Disproportionate response sizes that accidentally punish good big picture behavior are an important reason people ‘tune out’ of long-term relationships, in my experience.

The stereotype of the henpecked husband who spends more and more time at work, avoiding being around his family, or the deadbeat dad who one day goes out for milk and never comes back, are examples of this. People don’t one day tune out or one day leave because “they were just bored” (well, not normally, anyway). They do it because they reached a breaking point where they felt their efforts were too thankless, or even felt actively resented.

What often happens in these relationships is the man tries to do what he thinks is good (investing in the relationship – what the woman wants!), only to do something that is not done the way the woman wants, or he overlooks something the woman thinks is important, or otherwise fails to meet her expectations, and she gives him lots of drama.

Because the response size is disproportionate to the offense, and does not account for the mixed scenario of “good big picture, bad little picture”, the man learns the ultimate lesson that “investing in relationship = bad” and reduces his investment levels (which, ultimately, frustrates the woman even more, leading to more drama, more punishment, and more tuning out on the man’s part).

But men often do this too; particularly hot-tempered men. If you are a hot-tempered man you must be very careful about this. When you punish a woman too severely for messing up on a detail when she was trying to serve you/the relationship, the ultimate effect is that you train her not to serve you or the relationship.

In other words, you are causing her to tune out of the relationship.

That is probably NOT what you want.

But no matter WHAT you WANT, it WILL be the effect, if the response size is disproportionate, and the ‘training scenario’ is mixed!

 

Dealing with Mixed Scenario Punishment/Reward

These considerations only matter for genuine ‘mixed scenarios’. That is:

Big picture good, little picture bad (planned whole day trip, but messed up hotel)

Big picture bad, little picture good (went out to drink with the girls, but home early)

Especially if you are hot-tempered or present time-oriented, you are going to tend to prioritize the most immediate (little picture) item and ignore the overarching (big picture) context.

Examples:

You blow up at her for messing up the hotel. The lesson she learns? “Don’t agree to plan day trips or invest so much in the relationship. It hurts! Not worth it!”

You gush over her for how responsible she is coming home early from a night out drinking with the girls. The lesson she learns? “It’s totally cool to go out drinking without him. I even get bonus points with him if I manage to get home early!”

In the first example, you inadvertently discourage her from investing more in the relationship.

In the second example, you inadvertently encourage her going out to drink without you.

Both of these are mistakes, assuming you want girls to invest in you and don’t want them going out partying and drinking.

READ MORE: Why I Quit Dating Girls Who Club, Party, or Drink

How should you respond to these scenarios?

With a deliberately muted, controlled response. You HAVE to! You MUST be aware of the double condition – one element good, the other element bad. You do not want to discourage good behavior, but you also don’t want to encourage bad.

So:

When she screws up the hotel, you control yourself, reminding yourself she planned the whole trip, and just express moderate, measured disappointment. “Welp, this is bad.” If she’s clearly already stressed, you keep punishment very light (she is already self-punishing); if she’s blissfully ignorant as to how bad the situation is, you apply a little more pressure, while still keeping it measured – she needs to know she screwed up, but that is was just on this one thing, not everything.

When she comes home early after going out drinking, again, you control yourself, not gushing in relief but giving her a measured, “I’m glad you didn’t stay out too late,” that approves of her return but still shows disapproval overall that she went out in the first place. This way she gets the message that “Coming home early was good, but it’d be better had I not gone out at all.”

The muted, measured response is KEY for any mixed behavior shaping situation you find yourself in. It is absolutely essential to avoid sending the wrong message and ‘mistraining’ her.

 

Mixed Scenarios Are Common. Always Look at the Big Picture!
How guilty is she, and what is the context? Let that be the guide to your response size.

You need to get yourself into the habit of examining behaviors in light of the context they occur within. Most small behaviors occur in the context of a larger overarching pattern.

People make mistakes when they are trying to do good things. They also do good things in the midst of overall misbehaving. If you only address the immediate item, and if you do so in a strong or severe way, you risk shaping behavior in the wrong direction: punish good behavior, or reward bad behavior.

Always examine the meta-context of a behavior:

Was the good behavior done in a bad larger context? Do not give gushing praise.

Was the bad behavior done in a good larger context? Do not mete out harsh punishment.

This is how you avoid worsening bad behaviors accidentally, or discouraging good behaviors accidentally.

Many a relationship has been sabotaged by discouraging good behaviors or permitting bad ones. Don’t make that mistake – always keep the context top of mind!

Chase Amante

Title: Tactics Tuesdays: Conformity Framing | Girls Chase
content:
If you want to get a girl to do what you want, it’s a lot easier if she thinks what you want is ‘what everyone is doing’ or ‘what the cool kids do’. That’s conformity framing.

Women are herd creatures. Women, far more than men, feel driven to conform.

This can work against your interests when the direction of their conformity goes against your desires. For instance:

She’s consuming a lot of messages about how important it is to “not sleep with a man too quickly.” So she puts up many more walls to sleeping with you.

She’s part of a friend group that talks down on men working the trades. However, you work a trade. When she finds this out, she loses attraction to you.

All her social circle is filled with party people who drink and do drugs and think anyone who doesn’t is a stick in the mud. You’re a teetotaler. So, she decides you’re boring.

Other women with other perspectives might find you sexy and exciting (and be highly willing to comply with you!). But because these girls are operating within paradigms where they believe the ‘consensus’ is to reject your advances or look down on you/your traits/lifestyle, you run into walls with them.

What can you do about this? Well, one tool in our seducer’s toolbox is this: you can frame what YOU want or are as the consensus, and shift her paradigm to one that aligns with you.

 

Conformity Seriously Impacts a LOT with Girls

I’ve talked at times about my experiences with picking up blonde bombshells. These are girls who bleach their hair blonde (despite not being natural blondes) and dress and act in the most stereotypically ‘cool’ ways they can. Such gals are conformists through and through.

When I first started picking up girls, blonde bombshells were the coldest of any girls I approached. They’d continually snub me and act disinterested in me. Eventually I came to dislike and avoid them. No other type of girl treated me like that – just these stuck-up bombshells!

I didn’t know what the cause was, until one day I began to wonder if it might be due to these girls’ conformist natures – plus me not matching the ‘stereotypical cool/sexy guy’ look or vibe. My look and vibe were good… but not ‘trendy dude sexy’ good.

So, I changed my look, adopting trendy facial hair, a trendy hairstyle, and cool, trendy clothes, and ALMOST INSTANTLY blonde bombshells warmed right up to me. Suddenly I was the guy these girls wanted to meet; they found me fascinating, loved flirting and talking with me, and started coming home with me.

“That’s it?” I wondered. “It is really just down to IMAGE?”

I shouldn’t have been surprised. My adventures with social experimentation started in sixth grade. One day when I was 12 years old, I switched to wearing a popular sports team’s coat, removed my glasses, and behaved more extroverted. The result: my classmates en masse saw me in a completely different light. They began treating me totally different too (way better, in fact. I went from “nerd” to “interesting and cool” in a single day).

The reason why is because when you CONFORM with what people think is ‘cool’, ‘sexy’, ‘popular’, or ‘expected’, people naturally view you as being those things and treat you as such. Girls will quickly sleep with guys who match the image that is already in their head of ‘sexy bad boy girls sleep with fast’, while avoiding fast sex with guys who match the image in their head of ‘reliable safe guy girls take it slow with’. It almost does not matter what else you say or do; if you match the image, you get treated like the image!

Conformity with certain stereotypes and conceptions has a LARGE effect on how your seductions play out.

But what do you do if you are already dressed how you’re dressed, have behaved how you’ve behaved, and now you’re running up against a wall where girls give you resistance to conform to some set of beliefs they ‘believe’ they ‘should’?

 

Conformity Framing: “All the Cool Kids Are Doing It”
There are many forces in society that want her to behave in certain ways.

No doubt you’ve heard those lines, used to convince other people to do something, of:

“Come on… everyone is doing it.” Or

“All the cool kids are doing it.”

These lines often feel like bald, blatant manipulation… and YET, despite their obviousness, they often work.

In high school and college, I had other kids use these lines on me, and sometimes I’d comply! Other times I’d still resist, but I’d feel enormous pressure as I resisted it, because I felt like I was making myself look lame or uncool.

I’m a lot more resistant to social pressure and external influence than most people are. But these obvious lines have still worked on me!

These lines are conformity framing. They attempt to frame something as ‘cool’, ‘accepted’, or ‘ubiquitous’. They seek to get someone to change his or her behavior by framing that person’s behavior as ‘uncool’, ‘outsider’, or ‘weird’ to make that person want to switch to the comparatively more accepted, cool, normal behavior.

Other typical conformity framing lines you may have heard:

“It’s [current year]. This is normal now.”

“You’re [age]. You should be comfortable with this by now.”

“You’re never going to [something good] with that attitude!”

“Really? You’re not comfortable with [desired thing]?”

“Is this new for you? Have you not done this before?”

All these conformity frames work by placing social pressure on the individual to ‘get with it’ or otherwise show that he or she is not uncool, left behind, and outsider, but is just as cool and hip as other people are.

While these lines can work, they’re a bit ‘dark side’ for my taste. Also a bit too naked in their intent, and more prone to making people resent you and see you as a manipulator after the fact.

Instead, what I prefer is a more holistic approach to conformity framing, where you take a woman on a small journey that helps her understand how something actually is the norm, and that it is okay to engage in it.

 

Fleshed Out Conformity Frames

Here’s a more ‘fleshed out’ conformity frame.

Let’s say you’re with a girl who’s resistant to going to bed with you. You talk to her and it comes up that “everyone says you shouldn’t hop into bed with a man too quick. It makes him not respect you as much and leads to regret.”

The best way (in my opinion) to turn the conformity frame in your advantage is this process:

Find out where she’s getting this conformity frame from.

Dismiss the frame as being pushed by a vocal minority.

Share the REAL conformity frame (“everyone is doing it”).

Discuss some of the benefits of what the thing is.

Then reiterate that these benefits are why everyone is doing it.

If necessary, show her (better than telling her) examples of people doing it.

With the girl who says “everyone says you shouldn’t hop into bed with a man too quick”, you might have this conversation:

YOU: [escalating on her]

HER: [resisting you]

YOU: What’s holding you back?

HER: It’s just that everyone says you shouldn’t hop into bed with a man too quick. It makes him not respect you as much and leads to regret.

YOU: Who says that? [STEP 1: find out where her conformity frame comes from]

HER: Like influencers and stuff. Some of my friends say it too.

YOU: These influencers are all like parrots. One of them says something then they all repeat it because that’s what gets the most clicks. It’s not real consensus; it’s what Edward Bernays called ‘manufactured consensus’. Then regular people see it and parrot it, like those friends of yours. [STEP 2: dismiss her conformity frame as pushed by a vocal minority] Most people get together when they want to get together. They don’t follow some rules from a handful of vocal influencers on social media. [STEP 3: share the REAL conformity frame] They follow their hearts, do what feels right, and don’t block themselves off from the connections, and pleasure, and release they desire with someone they desire it with. [STEP 4: discuss benefits of the real popular thing] That’s why most people do not do what these anal-retentive vocal minority people working as ‘influencers’ say, where they all just parrot each other. [STEP 5: reiterate these benefits are why ‘everyone is doing it’]

HER: Maybe, but I’m just not sure.

YOU: Look, didn’t we JUST see your friend Lucy go home with a guy tonight? What do you think they went home to do, play checkers? [STEP 6: show her examples of other people doing it]

HER: [laugh]

YOU: This is natural. This is what people do. People get attracted to each other, and they get together. They do not wait for some unspecified timer to go off that says, “Okay, enough time has passed! Now it is allowed!” There are not following the commands of some tiny minority of rigid influencers say.

HER: I guess you’re right.

YOU: You know I’m right [wink]. [make out; escalation continues]

When you build a properly fleshed out conformity frame like this, that busts up a girl’s preexisting conformity frame and installs a new one in her, you leave much less room for doubt that you are ‘manipulating’ her and make it much clearer that, in fact, the frame you’re pushing really IS what ‘everyone is doing’ – it is not just a thing that you’re saying to her.

 

Conformity Framing Is a Tool; It Is Not the Whole Seduction
Conformity framing relieves her of the fear that doing what you want is “not conforming.” But you still must seduce her in other ways, too.

One thing I want to point out here is that conformity framing is a tactic you can use; it is not the entire seduction in and of itself.

For instance, with the girl giving resistance to quick escalation, you have successfully reframed quick sex as the REAL thing that ‘everyone is doing’, which removes that objection from her to hooking up (“Oh, okay. This is accepted, actually. This is the normal thing that people do”).

However, if she still has other objections, you will need to handle those as well. If she doesn’t feel similar enough to you, aroused enough by you, you have not escalated compliance enough, etc., or has other points of resistance, you will need to handle those.

Conformity framing is a very useful tactic; just keep in mind that it is one tactic to be used in conjunction with the rest of your usual seduction repertoire. Treat it that way (rather than as  a magic pill to seduce girls all by itself) and you will find it helps you clear away obstacles that other tactics and approaches can have difficulty overcoming.

Chase Amante

Title: What to Do After Unprotected Sex | Girls Chase
content:
Things got a little too frisky and in a moment of passion you left protection aside. What steps should you take after the act to ensure you stay clean?

Hey guys. Welcome back.

Note: This post addresses the aftermath of unprotected sex, which is a scary experience for some individuals. If you are in this situation, please read this post; it is for you. The sooner you read it, the better off you will be.

In my two most recent posts, I covered the important and often uncomfortable subject of sexually transmitted infections (STIs), discussing what they are and how to prevent them. These posts contain valuable information beyond what is typically found on standard sex education websites. I cover methods such as PrEP, a medication that helps prevent HIV, as well as one that helps reduce contracting gonorrhea. Additionally, I highlight some lesser-known facts about various STIs. I encourage you to check out these posts for more insights.

In my opinion, a playboy must educate himself about STIs. It is important to understand them and learn how to prevent their transmission; condoms are just one of many tools at your disposal. Prevention methods not only safeguard your own health but also protect others. As a playboy, you increase your risk of exposure, putting others at risk as well. It is essential to master this knowledge for everyone’s safety.

Please remember that although I have written these posts, I am not a health care professional—just someone who has done considerable research. The purpose of these posts is to provide an overview of available information and help you understand your options. With this knowledge, you can consult your doctor or health care professional to discuss your best choices. Their expertise takes precedence over mine.

In this post, I will discuss the aftermath of unprotected sex. Say an accident happened; perhaps the condom broke, or you were swept up in the moment and forgot to protect yourself. Now, it’s the next day, and paranoia has set in. Regardless of how you’re feeling—anxious or indifferent—this guide will help you understand what steps to take next.

 

Forgetting the Condom: Am I Screwed?
It felt so good, but now you’re not sure it was the best decision…

It’s hard to predict whether unprotected sex will cause problems, as it depends on various factors. Diseases such as chlamydia and gonorrhea are common. If you engage in regular unprotected sex, your risk of contracting these infections is high.

However, these diseases are curable and typically do not lead to complications if treated. Therefore, it’s important to test yourself.

What about herpes and HPV? They are more of a nuisance than a serious threat. Protecting yourself against both can be challenging, aside from getting the HPV vaccine; see my post on STI prevention. There is not much you can do to shield yourself fully. While condoms can provide some level of protection, if a girl you have sex with has blisters that come in contact with an unprotected part of your penis, you still face a risk, even when using condoms. I usually do not think about herpes as it is somewhat beyond my control. However, I always make sure to avoid sex if I notice any blisters or sores.

What about nasty infections, like hepatitis C and syphilis? Both are serious diseases and can lead to life-threatening complications if not treated effectively. Fortunately, hepatitis C is now curable. The likelihood of contracting hepatitis C through sex (including anal sex) is relatively low, which is why STI clinics do not routinely test for it.

However, there is a risk for transmission if both partners experience bleeding during very rough sex if one partner is hepatitis C-positive. The transmission of hepatitis C through other body fluids is debatable. While I wouldn’t be overly concerned, it’s still advisable to get tested.

Syphilis is a severe infection that can lead to organ failure if left untreated. It is more contagious than hepatitis C. The good news is that syphilis is curable, so get tested and treated.

You should take all these infections seriously. Get tested and cured.

Most infections cannot be tested immediately due to an incubation period; test results usually won’t be positive right away. I will discuss this in detail shortly. There’s no need to worry, as serious damage does not occur instantly. It can take months or even years for complications to develop. For example, phase 2 syphilis causes severe damage about one year after exposure. However, the sooner it is treated, the better. Waiting an extra week before getting tested is okay, as this leads to more reliable results.

 

The HIV Scare
“How to know if you have HIV”

HIV is the infection that worries most individuals. It usually requires treatment for the rest of your life. However, since many get treated, the spread in heterosexual circles in developed countries is limited.

HIV can lead to feelings of panic. You may find yourself googling to determine if you are okay or checking the odds of how transmittable and contagious it is. This can be overwhelming. The reality is that most statistics are averages and may not reflect your situation. The likelihood of contracting HIV depends on several factors: where penetration occurs, whether you are circumcised, if your partner is on medication (which can significantly lower the risk, often close to zero), if her viral load is high (it can be particularly high if she just contracted the virus), and whether either of you has another STI, such as chlamydia.

STIs like gonorrhea and chlamydia significantly increase your chance of contracting HIV if you have sexual contact with someone who is HIV-positive. These infections can facilitate the transmission of HIV. To reduce risk, ensure that you do not have bacterial STIs such as chlamydia, gonorrhea, or syphilis. Make it a priority to get tested regularly and get treatment when necessary.

Here’s a fact sheet about transmission rates.

As you can see, unless you are being reckless, your odds as a heterosexual man are low. Receptive partners, which include women and many gay men, are more at risk. Remember that the risk is still there, and all it takes is a girl on her period who recently contracted HIV. She may have a high viral load and be very contagious. Your chance of catching infections is much higher.

Your odds of being exposed to HIV-positive women increase if you live in an area with a high prevalence of HIV.

If you are taking PrEP (a preventive treatment against HIV) as prescribed by your health care provider, the odds are nearly zero. While there have been rare instances of PrEP failures, these are usually due to patients not following the treatment properly. See this article.

You can calculate and speculate as much as you like, but it will only cause undue stress.

If you catch a cold, you may tell yourself you have it. You may google “signs of HIV” and “symptoms,” but, likely, you don’t have HIV. Symptoms are not a reliable indicator of HIV.

GET TESTED. It’s as simple as that. I will cover STI testing in my next post, but briefly, it’s best to get tested after six weeks. Ask for a fourth-generation test. This tests reliably for both antibodies and antigens (p24).

If you are very worried, you can call an HIV hotline and speak with an expert. They can provide information and help assess your situation, which may help calm your nerves. Alternatively, visit a clinic and get a preliminary test after two to three weeks; this can give you a decent indicator of whether you may have HIV. However, you should repeat the test after four weeks for more accurate results. A test conducted six weeks after your potential exposure will give a reliable result with close to 100% accuracy.

 

PEP: Day-After Pills for HIV
If you did not plan ahead, there are still ways to cut your risk.

Many people are not aware that there is a day-after pill for HIV. In most developed countries, you can access post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), which is an anti-retroviral treatment that significantly reduces your chances of contracting HIV if exposed to the virus. While some studies debate its effectiveness, many agree that PEP can reduce the risk of infection by over 80% when used as prescribed. See this article.       

To maximize its effectiveness. You must take the treatment within 72 hours of exposure, ideally within 24 hours. The prescribing authority varies by location. In some countries, general practitioners prescribe it; this may not be the case in others. Also, your local hospital emergency room may provide PEP.

Before you rejoice, there is a catch to PEP. It is a 28-day treatment of powerful anti-retroviral medication. While it is certainly better than contracting HIV, the treatment can be challenging. It can be expensive, and your insurance may not cover the costs.

Typically, a doctor will evaluate your situation to determine if PEP is appropriate. They often prescribe doses for the first few days to get you started. They will schedule a follow-up appointment with an infectious disease specialist to reassess your situation and decide whether you should continue the treatment. They will also monitor your health for the next two to three months.

You cannot rely on PEP as a preventive measure. Instead, consider PrEP, which has significantly fewer side effects. PrEP can be taken before and after sex and requires only four pills over three days. For more, refer to my previous article. Here is a valuable resource about PrEP.

If you have sex with a riskier group, consider this option. This includes having sex with a woman who is a sex worker or drug user, including snorters.

It can be difficult to assess whether a woman is in a risk group or not and whether you are at risk. In those cases, your best bet is to call an HIV hotline, talk to your doctor, or your hospital emergency room. Avoid the 911 emergency number, as it is not a matter of life and death.

 

Questionable Advice
Does cleaning up after sex help? Well, it can’t hurt.

Below are some disputable tips and tricks that may be helpful, but remember that none are scientifically proven. I see no harm in trying them as long as you also get tested and do not substitute them for legitimate protection methods, such as condoms, PrEP, and vaccines.

One is to urinate after sex. This is a good idea, as it may flush out potential bacteria that could cause urinary tract infections. Whether this can help flush out chlamydia and other bacterial STIs is questionable. To my knowledge, there is no scientific evidence to prove it.

The same goes for post-sex showers and general clean-up. In theory, this should help. However, it is not scientifically proven to help mitigate STIs.

I mention both because men often discuss this advice, and I see it pop up in discussions about STIs on forums.

And this does make sense. I doubt there is any harm in peeing and cleaning up after sex for general hygiene.

I prefer to wash after sex. It’s a personal preference.

 

Parting Words
If you had unplanned unprotected sex, be sure to get tested after to make sure you picked nothing up.

If you have unprotected sex, it is crucial to assess whether you are exposed to something serious like HIV and act quickly. Contact a medical professional within 72 hours to determine if you should take PEP to decrease your chance of contracting a virus.

Other STIs, aside from hepatitis B, are curable. However, hepatitis B has a vaccine available. With hepatitis B out of the way, you can chill out and remain calm.

The other STIs are a nonissue as long as you get tested. The exception is herpes. However, herpes is very common, usually not dangerous, and is technically not considered an STI. It is more of a nuisance. If you want to know more about herpes, I have dedicated two posts where I discuss it in depth, including how to live with it and how to date while having it to avoid spreading it to others. If you fear herpes or struggle with it, please read these posts; they will help:

Dating with Herpes, Pt. 1: Dating Strategies
Dating with Herpes, Pt. 2: Relationships

The next step is to get tested. You can read about how to do that in my article on testing for STIs (link below).

Stay safe.

Best,

Alek
