Seducers don’t even exist much in societies where the men have not collectively decided to liberate their women – it is the average man liberating his woman that leads to a surge in the seducer population.

Superior men recognize that seduction is a master-able skill, that mastery over it will improve their lives, and that they can do it while still excelling in other areas and contributing to the world. A man must have a certain level of excellence to be able to set pride aside and examine problems a different way; a certain freedom to not go with the same flow as every other man.

Pablo Picasso was almost as famous for picking up much younger women as he was for painting.

Seduction is a field full of men of superior ability and character.

It is a field that hones a man’s superiority, too.

So: come on in, and make yourself into a better version of YOU.

Chase Amante

Title: Peacocking with a Wingman, Friends, or Girls | Girls Chase
content:
It looks funny to go out peacocked when your crew’s not dressed accordingly. Just how peacocked do your wingmen, friends, and wingwomen need to be, though?

Hey guys and welcome.

Over the past three weeks, I have been discussing the art of peacocking. This night game strategy involves dressing in a bold and flashy manner to catch women’s attention. The goal is to make yourself noticeable, even getting women to approach and initiate conversation with you.

Peacocking offers many benefits when executed properly. However, if done incorrectly, it can backfire, making you appear foolish and clown-like. For more details, see my post from two weeks ago.

Getting all this attention, although beneficial, is not without its cons, and we should also consider the drawbacks. In my previous post, I covered how peacocking affects your game and how you should strategize accordingly.

Today, I want to expand on last week’s post, which primarily discussed solo outings, which experienced night gamers often prefer. While many guys enjoy going out with wingmen (a topic I covered in a series last year), others prefer going out with friends.

Who you are out with and how they dress will determine your peacocking success or failure. So, it is crucial to strategize.

I will begin by discussing the effects peacocking has when going out with a wing, the implications of going out with several friends, and what to expect when going out with only girls.

 

Peacocking with a Wing

What I am about to discuss is often overlooked. By understanding this, you will already be ahead of the curve.

A general rule of nightlife is that you are only as strong as the weakest link. Suppose you dress as a dashing, fashionable guy, but your wing dresses like crap. He will negatively affect your results. The obvious reason is that if your wing dresses poorly, he reflects badly on you by association. Others will see him with you as your friend and judge you accordingly.

This effect is even worse when you peacock. It’s due to the extreme contrast between you and your sloppily-dressed friend. You look showy and stylish; he does not. It makes him look worse than if you were dressing normally. The worst part is that because you are only as strong as your weakest link, venue-goers perceive him as looking bad, which reflects negatively on you.

Lastly, it looks odd and suspicious. You dress to impress, and your friend does not. It looks questionable. Women see red flags when something feels questionable. It generates an incongruence for them.

Remember, when peacocking, congruence is essential, as discussed last week. If you dress in an outrageous and flamboyant way, people associate that with a particular social identity, perhaps as with a fashion or music community. Your friend clashes with this notion. How does that affect your congruence? Negatively, because it is the opposite of your expressed social frame. You are expressing X persona with your edgy outfit, but your wing’s outfit is a mess, resulting in incongruence. Not good.

So, what should you do? The options are obvious, but you need to act:

Fix your wingman. Take him shopping and help him correct his style. He may not feel comfortable dressing as outrageously as you but improving his style selections will help you both. Make a trade-off: he dresses better, and you tone down your outfit. This way, you both become two stylishly dressed men and avoid appearing incongruent when out together.

Change your wingman. If he is a friend, do not dump him because of this, but consider other activities you two can do together rather than clubbing. He may be a good mate, but he may not be a good club mate.

Do not peacock when out with this particular wingman. However, if he dresses badly, you need to fix this.

Whenever I go out with guys, I call and check what they are wearing. I want to get a sense of the styles they will be displaying alongside me. Sometimes, I give suggestions, then adjust my attire to calibrate to what they are wearing.

 

Folie à Deux
Make yourselves a killer pair.

The truth is that two well-dressed men together are lethal. It removes any questions about congruence, and your overall presence is stronger. When your wing looks good, he reinforces you. You look good, reinforcing him, so you become a stunning combo together. Two perfectly dressed men are deadly. Two peacocked men are even more deadly. You show that your style is intentional and that you have awesome friends. Immediate social value!

A key advantage is that you can take things more slowly when out. Last week I mentioned that being seen alone in-field while peacocking is death to your social value. This holds true here, too, although less so, because you have each other. However, it can only buy you some time; you must eventually approach or get approached. Fortunately, it is easier when you are two dashing guys.

It helps if you both have a similar style. It adds another layer of power. It makes your style appear thought out and congruent, adding sophistication. It’s another good reason to phone before heading out with a wing to ask what he is wearing. Then, calibrate accordingly. I often send pictures of my outfit, and my wing sends pictures, and we agree on clothing choices.

With my wing Pelusita, we sometimes like to use sequins. If he wears sequins, so do I. If he does not, then I won’t. If I do, it comes off as weird at worst, or at best I get all the attention, which is not ideal for wingman dynamics.

I usually would dress in younger outfits—flashy bombers, for example. With Razorjack, who was older (past 45), this could appear “off” when he wore classier clothes, like suits. So, I would calibrate by wearing a purple velvet blazer, black V-neck, and black jeans with boots. It looked cool and congruent. We matched.

Don’t forget to calibrate with your wing; it’s crucial.

It is also good to have a theme—a world you can your wing build upon. Try for a specific brand. It allows you to create a bubble where you can bring women inside.

 

Peacocking with a Group
Don’t make yourself the odd one out.

Sometimes, you may want to go out with a group of friends. Remember, you are only as strong as your weakest link here as well. If you are only socializing, this may not be a concern. However, if your goal is to succeed with women, it definitely matters. So, be mindful of who you go out with. I have discussed this topic in detail here: How to Pick Who to Go Out with to Nightlife

However, it is unlikely that all your friends will peacock. Thus, I do not advise peacocking when out with many people. You will appear as the odd one in the group.

Dress cool and edgy, perhaps wearing a cool accessory, but tone it down.

I have peacocked when out with a large group of people, and it was successful, mainly because I was out with two gay friends who dressed exceptionally well. One works in fashion, while the other is a connector in the LGBTQ crowd. They would bring along two amazing, stylish girls. One in our group was a former Miss Trans France, with a flamboyant, edgy style. Even surrounded by such fashionable friends, I would tone down my look to fit in better. Together, we would easily conquer Parisian clubs in no time. However, this strategy wouldn’t work as well in more selective clubs like Silencio, which attract a certain celebrity and fashion-oriented crowd; most people there dress quite edgy.

The general rule is when going out with many people, dress cool but tone it down.

 

When Out with Only Women

You should not have issues going out with women unless it’s with only one girl. I do not recommend that. Why? If your goal is to pull her, why go to a club? And why draw attention to yourself, including from other men? Don’t use your clothing as an excuse for men to approach you when interacting one-on-one with your girl.

However, going out with multiple girls is always great, especially if they give you room to do your own thing. Flashy AND surrounded by girls! You are in for a good night with many options. It’s pickup on easy mode!

Make sure you position yourself in the middle of the action so everyone can see you with the girls, and you are the man. Nothing to worry about here. Out with girls? Peacock!

Most girls dress well when they go out. You will be judged less harshly if they dress poorly than if you were out with a guy.

The bottom line is to go for it.

 

When Out with Only Men

I touched on this last week. Men will try to tool you when you peacock. It attracts as much male as female attention. This is strange to me. Why do men go nuts over my outfit? It may be instinctual. I haven’t reflected much about this.

 

New Male Friends

Some men are not ill-intended and may come up to you and seem nice.

But do not hang with them if they are dressed poorly and do not have a good presence. The same rule applies here: you are always as strong as the weakest link. Hang out too long with some nice dudes, and people will assume you are friends and out together. If one guy happens to dress poorly, others will drag you down with him, so be careful.

Some guys will jump on you; some will be nice. Remember, if you are peacocking, you are likely out with a specific intent, not to make male friends. Remember the goal.

Going out to make friends is okay, but do you need to peacock for that?

If guys come over and you want to chat, that’s fine, but break it off sooner rather than later. You will be associated with them as time goes by.

These guys will come up to you again the moment you start chatting with women and become real disturbances. Since he was nice, and you had a good vibe, it is challenging to get rid of him, since the frame is that you two are friends now. And you don’t tell your friends to get lost.

 

Peacocking in Isolation

It is okay to peacock while talking to girls. It lets the venue observe you talking with women, translating into social proof. This is desirable.

When you find a girl you like, and the hook is solid, isolate and escalate the vibe. During isolation, remove as much of the peacock as you can or try to isolate yourself from the public’s watchful eyes as much as possible.

The reason is straightforward: men can use your flashy outfit to enter and disturb you while in isolation. You do not want that to happen. Wearing a flashy jacket? Take it off while in isolation.

If you are making out or being physical with a girl, you do not want the room to know. You do not want her to feel observed, which can trigger resistance. You also do not want to lose your chance with the other women in the venue if this does not work out. The moment you make an overt move with a girl in front of other girls, chances are, those other women will auto-reject. No woman wants to feel like Plan B. It is best they do not know that you had something going on with a girl before engaging them.

 

Parting Words
Take it from the peacock itself: big & bright displays attract!

This concludes my series on peacocking. I shared nearly everything I know about the subject. I have historically always been a fan of it. I enjoy the advantages and dynamics it provides.

It may seem like there is much to think about when peacocking. It’s true to some extent. It is not an easy technique to pull off. However, once mastered, it is potent.

I mean, it is really potent. In 2019, the year I peacocked the most, some guys on a PUA chat asked me how I opened women. My response was a picture of my sequin jacket. This showcases just how powerful peacocking can be.

But it can be tiresome at times. If so, don’t peacock that particular night. That’s fine. 2023 was the year I peacocked the least. I would wear Adidas classics, black jeans, and a white or black T-shirt topped with a floral shirt. I spiced things up with a cool necklace. It’s a cool style but not overly peacocked: no red boots with higher heels, no sequin jackets or fur coats, or latex or nylon jackets with colored sunglasses.

The dynamic was different and more chill. I like that, too.

But when I want to go full flashy and play the social game, I go all in.

Best,

Alek

Title: What Daters Need to Know About Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs) | Girls Chase
content:
There’s plenty of misinformation around STIs in the dating scene. How serious are they truly? What really are the risks? In this guide, we get to the facts.

Disclaimer: This post is about a medical subject, and the information presented is from the author’s knowledge and experience. The author is NOT a medical doctor or a health care professional. It is important to verify this information with a health care provider, preferably a specialist in dermatology and infectious diseases. This information is meant to help you understand the subject better, but it does not replace professional medical advice.

This post is from late 2024. Research may have advanced with the knowledge shared here. To stay current, consult specialists in infectious diseases.

Hey guys. I hope you are doing well.

In this article and the next, I will discuss the not-so-pleasant topic of sexually transmitted infections (STIs), formerly known as sexually transmitted diseases (STDs).

But it is a crucial topic concerning sexual health. I have been discussing this frequently on forums, and it baffles me how little even some of the more experienced guys understand about STIs.

Today, I will share basic information and tips regarding STIs. I want to acknowledge that fears about STIs are valid and should not be taken lightly. My goal is to provide details to help you stay safe while offering a nuanced perspective.

I will present information from discussions with health care professionals and specialists, and personal research. Please remember that I am not a doctor, so it is always important to consult with a medical professional for expert advice.

This post is likely to be read by guys who may have engaged in activities that resulted in an infection. While this post will provide valuable details for prevention, it can still be helpful, even if it is too late. There are still steps you can take to address the situation.

In our society, we usually face two extremes: those who exaggerate the implications of STIs (it’s a death sentence) and other who trivialize it (just take antibiotics; the odds of getting something are low). Both are wrong, in my opinion.

Here is the truth

We must weigh fact against both dismissal and hyperbole.

STIs are less dangerous than we might believe if one tests, treats, or cures themselves.

STIs are far more dangerous than we might believe if one does not test, treat, or cure themselves.

What is my line of reasoning? Take chlamydia, for example, a bacterial STI that is frequent and relatively transmissible. In theory, all you have to do to test is to pee in a cup. What are the symptoms? They are usually benign if, any. Treatment? It used to be two pills of azithromycin, an antibiotic; however, most doctors now prescribe 7-10 days of doxycycline, another antibiotic. And it is over.

Is getting chlamydia no big deal? Well, not so fast. In some cases (although rare), untreated chlamydia can lead to complications and spread to the kidneys. What is the hassle, then?

Chlamydia and other minor infections can open the floodgate to more serious diseases such as HIV and hepatitis B and C. These infections can increase the transmission rate sevenfold! While HIV is not easily transmitted, several factors can contribute to its spread. When you consider the increased risk, the likelihood of transmission becomes much greater. Oops.

In rare cases, untreated chlamydia can lead to sterility. This is more likely with women. Do you really want to put your girls at such risk?

As you can see, a minor STI can be a significant concern.

But what about serious STIs? HIV is a serious disease, but did you know with proper treatment, you can have the same life expectancy as the general population? HIV is not necessarily life-threatening. After some time, you may no longer be contagious when you receive treatment. A specialist will sample your blood regularly to check if the treatment works and let you know when you are not contagious.

Yes, you may take pills every day, but it is not much worse than diabetes or other chronic diseases. There are many treatments, and they often function well. You may find a treatment that suits you with few side effects.

So, getting treatment is often less of a big deal than we think. The stigma from the 80s and 90s still persists.

Just to be clear, I am not minimizing anything. Having a serious STI will still affect your life drastically, and not for the better. But it is not a death sentence.

But if you are not tested and treated, it is a death sentence (you will get AIDS). And if you remain untested and untreated, you put others at risk, and in many countries, it’s punishable by law.

Although I am providing the basics about STIs, the best path to good and safe sex is PROTECTION and TESTING, TESTING, TESTING.

A good resource for STI details: https://www.aidsmap.com/

It pays to be informed.

This is a website about HIV with the latest information about research and treatments. In addition, they have plenty of information about other STIs. You can also check the public health authority’s website and search for STIs, like the CDC if you want the straight facts.

I strongly urge you to discuss your STI concerns with your doctor. If you are sexually active or plan to be, it is your responsibility, both for you and the girls.

 

Types of STIs

Below is a list of common STIs with CDC links that provide basic info, treatments, and symptoms. I recommend you familiarize yourself with these basics. You can find more details on your local health authority’s website. I will add notes, including lesser-known but useful information.

 

Common and Highly Transmissible STIs

Through penetration

Chlamydia: About Chlamydia

Gonorrhea: About Gonorrhea

Mycoplasma: About Mycoplasma genitalium

The following applies to all the above (similar diseases, although gonorrhea usually has the most severe symptoms and tends to be more symptomatic). However, there is a strain of chlamydia that can be hardcore).

People rarely test for mycoplasma. Many EU countries stopped testing for it unless symptoms are present. You may request a test; I recommend it.

Mycoplasma is highly transmissible through vaginal and anal sex. It’s less transmissible through oral sex (especially when performing oral sex on women). It is more transmissible when giving head to a guy, although less common).

Treatment: Curable unless you get a rare but resistant strain. Then, treatment can take longer and be difficult to treat, but you will likely be fine.

Consequences: It can lead to potentially serious complications if left untreated. This can increase the chance of catching serious infections like HIV.

Symptoms: Mycoplasma does not always show symptoms. Get tested if you have had unprotected sex.

 

Through contact

 

HPV (warts): https://www.cdc.gov/hpv/index.html

Transmission: very contagious via contact but does not always cause warts. Not all forms of HPV are dangerous, and not all cause warts.

Symptoms: Some strains cause warts; some increase the chance of throat cancer and, in rare cases, penile cancer. See a doctor to mitigate severe consequences.

Treatment: Surgical, like freezing, burning, or cutting with a razor. It can also go away on its own, but it can take time. Leaving it be is not recommended. See a dermatologist.

HSV (Herpes): https://www.cdc.gov/herpes/about/index.html

Transmission: Transmissible through contact with an open sore. Having HSV does not protect against reinfection by a different strain. If you see a sore or blister, stop sexual activity. It is always transmissible but less likely when in remission (when symptoms are gone).

Symptoms: Redness or blisters eventually form into a sore on the lip, mouth, or pubic areas (including anus for those who are receptive). HSV may cause flu-like symptoms. The first flare-up tends to be the worst; subsequent flare-ups are shorter and less painful. Flare-ups generally last for one to five weeks, sometimes less than a week, if a flare-up is treated early.

Treatment: HSV is not curable but easily treatable. There are many options. I recommend valacyclovir (over acyclovir) in pill form. This also works for oral herpes. In my experience, the side effects of the atopic cream are insignificant. You can get this over the counter. Talk to your doctor.

 

Less Common but Highly Transmissible
It might be old and rarer but is still dangerous.

Syphilis:

Transmittable via penetration and contact with blister and sores.

Prevalence: Rare in heterosexual circles, more prevalent in LGBTQ+ circles, although not an epidemic.

Transmission: Transmissible through all forms of penetration, including oral.

Treatment: Easily curable with several antibiotic injections.

Symptoms: Syphilis has different phases. You may experience sores, rashes, or a fever during the first phase. This phase typically has the most noticeable symptoms. Just because these symptoms fade does not mean you are syphilis-free. If you are experiencing symptoms, it's important to get tested.

Long-term consequences: Although curable, syphilis can cause severe damage if left untreated, potentially leading to organ failure. Get tested and treated. If you have pronounced symptoms, you will likely know something is wrong. Having syphilis significantly increases the risk of contracting other diseases, like HIV, due to the open sores syphilis causes.

 

Less Common but Not as Transmissible
Get tested. It’s important.

How common these STIs are depends on the prevalence of the disease where you live. HIV is less common in Western Europe compared to South Africa or certain areas in Russia.

Transmissibility can vary. HIV has a low transmission rate. However, not all cases are the same. Different strains affect the transmission rate. It also depends on the form of penetration. Anal sex is more transmissible, and oral sex is more of a theoretical risk. Other factors affect this, like how rough the sex is, as irritation and sores increase transmission, the viral load of an infected individual, and whether one of the partners has an STI, such as chlamydia, syphilis, or gonorrhea. For a breakdown, see Estimated HIV risk per exposure

These STIs are serious and often chronic. This is always the case for HIV, and often with hepatitis B, rarely for hepatitis C (if treated).

HIV: About HIV

Treatment: Uncurable but treatable. There are plenty of options for efficient treatments.

Symptoms: Flu-like symptoms are common during the acute phase, the early phase of infection, usually three to five weeks after exposure. Symptoms may dissipate. Although rare, HIV does not always show symptoms. Note that symptoms vary. Do not rely on symptoms to determine whether you have the virus, as this may not be an accurate indicator. If you think you’ve been exposed or may have HIV, see your doctor or a specialist and get tested. Testing is the only reliable measure to know. It’s essential to point out because it is easy to panic after having unprotected sex. I have been tested often, and it has always been something minor, like a cold. Whether a rash is a symptom of HIV or caused by hives, stress, acne, or something else, to know for sure, get tested.

Long-term consequences: HIV is a serious disease and can turn severe if left untreated. You can get AIDS. Currently, the treatment is efficient and usually well-tolerated.

Transmission: HIV is much less contagious if treated. If the viral load reaches zero (undetectable) and no virus is detectable in your bloodstream, you cannot transmit it. Having sex with a treated “undetectable” carrier of the virus is not considered an exposure. Thus, there is little risk sleeping with a positive individual if that person has received the green light from a doctor. However, I would still be cautious as there are no guarantees that the person is telling the truth. But if the person is, you are not considered at risk, medically speaking. For more details, see Undetectable viral load and HIV transmission

Treatment: There are many ways to prevent HIV. I will get to that next week.

Hepatitis B: Hepatitis B Basics

Treatment: Uncurable but treatable. Hepatitis B requires close monitoring by a specialist. Because an effective vaccine is available, research on this disease is limited.

Symptoms: Symptoms of hepatitis B can include dark urine and jaundice, which may develop a few months after transmission during the acute phase. However, symptoms are not always present, making them an unreliable indicator of whether you have hepatitis B. If you experience symptoms, it's important to get checked, as they are signs of liver issues.

Long-term consequences: Hepatitis B is a serious disease that can become very serious if untreated. It requires close monitoring by a specialist.

Transmission: Hepatitis B is much less contagious if treated. A lower viral load means less chance of transmission.

Hepatitis C:

Transmission: This is one STI that is unlikely to be spread sexually. Hepatitis C is primarily a blood-to-blood transmitted disease. In some cases, where infected blood comes into contact with an uninfected person via open sores, it can be transmitted.

Symptoms: See hepatitis B.

Testing: Test for hepatitis B if offered. Not all clinics test for it. I would still test for it at least once a year.

Treatment: Currently, no vaccine is available, but there is promising news. A new and effective antiviral treatment has been introduced, with a success rate of 95% or higher after one to two months of use. While the treatment is expensive and health insurance may not cover the costs, most Western countries with public health care may provide access to it, though it might not be free. Consult your doctor for more information.

 

Others

Mononucleosis: About Infectious Mononucleosis (Mono)

Note: Technically, “mono” is not an STI, but it is very common to catch it when hooking up with girls. It is highly contagious.

Transmission: Mono is very transmissible via kissing. However, you usually get it once and become immunized. And you likely already caught it as a child.

Treatment: Medicine is generally not given as it passes, but mono can linger for some time.

Symptoms: Mono causes throat pain, fatigue, swollen lymph nodes, and a swollen liver.

Long-term consequences: Follow your doctor’s orders, get rest, and no booze. Mono can potentially be dangerous if you stress your liver.

Testing: Mono is easy to test for, but it is not usually done at STI clinics. Go to your general practitioner. You do not need to test regularly for it; you only need to do so if you get symptoms.

 

Parting Words
Be aware, stay tested, get treated, and preserve your health (and ability to seduce).

I realize that STIs are not fun to discuss. But knowing about them can both help you and your partners physically to protect from potentially dangerous diseases and help you mentally to calm your nerves.

In my experience, there are types two types of men: those who do not care and those who are ultra-careful.

The guys who do not care may end up in unnecessary trouble. Most of the people I know who are HIV-positive may not have contracted HIV if they had received the proper information ahead of time. Sadly, the constant scaremongering also scares people in high-risk groups from seeking medical help. I believe it is better to have a nuanced view and understand that STIs should be taken seriously but also can be prevented and dealt with.

This post and my next post are for the other type of man. I am in this latter group: the ultra-careful, paranoid guy. But this, too, can be harmful to mental health. I have always been scared of STIs, especially the serious ones. Acquiring the necessary knowledge has helped calm my nerves. I know the facts about these diseases, how to prevent them, and how they work. This knowledge has helped me feel safer. If you are one of the anxious ones, these posts are also for you.

Next week, we will discuss prevention. You will learn the different ways you can protect yourself and others. I will mention condoms, but there are other methods to protect yourself that you may not know about, which you can discuss with your doctor.

These posts will benefit you, so stay tuned.

Best,

Alek

Title: Why Simping Behavior Evolved in Men | Girls Chase
content:
Male simping is ridiculously counterproductive. It wastes the males time and gets him nowhere with girls. So how on Earth did this behavior evolve?

For years the behavior of male simping has bewildered me.

I’ve felt like a naturalist in the field observing a bizarre and incomprehensible ritual whose object is hidden to him. Why do men do it? What is the drive? What ends do they hope to achieve? Why do they believe this will work? Is there any conscious awareness involved in those who simp, or do they act purely on instinct, driven by impulse?

Even when I was a lonely, desperate kid who just wanted a girl more than anything in the world, I’d never have lowered myself to the idiocy you can find all over the Internet:

Men endlessly praising women

Men spending heaps of money on women

Men professing their intense, undying love for women

Men doing this PUBLICLY, and even COMPETING to do it

Finally: this behavior is almost exclusively reserved for women these men DO NOT KNOW (very, very few men simp like this over women they actually know well)

A friend of mine who ran a cam girls app (and made a lot of money doing it) maintained monthly public leaderboards for the men who contributed the most money to girls (as ‘gifts’ – which the app company got a cut of, needless to say. It’s how he got rich). Guys would spend $50K-$200K per month on gifts for women, whom they’d never meet or sleep with, at least in part to get the ‘feather in their cap’ of being at the top of what I’m just going to call the ‘simp leaderboard’.

This behavior is epidemic. Yet while it is clearly defective behavior in the modern dating world (especially once you mix digital scale into the mix), it must have SOME function.

Whenever you see a highly common behavior, you are looking at something that has proved reproductively successful in the past. No matter how ineffective it might look now.

The question we have to ask then is what are the circumstances under which simping leads to reproductive success?

 

The Ultimate Simps
Artcite and Palamon battle for Emilia

I have gan to rede (began to read, in Middle English) Geoffrey Chaucer’s Canterbury Tales for the first time. The edition I have has about a page of Middle English followed by the Modern English translation. I’m enjoying seeing how many of the Middle English words I can decipher before reaching the Modern English equivalent. I have also picked up a little Middle English: ‘woot’ means ‘think’ or ‘know’, while ‘wood’ means ‘mad’ or ‘insane’. ‘Pleasure’ in Middle English is the delightful (and French-sounding) ‘pleasaunce’. I was stumped at ‘thentree’ until I read it translated as ‘the entrance’ (i.e., ‘the entry’), at which point it made a lot more sense.

Anyway, the first story in Canterbury Tales is “The Knight’s Tale”, a story about two matchless ancient Greek simps, Arcite and his cousin Palamon. The tl;dr is the two cousins were royalty, imprisoned forever after Theseus of Athens conquered their city (that way they could not lead an army against him). Then one day they both saw a beautiful maid – the sister of Theseus’s wife Hippolyta, named Emilia. Emilia was Theseus’s ward.

(interesting sidenote: the backstory is that the women of Scythia went full feminist, rebelled against the men, elected Hippolyta as queen, and Theseus decided he was having none of that, so invaded, conquered Scythia, and forcibly took the Scythians’ queen as his bride. From feminist icon to war bride – quite a journey for Hippolyta!)

The cousins both fell madly in love for Emilia, spent years pining for this woman they’d never spoken to, wished to die rather than not be with her, and ultimately ended up locked in a battle to the death for who would get her (still without either of them ever having met her) after escaping prison before Theseus arrived, found them, broke the fight up, the men confessed who they were and what they were doing, and professed their undying love for Emilia and how happy they’d be even to just be executed in front of her (lol). Theseus decided to spare them as two fools in love.

Theseus then decided that since both were royalty, wealthy in their own rights, and worthy men, they’d both make suitable brides for Emilia (who witnessed them fighting over her but had actually never even seen them before in her life), but of course only one could marry her. So they’d need to pass a final Simp Test, that I will not spoil for you (I haven’t finished the story yet either, so I don’t know who wins, or what twist or turn there is. Chaucer has a lot of twists and turns… he’s a wonderful writer).

As I read this story about these two idiots, I of course kept saying to myself, “You’re royalty, you dumb fools. Just return to your city and have your pick of the litter from the women there! Surely there’s one at least as beautiful as Emilia, or more so.” But no – for something like 10 years, both in prison and out of it, these men have eyes only for Emilia and go to all kinds of ridiculous lengths simply to be close to her.

READ MORE: Can't Stop Thinking About Her? Here's Why You Need to Meet More Girls

Meet some more girls, brother.

In the end though, it seems like it worked (barring any tragic or comedic twists at the end of the tale, which I have not reached): the ruler was impressed by their besottedness with Emilia, and, rating them as suitable matches for his ward, decided one of them will get to marry her.

Could that be the key to simping?

Is it as simple as this: that it is a strategy not designed to win over the woman, but to win over the adult(s) whose charge she’s in?

 

The Worst Simps Come from Arranged Marriage Societies

Everybody on Earth knows Arab and Indian men are most atrocious simps in the universe.

Obviously, there are cool Arab and Indian dudes. Plenty of exceptions to the rule.

But of the guys who simp, none are more egregious and shameless about it than these men. They turn simping into an art form. A pathetic, cringeworthy art form – but an art form nonetheless.

Their simping tends to be:

Filled with endless praises

Offers to provide material comfort

Professions of their intense, undying love

All done very publicly

All done on women they do not know whatsoever (and usually only have ‘access’ to via the Internet)

Sometimes their simping turns lurid (“show bobs and vegana pls”). That’s one wrinkle; the detail that doesn’t make sense for this hypothesis. I can’t imagine many women’s guardians being overly impressed with sordid sexual come-ons.

Anyway, even if a man is super low IQ and EQ, there’s got to be some part of him that realizes there is zero chance of him ever getting what he wants through simping (even the ‘normal’ simping, not the sordid sexual kind). So what is this behavior for?

If it is to display to a parent (or other guardian) his loyalty, besottedness, willingness to provide, and willingness to be PUBLIC about his devotion (thus holding himself accountable among others in society), these are the kinds of things that will impress a parent/guardian into suggesting the man as a match.

Further: the man does not need to know the woman for this to work. Attracting her, building trust with her, getting to know her – all that is superfluous. All he has to do is convince the family/guardians that he is the most suitable match and he gets the girl.

Perhaps it is no coincidence that the Middle East and India have the most arranged marriages, and also the most extreme simping. Perhaps it is simply that men in these societies, rather than attempt to seduce the woman, attempt to impress the family instead – the same way Arcite and Palamon impressed Theseus into giving one of them Emilia without ever having seduced her herself.

If this is in fact a behavior that evolved to secure mates via impressing the woman’s family, rather than the woman directly herself, suddenly it seems to look like a much more effective strategy.

 

Simps vs. Seducers: Who Really Wins?

Everyone, after all, has read the stories or watched the movies about women in love with one man whose families have arranged for them to marry another. This plot is everywhere, particularly in older stories (this happens a lot less in the 21st Century West, where families have far less influence over who marries whom than they used to, and where today ‘love marriage’ is the standard).

If a woman is in love with one man (i.e., a man who has seduced her), but her family wants her to marry another (i.e., a man who has proven himself to them), who gets her? Who actually gets to pump babies up into her and pass on his genes?

In the 21st Century West, obviously that would be the seducer.

But in the past? Often it is going to be the simp.

… and all her relations approved.

It’s clear from reading a lot of old materials that women generally followed their families’ decisions. If the family wants her to marry Mr. Simp, she is not usually going to run off with Mr. Seducer for a life of uncertainty and potential abandonment if he decides to leave her at some point (with her family now unwilling to take her back too, and Mr. Simp having married someone else). She is most likely to play it safe and just marry Mr. Simp.

In a society where families have little-to-no influence over which man a woman marries, however; one in which women are liberated and no longer ‘wards’ of anyone but their own hearts’ desires, simping is a maladaptive behavior.

You can work around genetically ingrained behaviors, of course; but you can’t just switch them off.

A behavior that’s been rewarded generation after generation with reproductive success is not just going to disappear. It will live on, embedded in the DNA of its modern inheritors – not working so well in our world today, but awaiting a shift in culture that will enable the simps to rise once again.

 

Rise of the Simps

You might think I’m kidding when I say the simps will rise again.

I am not kidding.

The simps will rise.

If you’re an American and your understanding of history begins at the American Revolution (or the landing of the Mayflower or what have you), history can seem linear, like a long series of ‘progress’ until you reach the society of today.

But read farther back – the history of Europe, of Byzantium, of Rome, of Greece; learn about the Islamic Caliphates and the thousands of years of Dynastic China; read about the rise and fall of the dynasties of ancient Mesopotamia – and you will discover that society cycles again and again through predictable stages at roughly predictable intervals.

Just as pickup artists ran the streets of Rome and Carthage two millennia ago, they had their time today, but it will not always be thus. Sooner or later, society closes back up, women become cloistered and protected, and simps hold much more power in the sexual marketplace.

It almost seems absurd to say it, I know; these dudes are so pathetic, so cringeworthy, it’s hard to imagine this behavior ever leading to anything for them. But in societies where the parents or guardians have a lot of say over which man a woman marries, I suspect simping is often a winning strategy, even if it’s totally ass-backwards and retardedly useless in a society like ours of sexually liberated women.

 

Women’s Friends and Relatives Prefer Safe Men for Her

In my article about impressing and amazing your girlfriend’s family, I recommended you switch off your ‘seductive bad boy’ persona around them and pull on your ‘consummate gentleman and delightful guest’ persona. Your girl will know it’s a bit of an act (which will only make her even more smitten with you – chicks dig men with high social savvy); meanwhile her family is going to think she’s “found a really good guy” in you.

There’s a fascinating study confirming this (I don’t remember which one now; I cite it somewhere in One Date & The Dating Artisan), finding that women given the choice to choose men for both themselves and their girlfriends choose SAFER men for their girlfriends but RISKIER men for themselves.

Likewise, parents will always encourage their children to date safer partners than those children will tend to want themselves.

There is simply just a natural tension between what you think you can handle for yourself (go for the more exciting candidate; the risk is acceptable!) vs. what those who are “just looking out for you” think you can handle (go for the safter candidate; pick someone who won’t break your heart!).

When you put women in charge of their own mating decisions, the bad boys and seducers win; but when you put her family or guardians in charge, the hand tilts toward simps.

Intriguing, no?

 

“So Simping Is Okay Then?”

Dear God, no.

Don’t be a simp.

If you are reading this in a time or a place where arranged marriages are endemic, still, don’t be a simp.

The healthiest relationship is one where the girl is smitten with you. You need to know how to make girls smitten with you. Simping on them definitely will not do it.

Simping will not get her to look at you like this.

Depending on your circumstances, you may need to be able to display some ‘simp-like qualities’ in front of a woman’s family and friends. But you should also be able to seduce the girl herself.

Rather than be a simp, be the man who knows how to win over the woman (seducing her by being the risky, exciting guy) while also winning over her family and friends (seducing them by being the guy who is ‘just right’ for their darling girl).

That means you will need to wear different hats, depending on whom the audience is.

This kind of flexibility is the mark of a true seducer, though.

It leads to the best of both worlds:

A woman totally smitten with you

Her family & friends completely in support of you

And next time you see some retarded display of simping online, just think of Arcite and Palamon:

This guy is not actually doing it for the girl – he is doing it for the people around her hoping to be picked by them to be her spouse.

(except the ‘bobs and vegana’ guys. I’m still not sure what that’s about)

Yours,

Chase Amante

Title: Roses of Romantic Attraction Progress Report: Organizing Research for Rose X, Touch | Girls Chase
content:
Rose IX (Logistics) is finished, bringing us to the writing of the final quarter of the Roses of Romantic Attraction: Touch, Pair Bonding, and Chance.

I’ve been a bit slow working on my upcoming romantic attraction book lately. We’ve had the holidays, a recent sales event at Girls Chase, the relaunched X account I’ve been laboring to build, and of course now it’s corporate tax time (yay).

Nevertheless, Rose IX (Logistics) is complete; and since my last update, I’ve gathered together all the research for the next two Roses on Touch and Pair Bonding, and most of the way through organizing the research for Rose X (Touch). I also went back and added a brief section on Byronic character traits and social penetration theory to Rose VI (Trust).

Find all the previous updates on the Roses of Romantic Attraction here.

 

Social Penetration & Layered Personalities

As I don’t have much to report this update, I figured I’d tell you about the little-known Social Penetration Theory. This theory from the early 1970s posits that interpersonal relationships develop along two dimensions:

The breadth of interpersonal penetration: how much interaction two people have had, how much information they’ve exchanged, etc., per the amount of time they’ve spent communicating.

The depth of interpersonal penetration: how intimate a typical interaction between the two individuals is.

For instance, if you have an officemate you see every day but never discuss anything other than the weather and local sports team, that is a relationship with minimal penetration. The connection never progresses beyond the most superficial level, in either breadth or depth.

On the other hand, if you meet a beautiful new girl, deep dive her on her dreams and hopes for the future, and she tells you all about her hobbies, passions, travels, day-to-day life, and family background, that is a connection with both great breadth and depth of connection. All at once you and her have created a broader, deeper connection than your many hours of idle chatting with your officemate managed to produce – thanks to the far greater penetration depth + breadth.

Social penetration theory intersects nicely with both deep diving and Byronic characteristics. One paper describes social penetration as being like “peeling back the layers of an onion”, which is the same way women’s exploration of the Byronic hero progresses in a romance novel.

 

More on Byronic Heroes

In romance novels, women progressively peel back the layers of the Byronic hero, digging deeper into him and learning more about him. His flawed human side becomes revealed and this ‘vulnerability’ only causes the heroine to fall even more in-love with him.

One of more fascinating passages I came across in my research on romance novel tropes was this:

He is a difficult, puzzling, and even dangerous man who challenges the very essence of the heroine. Her task is to decipher his personality and then to alter his reckless and rebellious demeanor so that they can have a mutually satisfying love relationship. As soon as the hero is ‘‘captured’’ the novel ends.

Got that? The romance novel heroine follows a specific ‘heroine’s journey’:

Encounters a man who is difficult, puzzling, and even dangerous (i.e., not a nice guy).

This man challenges the very essence of the heroine (i.e., not an agreeable doormat).

The heroine’s task is first to get to the bottom of who he is (i.e., he baits her in).

From there, she must seduce him into committing to her (i.e., she chases commitment).

Once he is at last tamed, the story ends (presumably they will marry, move in, have four kids, and live happily ever after in an otherwise boring, predictable story that is no longer exciting and no one cares to read).

This is the ultimate female fantasy, just like how male fantasies revolve around displaying power and prowess and winning the affections of a beautiful girl.

The male fantasy is to show off great proficiency and get the girl.

The female fantasy is to discover a complex, untamed male and rein him in.

A woman who wants a man to feel wowed by her would do well to make him feel that she is wildly impressed by his power and capability.

A man who wants a woman to feel wowed by him, on the other hand, needs to focus on luring her in with his puzzling complexity and untamed behavior, which she then must work to ‘domesticate’.

All the while, of course, she’ll be peeling back layers – discovering more and more about the Byronic hero.

 

Next Up: Writing Rose X

I’ll be finished ordering the research for Rose X soon.

I had some bits and pieces on some aspects of touch (like touch in a relationship, or orgasm during sex) I thought worked better in the Rose on Pair Bonding so moved those to there.

This keeps Rose X purely focused on the role touch plays in pre-sex attraction: from incidental touch at the beginning of the courtship, to escalating touch, kisses, and last minute resistance.

We’re in the final quarter of the book now, with just the Roses on Touch, Pair Bonding, and Chance left.

I’m not entirely sure what research will go into the Rose on Chance, though I know we’ll circle back around to propinquity, and certainly we’ll discuss the satisficing process here, romantic availability, rebounding, etc. Chance plays a very large role in attraction, one that is usually ignored, which might make that the most interesting part of the book to write of all.

More updates to come as I complete more of the book!

Chase

Title: Invite Her Home | Girls Chase
content:
Guys go out for different reasons. I find that one of the most common ones, particularly for men new to meeting women on the street, at bars, at clubs, at bookstores and coffee shops, is to “work on their game”.

Totally understandable. It’s where I started out at. And, especially in the beginning, you have a lot of basic stuff you’re trying to get down and specific traits you’re looking to iron out and make a regular part of who you are and the way you interact with women.

However, there comes a time when “working on your game” is no longer a valid reason for going out and meeting girls. It could be when you realize that talking to girls is no longer scary and intimidating. It could be when you discover that most girls now react pretty well to you. It could be when you have girls flirting hard with you now every now and again.

At that point, once you’ve realized that you still want to work on your game without having “working on your game” as your primary focus (because it no longer intrigues you), it’s now time for you to set a new objective for yourself. One I find very useful is “bring a girl home.”

It’s intimidating to think, “Okay, I’ve got to go talk to a girl and I hope she likes me.” When talking to a girl to get you to like you is your objective, you’ll have a lot of anxiety. However, when talking to a girl to get her to *come home* with you is your objective -- well, it tends to be pretty exciting.

Here’s why: when you’re at the point where you can realistically tell yourself, “I’m going to try and bring a girl home tonight, and if I meet enough girls and try to get some to come with me, I stand a good chance of finding a girl who’ll come with me,” you’ll be energized and will work harder. Then the goal is no longer the vague goal of working on game, but actually the very SPECIFIC goal of taking a girl (or girls) home.

And it’s easier than it sounds. A lot of guys build it up to this big thing in their heads. “Oh no, I’ve got to bring a girl home… how on EARTH am I going to do that?” they think. But I’ve taken girls home that I spent less than five minutes talking to. Wow, sounds amazing, right? It’s not. It doesn’t take some incredible level of game to get there. All it takes is the ability to PROPOSE it and FOLLOW THROUGH.

That means, you’re talking to a girl and you can tell she likes you. You’re moving fast maybe -- there are lots of girls and you want to keep moving. But you like this one and don’t want to dawdle. So what do you do? You say, “Hey, let’s party.” She asks what that means; you tell her. “Let’s go somewhere more fun than this; somewhere with good music and cheap drinks.” She asks you where; you refuse to say specifically. “It’s five minutes away; you’ll love it. Let’s go.” You insist again and again until she agrees. She continues to ask where as you head to your car or her car or to hail a cab; you just deflect and keep the conversation moving fluidly. Take her home, pop on some tunes, pour a drink. Give her a massage if you need to, or go straight into making out. Scoop her up in your arms and kiss her deeply.

You can talk to her at the bar or lounge for five minutes or fifty minutes; it doesn’t matter. All that matters is that you read her body language and know she’s into it. Preferably, you’ve built up compliance by having her do things for you, so now she’s ready to take the plunge and REALLY follow your lead. But I’ve brought girls back quickly who’ve never done anything for me yet and I really didn’t think WOULD come with me. I just proposed and insisted, and they agreed; I was SURPRISED they came home so quickly and readily, but they did.

It’s like the old saying, if you stand at a bus stop and ask 100 women to come have sex with you, one of them is bound to say, “Hmm… ok.” But when you’re combining that with good game, charisma, and a good / disarming look and persona, you’ll up your percentage a good bit. Being able to pick out the girls who are looking for it helps, and being able to disarm objections on the fly helps as well. But ultimately, it comes down to proposing it and following through.

Those who don’t ask for it, don’t get it. Keep that in mind.

You can kind of boil seduction down to that. There are the guys who ask for it, and the guys who don’t. Girls are the followers, not the leaders. They’re waiting to be led. So it’s always the guy who will step up and lead who gets the girl.

Next time you go out, and you’re not sure what exactly you’re doing, or what you want to do, try this: tell yourself you’re going to keep talking to girls until you find one to come home with you. You’ll be surprised at what you learn and some of the crazy adventures you get out of it.

Yours,
Chase

UPDATE: for more detail on the topic of inviting girls home and getting them alone with you, see "Get a Girl Alone Today with These 7 Tips" and "How to Go to Her Place Smoothly, Even If You Just Met."

Title: Pre-Opening | Girls Chase
content:
Opening (or engaging a woman verbally for the first time) in-and-of itself is a necessity, something that must be done 96% of the time when you want to meet a girl (if we imagine that about 4% of opening is done by women themselves). It’s unavoidable and inescapable. Different types of openers can net you different results – with direct openers being of course the flavor of opening that typically offers the most bang for your buck.

But outside the words used in the opener itself, there are in fact a few other things you can do with your openers to have them serve you far better.

Enter pre-opening. A term I coined to give name to a handful of small nonverbal gestures that net big returns in opening percentages and efficacy.

This is stuff that will get more girls opening for you, more eagerly. If you want women falling all over themselves when you first say hello, outside of making changes to your clothing, hairstyle, posture, eye contact, voice, and other fundamentals, this – pre-opening – is the way to do it.

There are several categories of pre-opening I’d like to cover here, so rather than spend a lot of time talking about the how and why, let’s just dive into them and hash that part of it out as we go.




Pre-Opening

Pre-opening by definition is an action that you take with a woman prior to verbally engaging her. It’s something you’ll use to get a woman’s attention and prime her to be opened.

We’re going to chiefly use touch to pre-open, although as you’ll see in the “Glance and Smile” section below, pre-opening certainly isn’t limited to touch by any means. Rather, touch is simply the most common and straightforward way for you to pre-open.

The reason pre-opening works is simple: you typically want a woman to be looking at you first. This is the first step in setting up the chase dynamic that you want –you want those subconscious signals firing in a girl’s mind that she noticed you first, that she was interested in you first, that she is chasing you and pursuing you. The early stages of an interaction with a new woman go much more smoothly when you start off using this dynamic than they do when you start off as the pursuer (as the one making the initial eye contact). By using touch, you’re able to get a woman looking at you before you are looking at her. Check out the article on elite eye contact for a little more information on how eye contact comes into play here.

Some standard pre-openers include lightly resting your hand on a woman’s arm until she turns to look at you, or placing your hand on her shoulder and perhaps squeezing her shoulder a few times if she is slow to turn. A half-second after her eyes are gazing at yours, you turn to her very casually with a warm smile and begin your verbal opener.

The reason this works so effectively is twofold:

Pre-opening should become an essential, core element of your opening strategy in nearly every occasion. It does so many good things for your opening it can’t be emphasized enough.




Nudge


A variation of standard pre-opening is the nudge. Simple enough to remember, you walk up to a girl who isn’t gazing your way, and preferably is leaning against something – a wall, a bar, etc. Then, you nudge her – either give her a gentle hip bump with your own hips, or give her a light, playful shove in the arm with your arm. When she turns to look at you, look at her back, and give her a playful smile.

As a bonus, if you smile at her like you’re about to begin laughing, she’ll often catch the emotion and burst into a bit of laughter herself. This makes for a very fun, light pre-opening, and you can still proceed with any kind of verbal opener you decide on (direct is fantastic here, since she is already receiving you warmly – might as well go with the most powerful, effective opener!).




Lingering Touch


After physically pre-opening (by first touching a girl to get her attention), you can use something I call the “lingering touch.” The lingering touch consists of leaving your hand where it’s resting on the girl you’ve just pre-opened, and holding eye contact with her with a warm smile on your face for a second or a pair of seconds before you begin your opener.

A lingering touch might look like this:

A man walks up to a woman and places the palm of his hand on her elbow. She turns to look at him, resting her eyes on his. He moves his eyes over to meet hers, and smiles at her warmly while he gazes into her eyes for two seconds. At last, he speaks: “I saw you standing over here, and I just had to come tell you, that…”

It’s something you’ll see sometimes in movies, in fact, where an incredibly suave, romantic man walks up to engage a beautiful woman he’s just seen. And just as women swoon for it in the movies, they swoon for it in real life, too.




Glance and Smile

The glance-and-smile is a non-physical means of pre-opening that relies instead on eye contact and smiling to prep a woman for being opened. It can be used regardless of who makes eye contact first; you’ll find it’s one of the few times that you can look at a woman’s eyes first and still reliably come off as charming and sexy.

The way the glance-and-smile works is that once you’ve made eye contact with a woman, and she’s returning your eye contact, you’ll then glance away and smile to yourself as if you’ve just realized something about her, or you’re picturing the two of you together. It will generate a lot of intrigue before you even speak your first word.

This works best with women who are highly socially aware. For obvious reasons, this most often is very beautiful, fashionable women; less attractive women tend to be less socially aware, and may not catch this subtle gesture. So save this one mostly for the top tier of women you meet, looks-wise and status-wise, to put it to best use.

Note on the glance-and-smile: it may be used as a standalone technique, or in conjunction with another form of pre-opening. You can very well use it by itself, but you can also walk up to a woman, pre-open her, the use the glance-and-smile. Use your judgment; depending on the situation, one approach may be superior to another.




Why Pre-Opening Works


Why does pre-opening work? It works because of the reasons we discussed before, and a few others:

It displays mountains of confidence. Women know that any man using pre-opening is comfortable with women and not in a needy frame-of-mind whatsoever.
It sets the initial chase frame. By having a woman look at you first, you’re setting the early frame in her mind (and in yours) that she is the one pursuing you.
It gives women a chance to size you up. In all likelihood, the woman you’re going up to meet is thinking about something else, or talking about something else, or doing something else – and when you first walk up, she has to mentally readjust a little to prepare herself to talk to you. When a guy walks up to her and immediately launches into conversation, it can be jarring and a little disorienting. Giving her a moment to soak your presence in lets her feel far more comfortable when you begin talking to her.

Pre-opening is a spectacular way of getting warmer, stronger, more positive receptions from women almost universally. The more you pre-open, the higher an opening percentage you’ll have, and the better a foot you’ll start off on in every new interaction. Pre-opening does much to benefit your initial approach; if you want to have women at hello, this is one way you can get there a lot more consistently.

Until next time--

Always,
Chase Amante

Title: Using Intrigue to Get Girls Chasing You | Girls Chase
content:
One big mistake I see a lot of men make when meeting new women is forgetting to allow for some mystery… a little intrigue. And a little bit goes a long way – it fascinates women, gets them thinking about you when you’re not there, gets them frustrated – in a good way! – trying to figure you out.

And as they try to figure you out, they’re all the while investing more and more time thinking about you. And as we all know, the more invested in you a woman is, the more she’ll LIKE you and the more she’ll stick by you and the more she’ll follow your lead.

Intrigue is an awesome, AWESOME way to get girls chasing you!

But hey, what do I mean, allow for some intrigue? Well, to put it in perspective, imagine this:

You meet a beautiful girl at your favorite coffees shop or bar. You end up in a conversation with her. You ask her how old she is; she says, “Old enough; how old are you?” then no matter how much you ask, she refuses to tell you. Then you ask her where she’s from, and she tells you, “A little town far away, but I’m here now, and I love it.” Again, when you press for details, she won’t give you a clear answer.

She intrigues you. She ropes you into this exciting frustration of wanting to know yet having absolutely no idea how to get the answer. And not only do you not know the answer to her question, but you also don’t know WHY she won’t tell you, and that’s the real fun in intrigue. Is she hiding something? Scared to talk about her past? What could her reasoning be???

A girl has NO IDEA what your reason is for deferring to answer. She becomes more and more intrigued, feeling more and more like you are this riddle, this puzzle she HAS to solve.

All human beings love mystery. It’s why there are so many movies about outer space – ANYTHING could be out there, we reason. It’s why the men in women’s romance novels are often mysterious, with foggy back stories and unknown origins – they could come from ANYWHERE, and thus have the ability to be ANYTHING that the woman desires.

You can become such a man – a man of mystery, of unknown intentions and unknown origins. And it’s relatively easy to do… get her interested enough to ask you questions, then dodge them with a non-answer that deflects the question by asking her something about herself or changing the topic entirely.

Remember, the steps are:

Non-answer
Deflection

A few examples:

Girl: Why do you XYZ?
You: Does it matter? (non-answer) Let’s just enjoy ourselves right now, in this moment. (deflection)

Girl: Are you ABC?
You: I’m really not the kind of guy you can categorize as one thing or another. (non-answer) How about you? (deflection)

Once you have intrigue generated, you must maintain it, at least for a while. She’ll start pressing harder and harder for an answer – stay strong and stay mysterious. Once a man lets the intrigue slip – by giving her too many concrete answers – he’s given up some of his power, the power of his own mystery, and made himself less interesting and mysterious. Avoid that pitfall and keep yourself shrouded in unanswered questions.

You want to MAINTAIN your power, by maintaining your mystery.

Another way you can create intrigue is by doing one thing and saying another. This is fun! For instance, tell a girl you’re talking to that you’re really shy with women, as you sit next to her, chatting her up confidently with your arm around her. Or tell her you don’t believe in alcohol, then order a drink at the bar right in front of her. Or tell her how you’re always trying to watch your weight and not eat too much, then order a gigantic pepperoni pizza all for yourself and ask her if she wants a slice.

Contradictions like that cause conflicts in people’s brains that they have trouble reconciling, and for women it makes you more intriguing, harder to figure out, and ultimately, more alluring and attractive!

So the next time you’re speaking with a woman you like, remember to intrigue her a little – it’s an old staple of many women’s flirtations (don’t reveal too much too soon), and if you want to get girls tying themselves up in knots trying to figure you out, make it a part of your repartee – today!

See you next time,
Chase Amante

Title: Closing With Consistency | Girls Chase
content:

Intention
Fearlessness

If a guy is just chatting with her and thinking, "Hmm, maybe I'll talk to her some more, then move her over here, then try to get her back to my place," that's not intention. That's him mentally meandering about.

Guys who get laid are thinking, "Mmm, she's fine. I really want to fuck her right now. Let's make that happen."
