We have a thread on the Skilled Seducer Forum that focuses on more practical strategies for autistic men – that may be more worth checking out.

However, perhaps the single most important tactical adjustment for EVERY incel who struggles with empathy (such as autistic men and ADHD men) to make is this one: stop making uncharitable assumptions about others. This is something I have discovered low empathy people ubiquitously do without even being cognizant they are doing it; they ascribe malicious or stupid motives to others, then react with total surprise when those others respond to them with hostility or by cutting them off. If you want people to stop reacting to you with hostility or by cutting you off, Priority Number One HAS TO BE to stop burdening people with your uncharitable assumptions about them and their intentions/motives.

READ MORE: Stop Repelling People with Your Uncharitable Assumptions

This one behavior — ubiquitous among low empathy men — really puts people off you.

Optionally, you may want to start a journal on our forum where you chronicle your progress improving your social skills. Or keep a private journal if you don’t need the public accountability side of things. Often simply having a journal you jot efforts, attempts, and outcomes into helps distill your thinking and keep you on-track in your learning.

 

Prepare for It to Be Hard

Learning social skills is not like anything else.

If you want to get muscular, you can do that in the gym without talking to anyone. You might be a bit self-conscious that there are other guys bigger than you there, but no one is rejecting you.

If you want to make money, you can do that in a career or with many types of businesses without dealing with much rejection at all.

But if you want to learn social skills, and you are coming from behind, which you WILL be if you are involuntarily celibate, you have to do that among people, where your inadequacy will be on full display. You cannot hide. You are going to make mistakes, and you are going to feel embarrassed. Pride is the 100-foot barrier here.

The most important lesson you will learn once you do it is that no one cares about your screwups anywhere near the extent that you do. People are far more concerned with what you think about them and whatever screwups they make (which you may not even notice, but they sure will) than they are forming opinions about you. Yes, if you screw up a lot you will develop a reputation as ‘that guy who is a bit awkward or weird’ but you need to have a lot of screwups (or else several really BIG screwups) to do that. And if people keep hanging around you anyway, it’s not even a dealbreaker.

Regardless though, you are going to need to swallow your pride.

Let me tell it to you straight, my man:

You are a beautiful human being. Deep inside, we are all beings of light, temporarily trapped in this mortal coil in our aging, limited bodies. In the end, we’ll all be back in the realm of light again, where we can frolic and vibe on the same good vibrations without even needing to speak. But here in this world of brains and vocal organs, we need to use our minds, voices, and bodies to communicate, and we have to develop this ability through experience and skill.

I know it sucks, and it is yet one more difficult thing you have to do in life to get what you want, but social skills development is one of the worthiest ventures you will undertake. Everything you want to do in life involves people. The better you get with people, the easier it is to do the things you want, and to get other people very happily on board with you.

The pride you swallow early on as you learn this stuff enables you to stand prouder later on than you are able to stand now.

Back when I sucked with girls, I tried to maintain as much pride as I could, but it was a very fragile pride, because there was nothing to back it up – no friends, no girls, no skills, no reality. Today I get to be very chill about it all, to the point where men who are incels assume I have always had it, that it was “served to me on a silver platter” as one incel put it recently, because that is where you get to eventually.

The journey is hard, but the journey is worth it.

Few journeys in life are as worthy as this.

 

Conclusion

I hope this article was useful.

I hope, even if you are not ready to stop being an incel just yet, it at least gives you something to chew on mentally.

I hope you will bookmark it and come back to it to review it when you need to.

I was there; I spent a long time there. Like you may feel, I felt that no one could understand me, and there was nothing anyone could do to help.

I was half right. People could understand me, but nobody could help me, because I was not open to being helped. I’ve always been a stubborn guy. In those days I was immovable.

Breaking out of inceldom is something a man has to decide to do for himself. It can’t happen until he becomes so Goddamn sick of being alone that he sets aside whatever the cause he’s fixated on as the excuse for his learned helplessness and decides to start taking steps to become socially successful and cool. This involves a series of self-improvement-oriented goals that get him out of helplessness and into a habit of self-help.

The word ‘self-help’ is almost a bad word in a lot of people’s minds these days. But self-help is really what it comes down to. I can give you advice, I can tell you my story, but you’ve got to go through the journey yourself. Even if I was there with you cheering you on, you’d still need to be the one doing it. Nobody can solve the problem for you. In that way, the “nobody can help me” view of the incel is correct. No one can drag him out of that hole he’s in. He has to climb out with his own hands and feet.

You got this, my man. Each one of us has this potential within him. You just need to tap into yours.

It’s doable. You can do it.

May you find yourself topside, out of that hole, someday soon – and may we celebrate your ascendance together when you do.

Your Friend,

Chase Amante

Title: There's Not Much Competition to Date the Best, Most Beautiful Girls | Girls Chase
content:
The highest mate value women – beautiful, sweet, & amazing – often have few good suitors. The trick? Girls who market themselves & girls of high mate value often overlap but little.

“Women have impossible standards,” the conventional wisdom goes.

“The prettier she is, the pickier she’ll be.”

“The hottest girls are drowning in suitors and simps.”

This all seems to make sense when we think about it. Men want the best girls. The best girls should have lots of choice with men. In fact, they should be slammed with offers from the highest value men, making it such that ordinary men shouldn’t even be able to compete.

Yet every day, you can find beautiful, sweet girls paired up with totally average men. Men who are unexceptional in their looks, intellects, wits, charm, physiques, and bank accounts. Most of the time these men don’t even have ‘game’, the stuff we teach on this website. If you ask them how to get girls like this, they’ll offer you vapid platitudes like “just be yourself” and “sooner or later the right girl comes along.”

These pairings have befuddled hopeful daters since men started dishing on dating on the web. How do these ordinary guys meet these girls? How do they keep them? Why do these girls choose THEM?

The raw – and at first counterintuitive – reality is simply this: there’s just not a whole lot of competition to date the most beautiful, most amazing girls.

 

Mate Value vs. Marketing

In sales, we talk often about a product’s quality versus its marketing.

A low quality product with gangbusters marketing can still sell like hot cakes.

An exceptional quality product with no marketing on the other hand will not sell at all.

That’s because if no one knows about it, if no one hears about it, if no one sees it, then for all those people – even people who would have LOVED it IF they knew about it – it may as well not exist!

This principle is alive and well in the dating world. You’ve likely experienced it firsthand. If you’re a Girls Chase reader, odds are high that you’re smarter than average and more ambitious than average – two things very attractive to women. (study 1: women are more attracted to intelligent men | study 2: women are more attracted to ambitious men) Nevertheless, I bet you have more than once thought to yourself, “Man, that girl would be SO thrilled with me… if only she knew!” That’s a problem of marketing.

Girls Chase is a ‘personal marketing site’. Through developing your fundamentals, you enhance one aspect of your personal marketability. Through developing your game, you enhance another aspect of your personal marketability. Develop both to a high enough extent, put them together, and you become a Grade A lady killer.

‘Personal marketing’ is as available to ‘low mate value’ people as it is ‘high mate value’ ones. There have been highly skilled seducers who were short, ugly, and dumb, but who bedded lots of good-looking girls by exploiting a ‘hack’; for instance, running SOI + barrier game on tourist girls, as the “aging ugly native” Guam Playboy who continually hooked up with young female visitors to the island of Guam did.

While this is true for men, it is equally true for women.

 

Case Study 1: Low Mate Value, Stellar Marketing

I recently came across influencer Hunter Schafer. If you’re unfamiliar with Schafer, here’s an interview Schafer had with Jimmy Kimmel:

Newsflash:

Here’s another video where Schafer talks about using a ‘tuck kit’ – i.e., a personal care item that helpfully tucks your manly bits up underneath so they aren’t bulging out when you want to wear something a bit more revealing. That’s right: Hunter Schafer is a guy.

I guarantee you this guy has loads of men chasing after him, simping for him, their brains tricked into viewing him as a ‘high value woman’. He is not a high value woman… he’s not even a woman! But he’s marketed himself as one – as an attractive, likable, down-to-earth one, no less. The result is, he vacuums up loads of male suitors.

I have seen this effect firsthand with transsexuals in nightclubs. I discussed several incidents in this article. Sometimes, the most sought-after, ‘highest value’ woman in the club isn’t even a woman – unbeknownst to the legions of men dumping their time into chasing ‘her’.

Meanwhile, the actual flesh-and-blood women – i.e., the ones with child-bearing organs – have far fewer male suitors, even if those girls might be good-looking. Even if they’re hot, they’re rarely as ostentatious or hyperfeminine as a well-done tranny is, so they rarely get the same degree of attention.

Men have limited amounts of romantic attention, and the more time and energy more men spend chasing after the same heavily-marketed women (or even ‘women’), the less time and energy they have to seek out and pursue any other girl – particularly girls who don’t market themselves that well.

 

Case Study 2: High Mate Value, Crap Marketing

My first girlfriend was a very beautiful, extremely likable, charismatic girl who’d had a string of in my opinion mediocre boyfriends. All the men she’d dated had been very average… shocking for me at the time as a novice dater. (I have since found it’s common for awesome girls to date good-but-mediocre guys)

Whenever I took her with me to parties, she was THE life of the party – everyone loved her! I’d get constant praise from men and women alike on both her beauty and her likability. She’d field this praise too; I got used to hearing “Thank you, thank you” from her non-stop whenever I took her out.

When I took her to nightclubs (I soon realized I had to stop taking her to nightclubs), other guys would constantly come up to hit on her. I must have heard “Is this your boyfriend?” as guys checked to see if she was with me 1000x. That still wouldn’t stop them from trying anyway and she’d ultimately have to fend them off. It was exhausting.

But when we broke up, at first the only guy she could get was a nerdy, balding programmer with a goofy voice and messed up teeth (though, to his credit, he was pretty fit). She cried to him about me, and asked him to be exclusive – but he declined. How had this high mate value girl so sought after everywhere I took her ended up in a situation where this was the best she could do?

The problem wasn’t her mate value. It was that she wasn’t marketing herself anywhere.

After Rebound Guy #1 denied her exclusivity and pushed her into being his friend with benefits, she started going out and marketing herself a lot more. At that point, she began meeting a lot more men – more desirable men. She hooked up with some of these guys; then Rebound Guy #1 got jealous and decided he wanted an exclusive relationship with her after all… but she declined. In the end, she found a top tier guy to marry: cool, fun, in-shape, intelligent, successful, with a great job, a dozen patents, a house, and a boat. Excellent guy all around. I was happy for her.

But she had no way to meet her future husband – and was stuck being FWB to a guy far below her future husband’s mate value – until she started marketing herself.

Here’s a different example: in East Asia, expat women have a really hard time dating. Expat guys are too busy dating local girls to worry about expat girls. Local guys, on the other hand, find expat women intimidating, and largely won’t approach them. So what ends up happening is almost nobody goes for expat girls. Expat girls in East Asia go through long dry spells, even if they are incredibly good-looking, even the ones who go out often, and end up dating far below their market value (i.e., taking whatever they can get). They even fight for these below-market-value men to “get serious” about them and commit!

Once again, it’s not a problem of mate value; it is a problem of marketing. The wrong product for the wrong market, or not marketed the right way, simply does not sell.

 

The Most Beautiful, Awesome Girls Have Few Suitors

Now that you have a basic understanding of the mate value vs. marketing phenomenon, let’s talk about how it works more generally.

I want you to imagine three different girls:

Madison, an absolutely beautiful 23-year-old girl with a very sweet personality. Madison is shy and a bit of an introvert, so she avoids bars and parties. She tried a dating app once at a friend’s recommendation but was overwhelmed with all the messages from guys, some of them shockingly crude, and uninstalled it in a panic. Her day consists of getting a coffee on her way to work, doing her job, a little socializing at the office, then heading home for dinner, which she eats with her female roommate. She doesn’t have much of a social life and almost never meets men other than her officemates or the occasional friend of her roommate’s.

Alyssa, a super sexy 25-year-old mid with borderline personality disorder. Alyssa is not naturally beautiful, but she’s so good with makeup, hair, clothes that show off her sexy cleavage, and super sexy nonverbals and body language that she’s an absolute sexpot. She works as a stripper and a dog walker, and is constantly one of the hottest, most-pursued women in the clubs she goes to every weekend. Alyssa never has a shortage of dates, including with a variety of cool, good-looking, wealthy, and successful men, even if her dating history is a messy one filled with broken relationships, infidelity, and revenge.

Sydney, a slightly overweight 27-year-old mid with a boring personality. Sydney doesn’t have much going for her, but if there’s one thing she knows, it’s how to put herself out there. She’s at different activities every day of the week after work, socializing with people; in between, she’s on apps swiping on guys and setting up dates. Despite her blandness and unexceptional looks, Sydney bats above her average, going out with Chads and playboys, entering into friend-with-benefits relationships with them, and getting the occasional out-of-her-league boyfriend.

How would you rank each of these three girls in terms of mate value?

But now how would you rate each of the three in terms of marketing?

Finally, how would you rate these three women in terms of how in-demand they are by men – and of the quality and quantity of the suitors they field?

If it boggles your mind that the highest mate value girl has fewer suitors of lower overall mate value than the other two better marketed, lower mate value girls, you’d better buckle up, because this ride’s just getting started.

 

Marketing Is Hard (Even for Beautiful Women)

Pop quiz: how many guys do you know who dress well, are fit, have polished social skills, and go out often to meet girls? You can also throw in guys with elite profile pics on dating apps who line up loads of dates.

Unless you are deep in the seduction community, I’m guessing you don’t know many such guys – you might not even known any. Heck, you and your wingman might be the only guys you know who make that cut.

Guess what? Just like most dudes are not ‘top tier personal marketers’, most girls are not either.

The girls you see with large followings on Instagram are the top of the top in terms of marketing. There are a whole lot of girls on Instagram with tiny followings. It’s not an issue of ‘beauty’ or ‘quality’ either; I have seen stunning girls trying to build an Instagram following without knowing what they are doing and getting very little traction.

Or here’s another data point: the average OnlyFans creator earns $165 per month. If you think that’s just ugly BBWs, you’re wrong. There are plenty of hot girls who try OnlyFans, have no idea how to market themselves, and get nowhere with it. Nor are the top earners all ‘total knockouts’; take a scroll through the list of OnlyFans top earners and tell me how many of them you’d personally rate as ‘high mate value’. I doubt it will be ‘all’; if you’re not down with the whole ‘adult actress lifestyle’ thing, it may well be none.

Dating apps are organized around male mate selection processes (i.e., extremely visual / quick decision oriented; zero of the behavioral and social evaluation women rely on to assess mates), which makes them hostile to how ordinary women choose mates. If this wasn’t enough, women on apps get inundated with messages, many of them extremely crude, as soon as they start getting matches. Low self-esteem women love this; high testosterone masculine women (who are more visual and thus better fitted to apps; and who are also higher sex drive and need a steady supply of fresh sausage) also like it more. But most women get overwhelmed and quickly leave apps; thus why most women aren’t on apps and app populations are so heavily skewed toward men (typically 70-80%+ male).

We’ve also got looking for friends. The average girl is as terrible at this than the average guy – worse, even. At least men can go out and socialize actively. Women have to wait for people to approach them, generally.

The above are all women, talking about how hard making friends is.

Without friends, without apps, without having a large social media presence, and if a woman doesn’t like going to nightlife and activities (not all women are extroverts… and even many of those who are aren’t strong extroverts), how the heck is a girl supposed to market herself to men?

 

Most Women Lead Boring Lives
She’s not going on a bunch of dates. In fact, she’s not even very socially active.

The vast majority of women are NOT:

Active on dating apps

Active partygoers / nightlife revelers

Maintaining large man-filled social circles

Owners of large and busy social media profiles

Active about attending social events & activities

They may dabble in some of these things occasionally.

Often when they do they are not very active and do not meet many or any guys.

If a girl dresses fairly ordinary (i.e., non-flashy) and goes to a bar with a few of her friends, then leaves before it gets very late, there’s an excellent chance she won’t have more than a few minutes of conversation with men there the entire night, or none at all – even if she’s gorgeous. It’s unlikely any guy will get her contact info. If she only does this a few times a year, her grand total of ‘men met via bars’ maybe be zero.

Likewise, if she goes on a dating app, matches with a few men, feels uninspired by the process of talking to men via text whom she knows only via photos (and thus feels zero connection with… or may even feel suspicion toward), then logs off and then doesn’t log on for a while, then feels awkward about all the unanswered messages so delays logging on even more, until she ultimately deletes the app, she may meet zero men on that app. Technically, she was on there, and she did get matches – she just didn’t meet anyone from it. I have talked to many girls (met via cold approach) who’ve done just this. They tried apps… they just found the process too uncomfortable and didn’t end up going out with anyone.

Perhaps just as or more common is the girl who’s gone out on dates with one or two guys from apps, didn’t like it, and swore off apps ever after that. (FYI: the average American woman goes on three first dates from dating apps lifetime)

Most girls’ lives are very boring.

They are not going out socializing.

They are not connecting with men online.

They do not have legions of simps drooling over them.

The girls that DO have and do that are the minority of highly public / very well self-marketed girls – NOT usual.

What is more, most of the most beautiful women never become the best marketers; the best marketers (i.e., the ones most guys are drooling over) are almost always women of moderate natural attractiveness.

READ MORE: You're Passing Up the Hottest, Coolest Girls

Don’t miss those diamonds in the rough!

 

The Secret to Meeting Low Competition Beautiful Sweet Girls

A long time ago a woman commented to me on a Girls Chase article (I don’t remember which one) that “You really don’t like competition, do you?”

That’s right; I don’t.

Well, let me clarify: generally speaking, the vast majority of men present no threat to my seductions (or the seductions of any skilled seducer). I do not worry about ‘Chads’. I have beat out guys for women who were very good-looking, very high status, or very rich; unlike a lot of guys who really worry about these factors, I don’t.

The only thing I would worry about would be if I found myself in a head-to-head competition for a girl with a guy with exceptional game: if he was confident, authoritative, flirtatious, witty, touchy, cool, and obeyed the Law of Least Effort. The few times I have lost girls to other guys, it has been to guys who outclassed me in these dimensions – not looks, money, or status (all my “lost a girl to another guy” incidents happened early on… these incidents fueled me to work harder to nail down all those attractive qualities and game).

Nevertheless, dealing with a constant parade of male suitors – even if they are lower caliber suitors – is still annoying, and still inflates a girl’s ego, which raises her resistance to you. It is undeniably harder to pick up the girl who is the center of attention at the nightclub than it is the girl who is off in a corner being ignored, even if the girl in the corner is hotter.

For that reason, while I do think it is sometimes fun to challenge yourself to pull the girl whom every other guy is trying to get (if purely for the challenge of seeing if you can do it and ‘beat the odds’), from an efficiency standpoint it simply makes sense to look for ways to reduce competition without sacrificing quality.

In my experience, as you reduce competition, you actually often RAISE quality – as the most sought-after girls are always the most intensely self-marketed ones, who never happen to be the highest mate value ones.

But if the way to get high mate value girls consistently with minimal fuss is to find low competition high mate value girls, how exactly do you do THAT?

 

She Isn’t at Any of the ‘Marketing Spots’

Here’s the secret:

Low competition girls rarely or never use the ‘marketing channels’ that high competition girls make use of:

Dating apps

Parties and nightlife

Large man-filled social circles

Large, active social media profiles

Social events and activities

That means if you go these places looking for them, you will not find them.

You will not find high mate value women who don’t entertain many suitors on dating apps – because they aren’t there.

You won’t find them at parties or in nightlife – they don’t attend these.

You can’t meet them via social circle – they’re not in your circles.

You won’t engage with them over social media – you likely won’t stumble across their profiles, and even if you somehow do you won’t be able to engage them there.

You won’t bump into them at social events and activities – they don’t go.

You may find them these places occasionally. But the odds any girl you meet at one of these places is such a girl are not high (because these girls are so rarely in these places), and she’s a lot more likely to be on guard when you meet her here, due to her discomfort and unfamiliarity with the venue (compared to the girls who are ‘old pros’).

Instead, these girls are doing things like:

Going to happy hour with their officemates, then going home.

Having a quiet dinner with their roommate at a hole-in-the-wall restaurant.

Reading a book in the park on the weekend for sunshine and fresh air.

Showing their college friend around town when she visits for the week.

None of these, generally speaking, are recommended places you will hear to go meet women at. Happy hours aren’t conducive to pickup; she’s with her colleagues and self-conscious about meeting strangers. Girls having quiet dinners with their friends aren’t in ideal pickup situations either. Etc.

Because such girls are so rarely in ‘marketed’ situations, where men can meet them, they field comparatively few suitors. A couple guys from work may be chasing them. That guy who’s friends with their roommate may be trying to get a date. The occasional outgoing guy who talks to them here and there in public might shoot his shot with them. But that’s it.

If you want to meet these girls, you cannot meet them at the places they aren’t.

You must go the places they ARE; the places that every girl more or less goes.

 

Going Where Every Girl Must Go
She has to get food to eat. Meet her there!

Here is an incomplete, but fairly detailed, list of spots you can go that most women are going to end up in sooner or later, even if their ‘personal marketing’ levels are at absolute zero:

Grocery shopping. She needs to buy groceries. You can meet her in the aisles.

Clothes shopping. That said, the girls who shop for clothes most often tend to be the more marketing-focused ones; but even the girls who don’t market themselves need to wear something (though they are somewhat more likely to simply order clothes online; non-marketer girls tend to care less about trying clothes on first to check the look/fit).

Coffee shops. Many girls get coffee in the morning before work and throughout the day. You can meet girls in line or doing work/reading in coffee shops.

Lunch spots. Especially large indoor or outdoor seating areas. Food courts and cafeterias are great for this. One of Hector Castillo’s students dated a 19-year-old Instagram influencer with a million followers after meeting her eating alone in a food court. Even the heavily-marketed girls can more easily be picked up here!

Parks. Lots of girls go to parks for sunlight and fresh air. Look for girls reading books alone, or just walking or soaking up sunrays on a bench.

Boardwalks. If you live near a beach, many girls will go for walks along the boardwalk to get outside and be near the sea.

Libraries and bookstores. One beautiful girlfriend I had who never went to bars or parties and never did online nevertheless spent lots of time in libraries. She liked to read and the library was the ideal spot to ‘get away’ for her. There are lots of girls you can meet in libraries – bookstores too.

Mass transit. If you live in a city with a good, safe metro system used by attractive women, this can be an ideal spot to meet girls. I’m a huge fan of meeting women on the subway, personally. Also good can be buses and airports/airplanes. Unless she’s a vegetable, she has to commute somewhere. Mass transit gives you an easy way to meet her.

Sidewalks. Street game is hard to beat. No matter what type of girl, you can find her on the sidewalk – it is the great equalizer of game. If you don’t want to do street stops, you can instead find girls at street corners waiting for the light to cross, or girls wandering shopping streets ambling along and stopping as they consider which stores to enter (or else browsing displays outside).

Most of these are day game spots, needless to say. Girls who aren’t ‘marketing’ themselves don’t tend to go out at night. They don’t have places to go when the sun goes down, and anyway, it’s less safe.

Will you find ‘marketer girls’ – nymphos, psychos, makeup-wearing up mids, etc. – in these places? Sure.

But that’s the trick: you will find EVERY kind of girl in these places!

And the vast majority of women are not ‘personal marketers’.

The vast majority of women, no matter how beautiful, no matter how sweet, lead boring, low-or-no-marketing lives.

 

Most Guys Aren’t Trying to Get These Girls

Keep this in mind:

All the guys you hear complaining about women having too high standards, about women drowning in male options, about women sleeping with tons and tons of guys, are not talking about these boring-life, non-marketed girls. Such girls effectively do not exist for them.

They are talking about the girls on apps; they are talking about the girls in clubs; they are talking about the girls on social media; they are talking about the girls they meet at singles events. These are the girls who are out there, marketing themselves, and drowning in suitors. For a great many men, these are the only girls they meet.

Women who do not market themselves are in effect invisible to most men. The more “plugged in” a man is – focusing on women in social media, women on dating apps, women who dress up flashy and market themselves for attention – the more unaware he is of the silent majority of un-marketed women.

Legions of these girls walk by him every single day, but he doesn’t register them. He assumes they “must be online” or “must go to bars” or “at least singles events”, even if he never sees them there. He assumes… but he’s wrong.

It makes sense guys think this way though, right? If she:

Isn’t on dating apps,

Doesn’t go to clubs,

Doesn’t attend singles events,

And only maintains intimate social media accounts with people she only knows personally,

How the heck is the guy who isn’t already in her tiny social circle and does not cold approach even supposed to know she exists? He can’t!

He doesn’t know she’s there, he isn’t trying to get her, and like a great deal of other men, he focuses the lion’s share of his efforts upon the most heavily marketed women:

Girls on dating apps

Girls on social media

Girls at singles events

Girls at nightlife

Even flashy transsexuals

That’s where his male ‘competitive energy’ gets spent – competing for the same girls as every other guy.

And you know what?

That is sad for him and all those other guys…

But it means that for the rest of us, most guys’ energies are all being squandered on the same set of women, while a whole bunch of other women – including the more-or-less objectively best, most beautiful girls – are only fielding suitors from their immediate social circles plus the occasional ballsy ‘shoot his shot’ guy here and there.

There’s just very, very little competition for girls who do not go out there marketing themselves actively, whether through online, nightlife, or activities.

I can tell you – I have done all of social circle, online dating, nightlife, and day game.

I built an elite social circle filled with hundreds of very successful men – multimillionaire business owners, hotel owners, etc. – and the social climbing women who hang around them. The result? I was underwhelmed at the talent. The girls all acted haughty and elite, of course; but you can pick up girls with better faces and bodies – and often educations and personalities – running night and day game.

The biggest party I ever threw, attended by hundreds of people with me as the host and absolute center of attention, from which I originally planned to cap the night by pulling one of the girls from the party, I ended up leaving early out of boredom because none of the girls excited me enough and I had another girl I’d just slept with a few days earlier (from day game) who was hotter than any of them whom I wanted to convert before I left town the next day.

Similar deal with online dating. Online game is good for one thing: volume. Get a profile on lock and your messages and date figured out, and you can do lots and lots of volume. You can even have girls come straight over for sex! But the dirty secret is the talent isn’t there; girls on apps are either mids or they’re broken (and sometimes both). Good for notches but you won’t find a top tier girl online (unless you are real lucky and catch her during that initial 1-3 days she tries the app out before she quits it in overwhelm and disgust).

Bars and nightclubs, you can run into the occasional non-marketed girl here and there when she and a friend of hers decided to venture out and see what all the fuss is about in nightlife. But most of the girls you’ll meet at nightlife are ‘marketers’: they go to places where they’ll receive attention and dress in ways aimed at getting it. Then they go back again the next week. Same deal with singles events – non-marketer girls will try them occasionally, but usually won’t come back. Most of the girls you find at these are ‘regulars’.

If you want to get the girls that no one is competing for – the girls with very few suitors, who aren’t even much competition at all – you need to go places that every woman goes, even if she is not marketing herself at all, and meet girls there. That’s how you find awesome, beautiful girls who usually date average dudes because they just date from the handful of men around them in school or work or sometimes their buildings. That’s how, if you are an exceptional man, you meet women who are top tier, yet for whom you nevertheless are still an outlier amazing man for them rather than “just another one of the many amazing men they know.”

 

Remember: Marketing ≠ Mate Value
High mate value girls can be found anywhere — but often not in the flashiest places.

Keep the “sexy transsexual” example in your head:

Just because a girl (‘girl’) is heavily marketed, and even sought after by legions of men, does not mean she is a high mate value girl. It does not mean she’s “the most beautiful” girl! It just means she’s well marketed.

Further, energy is finite, and every ounce of energy Man A, Man B, Man C, and Man D devote to chasing after Heavily Marketed Girl H is energy they are not devoting to Un-Marketed Girls I, J, K, and L. Men pool a lot of their ‘pursuit energy’ in to chasing after the same incestuous pool of app girls, nightlife girls, singles event girls, and social media girls, while under-pursuing the girls who do not market themselves through these channels.

None of this is to say you can’t go for heavily-marketed girls (though I would advise you to skip the transsexual ones). Flashy girls in clubs and easy-to-bed girls on apps have their merits.

Nevertheless, high mate value but un-marketed girls are out there; they are legion; but you just cannot meet them unless you go the places that girls who don’t market themselves go, and make approaches there.

It’s the only way to meet them – otherwise, they will just end up dating some average guy from their social circles who summons up the balls to ask them out, and one day you will see that couple walking down the street, scratch your head, and ask yourself, “Now how the heck did a schlub like THAT land a stunner like HER?”

There are high mate value girls aplenty who do not market themselves. There’s not even a lot of competition for them. Totally average guys CAN get them.

However, to find them, you cannot be a ‘mass market consumer’ like most guys, drooling after the most heavily self-marketed girls.

You must learn to become a woman connoisseur; to go to where the difficult-to-find women of rare quality are, sniff them out from their hiding spots, and make these girls yours!

Cheers,
Chase Amante

Title: How to Sleep with Girls When You Paid for the Date | Girls Chase
content:
Paying for dates with women can mess the dynamic up. It can feel like you’re chasing – and she feels it too. Yet, there IS a way to pay, AND still seduce.

Long-time Girls Chase readers know my suggestion when it comes to paying for dates: don’t! Preferably, let the girl pay for it. If you can’t do that, then at least do what you can to get out of paying for dates. When girls pay for the date with you, it’s been my personal experience and my observation with others that you (as the man she pays for) are simply a lot more likely to get that particular girl in bed. With you paying for the date, it gets quite a bit trickier.

Nevertheless, from time to time I get requests to talk about how to sleep with girls when you do pay for the date.

Chase,write an article on how to convert paid dates into lays, you've not talked anything about that in all your articles. This is because most men prefer to pay for 1st dates to avoid awkwardness. Thanks.

— David pereira (@Davidperei28228) February 22, 2025

So let’s talk about how to do that.

 

“I Thought Paying for the Date was Normal?”

Any time we talk about this some new guy or other acts surprised that you would not pay for dates with a girl – or that doing anything other than paying for women could be anything other than destructive for your chances with her. “I thought you had to?” goes the logic.

I polled our audience on X, and 43% of men said they pay for women because “it’s the male role”, while a further 12% said they pay because it’s “too awkward not to pay.” That’s 55% of men paying because they think it’s just what they’re supposed to do.

It is clear that paying for women is the norm. Most men believe you should do it… or even that you have to. But just because something is the established norm does not mean it is optimal.

Other established dating norms include:

Men chasing after women.

Men working to impress women.

Not having sex till the third date.

None of these are ideal. So too with paying for women – but we’ve talked about that already:

A woman who pays for you invests in you, and, further, breaks established dating norms to invest – which means she really invests in you. If your focus is on results (i.e., more girls in your bed), getting girls to invest in you is very, very desirable.

Meanwhile, when you pay for a woman, it is hard to escape the appearance that you are investing – and often chasing. Excellent if you want to frame yourself as the ideal provider, wait five dates for sex, and undergo heavy provider screening trying to get the girl (I hope you have an excellent job! Owning your own house won’t hurt too. Are you currently in the market for a wife and kids? I hope you are – because she’s checking!). Not so excellent if you want to shag her on your terms and be the one who decides whether the relationship proceeds or not.

The ’normal’ way in dating is generally always something that puts the leverage in the woman’s corner. My advice and the other advice on Girls Chase aims to move the leverage back to you.

But let’s say you want or need to pay. Perhaps:

You just really love dates that require someone to pay for them.

You HATE the awkwardness that comes from splitting bills.

You’re simply too much of a gentleman to ever not pay for a lady.

How do you pay for her but still manage to get the girl?

 

The Secret to Paying While Still Sleeping with Her
Let me let you in on a little secret…

In the last section when I talked about paying for women, did you pick up on the underlying theme about what paying says about the person paying and how it affects the dynamic?

I’ll spell it out for you here: the one who pays is investing. Further:

The MORE that person pays,

The BIGGER A DEAL the paying seems to be,

And the more UNEQUAL the exchange is,

… the GREATER an investment it is!

Investment plays a key role in both seduction and relationships. Invest too much more in her than she does you, and she will feel as though you’re chasing her. Invest too much less than her, however, and she’ll feel like it’s a one-sided relationship and start scaling back.

READ MORE: It's Not Your Investment in Her; It's Hers in You

Who invests and how much makes all the difference.

If you’re an old hand at investment balancing, you’ve probably clued into what our solutions to paying without having it hamstring your ability to bed girls are likely to be.

We have two (2) solutions:

Trivialize the act of paying to minimize your ‘investment footprint’

Position your paying as reciprocation for earlier investments on her part

Let’s take a closer look at each strategy.

 

Option 1: Minimize the Investment Footprint
Get that footprint as small as can be.

This is my recommended strategy for beginners and intermediates (and even much of the time for advanced playboys). Follow the Law of Least Effort when you pay for women and make the payment as much of a low effort non-issue as you possibly can.

Compare these two examples.

High investment payment:

You’re at a fancy restaurant. The waiter brings the check. You look at it, then try to hand it to your date. She does not take the check. “I thought you were paying?” she says. You balk and try to tell her it’s pretty expensive. You then mention that she ordered a lot more food than you did. Plus those two expensive glasses of wine! “You’re the one who wanted to come here,” she says. You complain that this is much of your paycheck for the week. She folds her arms and scowls. You sigh, take out a credit card, and, looking beaten, hand it to the waiter.

Low investment payment:

You’re at a fancy restaurant. After the meal’s finished, on a high point as your date is laughing, you excuse yourself to use the restroom. On the way there, you catch your waiter and tell him you’d like to pay. He grabs your check, you give him your card, then go to use the restroom. On the way out you find him again, sign for the payment, leave him his tip, take your card, and return to the table, all without the girl even knowing you paid. You stay at the restaurant another 30 minutes, laughing and talking, then suggest the two of you get out of there. As you’re leaving, your date remembers that you haven’t paid the check yet, but you casually say, “I got it earlier,” then immediately return the conversation to what it’d been about before she brought up the check.

Same restaurant, same amount of money, but in one of these it’s a massive investment on the guy’s part, and the other it’s an absolutely trivial one. These two scenarios set the man up for a completely different dynamic with his date.

Generally speaking, it is an excellent call to make your investment footprint around paying for dates as minimal as possible:

Pay for things ‘offscreen’ where you can. Don’t let her see or know you paid. She may not even bring it up/ask – in which case she’s likely forgotten about it entirely and ‘paying’ has been neutralized as a factor. If she does ask, you very casually mention you already got it, then keep going with the conversation from before she mentioned it.

Where not possible to pay ‘offscreen’, pay SUPER casually. Don’t do any of that “let her see the check”, “deliberate for a bit”, “discuss it” nonsense. When the check comes, you take it from the waiter, glance at it casually – or even skip the glance – and hand your money or card to the waiter right away, ideally without even looking at him, all while continuing to smile and talk with the girl as if you haven’t even consciously registered the check; you are just taking care of it on autopilot, like it’s the most natural thing in the world.

What both approaches do is position paying for the meal as ‘nothing’ for you. Because here’s the deal with investment: it is largely a subjective evaluation. The BIGGER A DEAL you make doing something, the more investment she views it as being for you. The less of a big deal you make it, conversely, the less of an investment she views it being for you.

This has add-on effects: a guy who very casually pays for things comes across as a guy who is materially comfortable. That’s attractive. You have enough money that you aren’t worried about money – in fact, you don’t even need to think about paying. If you’re otherwise a sexy man, this won’t derail you out of the lover zone; it just looks powerful. (while money can all too easily finger you as ‘husband material’, used correctly it can actually enhance lover value rather than detract from it)

You chillness around paying also marks you as very socially savvy. Most guys don’t know how to handle paying; they make it awkward, or act like the girl should be super grateful. Treating it like a non-issue tells the girl that you’re placing the real importance on your connection with her, and that the money side of things is comparatively unimportant to you. You look cool, and she feels special. Wins all around!

 

Option 2: Reward Her for Investment Served
She worked hard for you. You’re just saying “Thanks.”

The other option for paying is to frame your paying as a reward for investment she’s already given you. This should only be used by more advanced players. It’s very easy to get the calibration wrong and set a damaging frame.

For example, all these are “paid date rewards” that set terrible, anti-seductive frames:

She was busy, but finally made time for you. You’re paying for the date as a ‘reward’ for her doing so. This frames her as the prize – she gets free stuff merely for making time for you.

She has been affectionate with you, touching you and giving you little kisses. You’re paying for the date as a ‘reward’ for what a good girl she’s been. This frames her as the prize – she gets free stuff in exchange for giving you affection. Hope you like buying your girlfriends gifts whenever you want a chance to have sex, because that’s the dynamic you’re setting up here.

She’s been very attentive to you, listening to you talk, and pairing up with you rather than go with her friends. You’re paying for a meal as a ‘reward’ for what a loyal girl she’s been. This frames her as the prize – you pay for her attention and loyalty.

All these frames are atrocious. You’re far better off minimizing the paying – or getting her to pay – than shooting your own foot like this. Thus why I specify that this option is only for seasoned playboys who understand their investment scales.

Let’s look at a few actually valid ways to use this option to handle paying for a girl on a date:

She paid for your entry to a comedy club earlier in the night and drinks at the comedy club. You’re paying for the dinner after as a reward for her earlier investment: “Hey, I’ve got this one. Thanks for the drinks and club earlier.” This is good – it shows you noticed and appreciated her earlier investment, reminds her of that investment, and shows you value her enough to want to keep the investment scales balanced. +attainability

She defended you earlier against some people who were talking smack against you. She went to bat for you, protecting your honor and good name. Later, you pay for your date with her; as you hand the waiter the check, you tell her, “Thanks for protecting me back there. It means a lot.” Once again, you show you value her earlier investment, remind her of it, and are keeping the scales balanced. +attainability

You see the process here:

Earlier, she invested in some large, unusual way – either financially or really going out of her way to help you. This always needs to be something she’s already done, not something she’s promising to do or that you are hoping she ‘will’ do in the future.

When it comes time to pay, you verbally remind her of what she did earlier and thank her as you pay. This links your paying to her earlier investment and frames it as a reward.

You want to aim for your investment to feel like it is less of a big deal than hers was. Even if you are spending more money than she spent (e.g., she spent $40 on the comedy club + drinks, while you’re spending $70 on dinner), if you make the money ‘not a big deal’ to you but frame her paying earlier as an appreciated and unusual event, it makes her earlier actions feel like a bigger deal – and thus, a larger investment than yours. You’re just trying to even out the scales a bit… but she’s still invested more.

Remember: in a seduction (and, later, in a relationship), we don’t want her getting too far ahead of us, investment-wise… but we do want her more invested than we are!

 

Wrap Up: Paying for Girls
Handle the check right, and you’ll walk out of there with the girl — ready to head back to your place.

You can extend this same logic we used for paying for dates here to paying for anything else for women, too. Drinks, rides, entrance fees, you name it. Most of the time, you should opt for ‘minimizing the investment footprint’.

You will not always have some earlier large, unusual investment of hers it makes sense to reward her for by paying. Even if she’s invested a lot, if it it’s not investment unusual for a courtship or a relationship, it is not something you want to reward by paying. For instance, if her investment has been qualifying herself to you heavily, self-isolating from her friends with you, or touching you lots, as excellent as those are, they are what she SHOULD be doing as the seduction progresses, and are NOT things you should be rewarding financially! (the reward for those things is that she gets you, not ‘other nice things’!)

If you are a more experienced playboy, and you recognize she has invested in you in some larger and unusual-for-a-typical-seduction way, in that case you can opt to use our second option here, where you ‘reward her for investment served’. It’s not necessary to do this – there are plenty of ways to reward women besides paying for them – however, it is an option.

How do you sleep with girls after you paid for the date? Well that’s simple enough: you invite them home and take them to bed! If you did everything else right, this step should be no sweat. (if you are still sweating at this step, then in that case you may not be doing everything else right. So check your process… or maybe pick up my One Date System so you can start really nailing those dates… then nailing the girl after the date 😉)

Now you know how to pay for women in cool, smooth, seductive ways – and unlike how it goes for most normal men, actually have it help your seductive aims, rather than hinder them.

Yours,

Chase Amante

Title: Don't Change Your Approach to Girls Just Because They're Beautiful | Girls Chase
content:
When a girl’s beautiful, your instincts will scream to play it safe: go slow! Don’t be risqué! But if you WANT her, you must treat her the SAME as other girls!

Bit of a public service announcement here, but you should not be changing your approach to women simply because they’re beautiful.

Lots of guys do this; in fact, it seems to be hardcoded into men. If you’ve gone through my free 7-day mini course (and if you haven’t, you definitely should – you can take the Girl Q quiz and sign up for the Girls Chase Email Newsletter to begin receiving the mini course here), you’re familiar with the Mating Sociometer.

Sociometer theory states that we adjust our behavior to match our status relative to the status of the person we’re dealing with. The result is men whose hearts beat faster for beautiful girls behaving more reserved and treating those girls as ‘higher status than me’.

Yet any Girls Chase reader who’s been reading even a few weeks should know: doing anything that frames or positions yourself as lower status than the woman you’re courting spells attraction DEATH! Girls go for men they view as higher status than them, not lower!

But that leaves guys with a conundrum: how do you override those instincts to treat her ‘special’ and ‘unique’ when those instincts are so powerful and it’s so hard to get yourself to ‘behave normally’ around her?

Beside this, there’s also what your instinctive brain will be shouting at you: “We HAVE to treat her special! Think there’s any way she’ll go for what all those other girls go for? No way!”

Is that instinct correct?

It’s NOT correct – for reasons we are just about to review.

Note: this article aims at men who are already able to get together consistently with at least somewhat cute girls; i.e., men who have a working process down. If you do not have a working, repeatable process down with girls yet, you may still enjoy this article, but it won’t be as helpful for you – YET!

 

The Same Game Works Across Beauty Levels

Different types of girls can be more or less responsive to different types of approaches – this is true. Some girls eat up certain archetypes of men that repel other girls, for instance.

As I lay out in the One Date System, some girls are looking for much more similarity and connection. Other girls are looking for more excitement and arousal. Others just need you to lead (girls who are ready to comply). Depending on what type she is, tailoring your approach to her gets you better RESULTS and a more likely good OUTCOME (i.e., that girl in your bed / in a relationship with you).

Over the years, I have discussed other ways of gauging a girl’s type and calibrating your approach to it.

One thing you may have picked up on if you’re perceptive is that I have almost never told you, “Do this if she is only somewhat cute, but do THIS if she is exceptionally beautiful!” That is because what works on a girl of middling attractiveness also works on girls who are beautiful.

As we’ve shown repeatedly on Girls Chase, opinions on looks are extremely subjective. Men often have trouble believing this until they see it for themselves; we all tend to assume there ‘must be consensus’ about what we believe is beautiful; we are all very wrong. You can read those two articles I just linked for examples (check the comments); or check out these two threads I posted on X and see how variously guys voted on the women.

Do you believe there is such a thing as an “objective 10”?

Rank the women in the image below from MOST to LEAST ATTRACTIVE.

Let’s see how your rankings compare to others’! pic.twitter.com/EOFV54XLFz

— Girls Chase 🏃‍♀️💨 (@GirlsChase) December 26, 2024

Average relative ranking for each girl from our poll the other day, plotted.

Note that rankings are relative (i.e., how does each girl compare to the others), rather than on a 1-to-10 scale.

Do you agree with the rankings of your fellow men? pic.twitter.com/H9RkTftewf

— Girls Chase 🏃‍♀️💨 (@GirlsChase) December 28, 2024

Is there an “Objective Female 10”? PART II

Here, we compare apples 🍎 to apples 🍎: race, hair, age, expression, angle.

Rank the women in the image below from MOST to LEAST ATTRACTIVE.

Let’s see how your rankings compare to others’! pic.twitter.com/MCh9qRZyvJ

— Girls Chase 🏃‍♀️💨 (@GirlsChase) December 29, 2024

🏆 FINAL RANKINGS 🏆

Want to know how your tastes compare to your fellow man’s?

Here’s the ordering, from highest to lowest ranked, of our 9 blondes.

Rankings as determined by YOU, THE PEOPLE.

How close are the average rankings to how YOU’d rank these girls? pic.twitter.com/z015CzkKel

— Girls Chase 🏃‍♀️💨 (@GirlsChase) January 12, 2025

Or, if you want to see it yourself, assemble pics of three to seven women you consider ‘absolute stunners’ and share them with your buddies asking if they agree that these women are some of the most beautiful women they’ve ever seen. You will then be utterly gob smacked at their reactions as you discover that ‘stunners’ for you are ‘just okay’ for your buds. You will be equally gob smacked when they try to ‘straight you out’ by sending you their own ‘stunners’… whom for you will be middling at best!

Because of the subjectivity of beauty, those girls you think of as ‘drop dead gorgeous absolute stunners’ regularly have men interacting with them who treat them as ‘just kind of cute’ or ‘just okay’. And sure – there are girls who are ‘consensus beauties’ who are more beautiful than average. These girls know they’re beautiful… but even still, not every single man treats them as knockout. Perhaps no more than 30% of men will see any given girl as a ‘total knockout’, among even the most ‘consensus beautiful’ of women!

There are also the ‘made up hotties’ (many of whom are actually quite plain without their makeup, hair, and cleavage on display), who know/expect men to treat them like princesses when they have all their kit on and are in full ‘pose for the camera’ mode.

READ MORE: How to Tell a Girl Who's Beautiful from One Who's Made Up

Do not be fooled!

But even ‘makeup hotties’ go outside without their kit on sometimes (like when they run to the grocer’s) and get treated like totally average women a lot of the time. They even get hit on by guys sometimes during such moments who treat them as ‘only kind of cute’, and typically know they are, in truth, only kind of cute, and treat these men approaching them that way as the sincerest approaches they receive.

Every girl, no matter her beauty or ugliness to you, fields approaches from SOME guys who treat her like the most beautiful girl in the universe, some OTHER guys who treat her like the most middling girl in the universe, and still other guys who treat her as kind of cute but not amazing. She may get more of one type than the other, but every single girl gets SOME of EACH of these.

Your mission, as a man approaching her, is to hit the right ‘Goldilocks’ note where you are showing enough interest in her, but not too much.

 

What’s the Right Amount of Interest to Show?

This actually changes somewhat by the situation you’re meeting a girl in.

We’ll discuss that more in a moment. But first: it does not change because of how beautiful she is, but rather because of the circumstances you meet her under plus her pride and your competition for her at that time.

When meeting a girl in a relatively neutral situation (as you will usually during day game, or early on into the night at a bar or nightclub before other guys have gotten drunk enough to start hitting on everything that moves, or when you are on a dating app and encounter a girl who has newly joined and not yet begun drowning beneath a MAN FLOOD), you want to show moderate interest in her appearance.

Think of James Bond commenting on a woman’s looks: “Sure, you’re attractive,” he says in a profoundly casual (yet sexy) way. It’s more of an honest admission + gentle flirtation, as if admiring a piece of art. He does not say, “Wowee-wow, you are GORGEOUS!” nor does he try to act as if he doesn’t find her at all attractive. He acknowledges she’s attractive, does not admit HOW attractive he finds her (that part he leaves mysterious… remember, girls like mystery and intrigue), and acts otherwise nonchalant about her appearance.

This should be your default vibe to how you approach women’s beauty:

Sure, she’s attractive. But other than that, you aren’t that impressed by her… YET!

Why aren’t you that impressed by her?

Well, there’s a lot more ‘getting to know her’ first: she needs to pass your screens, show you she’s cool, show you she can invest, and just generally move through the courtship process with you.

At that point, once she’s done all that, and ultimately gone to bed with you, you’ll probably be a bit more impressed. (of course, then she’s still got to keep you around and seduce you into a relationship. That requires more impressing on her part! This girl has her work cut out!)

Remember: you’re the prize. She should be chasing YOU! Not the reverse!

(you’ll still be making the moves. But all your moves are designed to hook her deeper in and cause her to chase you to help further the seduction. You’re in charge; she’s responding by chasing and investing)

 

You DO Change Your Approach Based on the Circumstances
This girl is likely going to require a little strategy to approach.

Here’s the part that gets a lot of guys tangled up.

Imagine these three scenarios, and how you’d treat girls different in each of them:

A cute girl you meet in a class have or the office.

A stunning girl you encounter alone in a grocery store.

A makeup-caked hottie with extreme cleavage surrounded by men in a nightclub.

You can probably feel that each of these girls requires a slightly different approach, but how do you put your finger on what the differences should be?

As a matter of fact:

Girl 1 requires your normal approach.

Girl 2 requires your normal approach.

Girl 3 requires you to be more aloof, socially proofed, teasing, pattern interrupting, and to create more open loops and hooks.

Girls 1 and 2, even though you meet them in very different circumstances and to you their looks are far apart from each other, require the same basic approach.

Girl 3 requires a different approach however, even if underneath her makeup she’s actually LESS attractive than either Girls 1 or 2, due to her different circumstances.

This article is not a tutorial on calibrating your approach to different girls based on their circumstances (if you like those attention seeker type girls like Girl 3, be sure to check out Alek Rolstad’s series on picking up attention seeker girls). Instead, we’re just demonstrating a point: you should not change your approach due to beauty; only to adapt to circumstances.

The more men she has around her right now competing for her, and the more people vying for her attention in general (even girlfriends and platonic friends who just want to talk to her), the more you need to use harder game techniques to hook her in and captivate/monopolize her attention.

 

This Only Matters for Her Circumstances in the Moment

The only thing that matters here is in-the-moment circumstances.

Maybe that cute girl in your class or at work is on a dating app with 500 matches and an inbox flooded with men drooling all over her. That doesn’t matter when you meet her in class/at work because she’s not on the app and is instead in ‘real life’.

In real life, she is just some ordinary chick nobody really cares about or acknowledges most of the time, with guys around her treating like she is just an average, sort-of cute woman. Further, when you meet her, no other guys are competing for her; she is in a one-on-one conversation with you, with zero other people competing for her attention. She will assess you on your merits, with those 500 thirsty guys in her inbox totally pushed out of her mind for now (much to their chagrin. Poor thirsty app guys! If only they could’ve met her in person…).

Likewise, if you meet the made up club queen at a metro station on her way to the nail salon she works at Tuesday morning, she’ll be dressed down, average looking, and ignored by all the commuters other than you – and your approach will feel special and sincere; she’ll actually really enjoy meeting you if you are cool; even if she might’ve totally ignored you had you tried hitting on her in her club, in the metro, you are likely to get the number and a date.

A woman’s circumstances do not carry over. They are limited to the time and venue in which she experiences them. Once she leaves that venue, closes that app, or steps away from those people admiring her in the club, all that goes away and she adapts to whatever her current circumstances are.

Even if she’s beautiful, and even if, in other circumstances, every guy around wants her…

The circumstance she’s in RIGHT NOW is KING!

 

What to Do If Your Instincts Are Going Crazy
The pressure is ON and your instincts are going into overdrive… so WHATREYOUGONNADO???

Okay, now here’s the deal:

Your Mating Sociometer is not good at distinguishing between girls who seem high status because you personally find them very beautiful versus girls who seem high status because based on circumstance they’re positioned as very high status.

The reaction will be the same in you, whether she is gorgeous to you walking down a sidewalk alone despite her conservative clothing, or whether she looks enticing because she has a lot of her body on display with twenty other guys grouped around her fighting for her attention.

What you must do is recognize nervousness worth listening to versus nervousness worth overriding.

Cases in point:

If you see a gorgeous woman walking down a sidewalk and immediately think, “Oh no way, I couldn’t talk to her; she’d NEVER want a guy like me!” those are nerves you need to ignore. You need to deprioritize her beauty and treat her exactly the same as you would a girl of average looks: if you want to approach her, approach – in the exact same way you normally would!

If you see an attractive girl surrounded by fawning men and a bunch of her friends, and think, “Oh whoa, how could I even talk to that girl? She’d just reject me,” THOSE are nerves worth listening to – they are alerting you to her high status in those circumstances. If you want to approach her, you need to find a good angle and leverage your ‘A game’ to come in at her level or higher.

Let’s assume for the sake of argument that most of the girls you get nerves for are not girls in circumstances that confer higher situational status on them, but rather simply are girls you find very attractive.

When that’s the case, you must be able to override these nerves and come in using your usual way to approach girls.

 

Tried and Tested for the Win

Assuming you are an active dater and have been going around approaching girls and refining your craft (and if not, you may want to try my 4 approaches per day challenge to get yourself into gear), you have probably figured out an approach that works reasonably well for you with girls.

It may not always be 100% consistent, but it gets you opens, creates attraction, and gets girls onto instant dates, dates, or back to your place. It gets you lovers and relationships. It’s a dependable process.

What many men do when they find a girl they find very beautiful is to throw all that out and WING IT, based on ‘instinct’. But riddle me this, Batman: how far did instinct get you with all those other girls before you sorted your process out? Not very far, right? So why would instinct serve you better with really beautiful girls? Do you have a special instinct for beautiful girls that you lack for less beautiful girls? Let me tell you: you do not, and if you abandon your process because a girl is ‘too beautiful’, you’re highly unlikely to get her.

The same stuff that works on ‘7’s also works on ‘9’s. You do not change your process simply because a girl is better-looking to you. You use the same process, doing the same things, the same ways you’re accustomed to.

Calibrate to the girl, of course; if you’re using my SAC model, or VAC, use those to adjust your courtship as you go. You are not being a non-responsive blockhead.

But you want tried and tested when you deal with particularly gorgeous girls.

You want to treat these girls the same as any girl.

That’s because, just like every other girl, really beautiful girls meet men who treat them like any girl.

They meet high status men who are used to girls of their level of beauty (or for whom they may not even be particularly beautiful, these men preferring girls of a different look from theirs).

If you want to come across as a cool, relaxed, experienced man who gets girls like them, you want to treat them like any girl, and use your same process. That is how you get the stunners; NOT by treating them like they are ‘special’.

 

Why ‘Tried and Tested’ Doesn’t Always Work

Something I’ve seen often with men over the years is that they claim that “using their tried and tested method with really beautiful girls do not work.” They suspect that there is some missing piece, like that they have to be less sexual, or more sexual; they need to come in higher value, or perhaps more subtle; they need to move faster, or they need to move slower; whatever it is, SOMETHING needs to change!

Occasionally I’ve seen guys dealing with this sticking point shocked to watch a guy they know who gets with all kinds of girls get together with a girl they find BEAUTIFUL by using his same exact process he always uses. Sometimes they decide that they just need to learn this guy’s process, because clearly his process works on all levels of girls’ looks. Other times, though, they clue in to the REAL problem:

That their nerves have been seeping in and eroding their seduction effectiveness with beautiful girls!

Even if you have a tried and tested process you use with girls, if you get too nervous around very beautiful women, you are highly likely to:

Subconsciously move a lot slower and more cautious than you normally would

Subconsciously sanitize your approach, removing any too risqué moves & flirtation

Subconsciously ‘good girl frame’ this girl, treating her like a too-pure princess

Subconsciously hesitate to escalate or not escalate at all, deciding to ‘wait’ till later

The Sociometer is alive and well, putting the brakes on your seduction, warping your regular process into something far less effective than it normally is.

It’s not that your process does not work on gorgeous girls. It’s that your process when slowed down and neutered does not work!

If you want to fix that, read these two guides:

Why Do Guys Screw Up When the Girl Is Really Hot?

Afraid to Talk to Hot Girls? Know THESE 5 Key Things

 

Don’t Change Things ‘Cause She’s Beautiful
Use your standard approach, remain chill, and stay the course.

Changing things just because she’s beautiful doesn’t work.

You won’t magically devise a better process by ‘going on instinct’ doing stuff you’re not used to doing with girls you’re not used to doing it with. All you will do is sabotage your results.

You need to treat beautiful girls the same way you treat other girls: the same approach, the same process, the same jokes, the same touch, the same everything.

Calibrate to the individual girl, of course. Tweak and adjust based on the feedback she’s giving you. But do not go in assuming that since she’s beautiful she needs a slower or more sanitized approach – she doesn’t.

If your Mating Sociometer is firing off, telling you, “Whoa! This girl’s high status! Proceed with caution!” you need to be able to step back and ask yourself whether

You feel that way because there is a legitimate circumstantial reason giving her high status that necessitates you carefully strategizing your approach so you come in the right way, OR

You feel that way just because she’s very good-looking and you aren’t at a level of abundance yet where you are used to girls like that.

If it’s the latter: then you need to chill yourself out, calm yourself down, and figure out a way to approach her without all those nerves – so that you do things properly with her.

Follow your process. Treat her like any girl. Don’t throw the baby out with the bath water by discarding your battle-tested approach to getting girls. Once you’ve got something that works, it works – unless the circumstances change.

As useful as instincts can be, this is one of those situations where they can sabotage you, and you are better off working around them… at least until you reach the point where you have so much abundance, and so much experience bedding very beautiful girls, that even these girls can’t shake you anymore.

At that point, my friend, you become unstoppable!

Chase Amante

Title: An Opening Style: Hook Dropping | Girls Chase
content:
Open girls in a way that avoids rejection and lets girls open to an approach let you know they are. Just drop a hook around her – then see if she bites.

This post by Glow originally appeared on our forum here.

A simple way to open that I like to use is what can be labelled hook dropping. I share it cause it can give a little nuance to how we open that shapes some ease on the opening.

Hook Dropping: To drop a particular sentence to a bypassing woman or one standing next to me to see if she bites. As such you put it out there and she can answer it or react to it and you get an initial mini-hook and a read of her interest-level to work from.​

Often responses easily lead to conversations and seductions.

 

Hook Dropping Example

Yesterday me and a colleague were walking and a gorgeous woman walks slower in front of us. We walk around her and she squeezes of a bit to the side in her own world. As we pass her I look back and say, "Sorry if our pace stressed you in any way".

Her response: "No worries I was just in my own head with a million thoughts." Her vibe was warm and connective.

Me: "A million thoughts???" (done with raised eye brows and a playful smile)

Gorgeous: "Yeah im looking for an apartment.."

Glow: continues and elicits deeper. Later we had drinks and she ended up at mine.

 

Where to Hook Drop

This can be done as outlined in day game pass-bys, side by side openings, but also works well with mingling style room game where you mingle around and drop hooks left and right to see if chicks bite. It's a lot less stressful way to manage room gaming or an opening. I rarely mingle anymore as I just sniper in where I want to aka materialise next to some woman of delight and then side open. Also here it works great.

The idea is that you shoot it out like a true fisherman and see how she responds. I've talked about how the opening just needs to open - not impress, not overpower, not anything really for many situations. The response to it is the key to manage and elicitation techniques work well here to easily transfer into more like I demonstrated. It's especially good for more passive day game or early stage night game.

It works like a charm as a soft open that then via elicitation opens her up for you. As you get leads from her you stimulate progressively and work her via subtle escalations.

 

A Few Variations (to Fit Situations)

You can easily use reality paces and truisms ( have you ever noticed how...>>insert RP<<) ).

Also often the hen of a set will answer while other girls in set will be passive but silent and obviously more affected and here set re-positionings etc. can be smart to then engage the right target after managing the set appropriately.

My aim is to just open, amplify their energy via their responses, then LEAVE to create a Cinderella-like snowballing effect by igniting them to make them loose it right after. I mainly focus on girls that almost hold me in set which will happen along "the mingle rolls".
