Another nuance is that at more sexualised hours girls will be a lot more carefree and react more as such. Here I hardly have time to drop hooks as the sexual tension does all the work for me and typical hook dropping could be a step back in the wrong direction or it needs adaption. But hm... let me just consider those scenarios for sexualised game level hook drops... might be interesting actually.

Inspiring to re-see Cajuns rock solid stacking and leading things while rolling with the set. His confidence is one to steal :) Gives me ideas for refinement of my own. Thanks for the share.

 

Responding to Girls' Responses

I've started doing situational openers whenever I go indirect after reading your hooking cheating sheet @Teevster

Sometimes though, a girl will respond with something minimal like "yes" or a nod of the head and I wonder if I should keep walking if I get one of those non-committal responses.

The times that I keep talking to these girls, I rarely get their number.

I wanted to know if you guys engage with these small responses or just keep walking, are they worth the effort or not?

You already had good answers but here's my take!

1) If I am strategically mingling or doing "room game" I don't care much about individual responses - my aim is to go in, drop hooks, amplify the energy and then LEAVE. This means I would presumably already be sorta leaving when she responds. The effect of this aims to with the girl create a takeaway effect - that she looses the connection by my control - a feeling of loss, and a second effect is to create a smoke and mirror effect that makes OTHER girls see me as someone cool, who creates/has multiple social ties as they just see me slowly rolling in and speaking to many girls/people along having a cool presence. The strategy is to game the room, not the girls. I combine this with an A lister presence just sorta floating through. Then collect in later or when I hit something I like as some girls will pull me in later or engage me.

2) If I materialise with a particular girl and the girl is HOT I might do either of the following:

Amplifying up the energy by responding to her response to my opener. Even a slight no can be ignited via a raise in energy and e.g. shifting to a challenging response that dramatises the energy. I can rip neutral style girls out of their shell this way. I'll see if i can repost one of my old nextASF posts that outlines it.

More calmly activating her via shooting reads - a.k.a. I , + setup pacing and leading with a stronger perspective that resonates with her values - would often need more but this is a way to flip these girls if I choose to go in and "work her". Here micro nuances of her state are key.

3) If I enter and have time I might vibe bomb her before which can at times make her a lil' uncertain but i know she just need to collect herself a lil' and I route things to work with her withdrawn energy - sorta opening her up like a flower that just withdrew. This often entails a part warm, part confident sorta leading her making her feel at ease. Strategy is to make our convo fun and interesting which I can manage by 1) making her respond to me (spitting game) 2) making her feel comfy/having fun/disarming.

4) There are many other reactions and strategies, just to give you a bit of variety to show there's a bit more to it especially dependent on your strategy at the moment it happens.

The game situation here is how to work with/turn a yellow girl which is a key skill to obtain.

If I'm more laid back/smashed state I mainly focus on green girls with better responses and just ignore girls like this.

 

Why Hook Drops Work Less Well Later on in Night Game
Hook drops: somewhat less effective in later night game. But why?

I also noticed that in the later hours of the night, this strategy is less efficient because girls are probably drunk and your simple "drop by comment" is not stimulating enough to really catch her attention. Just a theory.

Do you have any theories?

-Teevster

Cool, yeah my theory is that its about later in the night states for chicks somewhat similar to your thoughts:

There's more chaos, sets are mixed up and all running across each other which makes them "in momentum" and a little more tunnel visioned.
Some girls are more wild - unfolding states looking for guys who are leaders and potent.
Some girls are more carefree, don't care about regular blah, wants to hook up with someone interesting.
Shields are higher.
Some might be drunk as you say
Some are sleepy/tired/deenergised/bored
Some are paranoid from the chaos and feeling of social uncertainty.

Point being the volume is turned higher and the chaos level creates a less attentive, less "polite", less open crowd. More primal, more raw, more shielded on some areas, more sexually charged, more unfolding. I just sorta see the totality of how girls states are changed to later in the night type states makes them give us less attention and demand a lil' more attention capture.

Is this something that resonates with you?

I find you can still do pings later at night, but they have to be more emphatic pings.

e.g., instead of just dropping a casual, "Man, this bartender's got some speed," you need to get close to her, ideally get some eye contact, and say, "MAN, this bartender is SWIFT, isn't he?" and point your thumb right at the guy demonstrably.

Then if she isn't interested, she'll just be like, "Yeah..." and turn away. If she is she'll be like, "OMG, he totally is!" and then you chat her up.

Of course the problem is it feels like a bigger rejection at that point if you get right close to her and she denies it.

What seems to happen is as the night goes on, girls' awareness radii shrink. I'm sure the alcohol is part of it, but I think another part of it is the chaos. Earlier on it's not as chaotic and girls are paying closer attention to everything going on around them. Later at night they've been bombarded with stimuli for hours and have really focused in on whatever they're focused on. So you can be right next to them going, "This bartender sure is swift!" but if it doesn't seem directed at them it just gets filtered right out as background noise.

Ends up being you have to get eye contact, make some gestures, etc., so she knows you are definitely talking to her, and then she pays attention.

Chase

Interesting point and details on stimuli overload - cool.

Title: Does Touch Guard Against Sexual Infidelity? | Girls Chase
content:
Touch has several functions in long-term romantic relationships. One of them may be this: that it appears to help guard against sexual unfaithfulness.

While researching the next chapter of my book The Roses of Romantic Attraction, I came across a study on how couples touch each other that puzzled me at first. Here’s the abstract:

The effects of relational stage, intimacy, and gender on touch were examined. Participants were 270 partners from 135 couples involved in a heterosexual romantic relationship. Results indicated that touch varies as a function of relational stage. An examination of relational stage and subjects' perceptions of how much they touched their partner and how much their partner touched them generally indicated an asymptotic relationship. Specifically, men's and women's perceptions of how much they touched their partners, and women's perceptions of how much their partners touched them, increased from the casually dating to the seriously dating stage and then leveled off for seriously dating, engaged, and married couples. Men's perceptions of how much their partners touched them increased from the casually dating to the seriously dating stage then decreased from the seriously dating to the married stage. Relational intimacy was also curvilinearly related to self and partner perceptions of touch. Because there were no significant interaction effects between stage and gender, or intimacy and gender, the curvilinear effects of relational stage and intimacy on touch are generalizable to both men and women.

That is to say:

Men touch women more in serious relationships than they do in casual relationships. Men continue to touch women at the same rate as the relationship moves from serious to engaged, then to married.

Women also touch men more in serious relationships than they do in casual relationships. However, women begin to touch men less again as the relationship moves from serious to engaged, then to married.

Why would women’s touch rates on men increase as things get more serious, then fall again as they commitment levels raise further, even as men’s remain stable at higher levels of commitment?

I considered a few possibilities. One was that after a man passes a commitment point, where the woman knows she has him, she loses some of her attraction to him because she ‘has him’ now and he’s not as exciting/sexy/a challenge. But why would men’s touch/attraction stay stable? Are men forever chasing in their relationships? Some are, but it’s not the average.

Another possibility was a selection bias effect, where the men the study polled who were engaged/married were more likely to be ‘husband material’ guys less attractive to women, so they get touched less than the sexy serious relationship guys who put off commitment. It didn’t make sense why men’s touch on women would remain stable at all the more serious relationship stages though. Or why women would also touch less when casual.

I began to suspect that what’s actually happening is that people are using touch to guard against sexual infidelity – something that for both sexes becomes more important to guard against in a serious relationship than a casual one, but which falls in importance for women once engaged/married… but not for men.

I believe the research backs me up on this, too.

 

How Sexual Infidelity Fears Vary Across Relationship Stages

In a casual relationship, people are obviously less worried about sexual infidelity than they are in a serious one. If touch is used to guard against sexual infidelity, this could be one reason we’d see less touch in casual relationships (where sexual infidelity is both more common and less important) and more in serious ones.

The more serious a relationship gets, the more invested the two lovers are, and the more they have riding on the outcome of the relationship. Deeper into a relationship, infidelity has far weightier consequences:

You find out your casual friend with benefits (FWB) is sleeping with someone else? Well, you expected that anyway, didn’t you? That’s what FWBs do! They sleep around with people! I just hope you’ve been using protection.

You find out your serious girlfriend, fiancée, or wife is sleeping with someone else? Well now that is a much bigger problem, my friend. A MUCH bigger one. Unless that is you happen to be among the minority that enjoys open relationships.

Yet we know things change when you pass a commitment point.

Obviously, for women, things change in a way they do not change for men:

Past the engagement/marriage commitment points, men remain as devoted to touching their women as they were before them (i.e., in a serious relationship).

Yet women past the engagement/marriage commitment point scale back touching their men to levels below what they did in merely serious (but uncommitted) relationships.

Humans are animals and animals are lazy. They do not expend energy they don’t need to. All the extra touch men exhibit in serious, engaged, and married relationships, and that women exhibit in serious (but not engaged or married) relationships, must thus have a function.

For whatever reason, men continue to view this function as an important one in engaged and married relationships, while women do not, and can scale back their efforts.

What is the reason men keep touch up past the commitment point, but women scale their touch back down?

Well to understand that, we need to understand the function of TOUCH.

 

What Is the Function of Relationship Touch?

I’m going to skip looking at how touch is used in seduction here (where potential lovers-to-be use it to communicate intimacy, escalate, or alternately create space/hit the brakes) and solely focus on its role in relationship maintenance.

First off, touch is tied to feelings of intimacy in a relationship:

Love was significantly and positively associated with affectionate touch behaviors in both studies and this result was replicated regardless of the inclusion of potentially relevant factors as controls. Altogether, our data strongly suggest that affectionate touch is a relatively stable characteristic of human romantic relationships that is robustly and reliably related to the degree of reported love between partners.

You might say “People touch because they feel love” but then why waste the effort if the touch itself does nothing? No – the touch is part of the love feedback loop. You feel love, so you touch; when you touch, she gets the message, “He loves me,” which makes her feel more loved (and, assuming she wants that herself, buoys up her own love for you in turn).

People with stronger feelings of love and affection also cheat less; those who feel a ‘deficit of love’ are more likely to seek it out with someone else.

Touch also leads to greater relationship satisfaction:

In Study 1, greater kissing frequency was associated with greater individual well-being, and these links were especially pronounced in the most satisfying relationships. In Study 2, participants who were randomly assigned to imagine receiving affectionate touch from their spouse anticipated greater individual well-being (less stress and greater life satisfaction) and relational benefits (greater perceived partner affection, state security, cognitive interdependence, and relationship quality). These benefits were stronger among people with moderate or high relationship satisfaction but observed even for the subset of individuals (approximately one-third of the sample) who rated their relationships as “distressed.”

A touchy relationship is a more satisfying relationship.

Relationship satisfaction reduces infidelity, albeit much more so in women:

50% of unfaithful men are unhappy with their relationships but the other 50% are happy

66% of unfaithful women are unhappy with their relationships while only 34% are happy

The 2022 General Social Survey found that around 85% of married women and 83% of married men ages 18-55 report being “pretty happy” or “very happy.” Only 15% of married women and 17% of married men ages 18-55 are “not too happy.”

By combining these two statistics, we discover that:

Unhappily married men are 4.9x more likely to cheat than happily married men

Unhappily married women are 11x more likely to cheat than unhappily married women

It would appear if you want to prevent a woman from cheating on you, her relationship happiness plays an important role!

From the studies above, we see that touch creates in-love feelings and raises relationship satisfaction, both of which are protective against infidelity.

There’s more, too: as it turns out, lovers can use touch as a means of reassuring jealous partners:

Anxious attachment was associated with high levels of jealousy, and touch was an effective buffer against jealous feelings for individuals high in anxious attachment.

What are they reassuring jealous partners of when they touch them?

The only thing jealousy is about: unfaithfulness.

Touch is used to communicate to a worried partner, “Don’t worry; I’m here. I’m not going to cheat.”

Putting all the pieces together, it appears strongly likely that one of the primary roles of touch in an ongoing romantic relationship is to reduce the odds of infidelity.

If this is the case (and it appears to be the case), why then would women cut back on their infidelity prevention strategies after passing a commitment point?

Don’t women care about losing their husbands and fiancés?

 

Male vs. Female Infidelity Concerns

If you’re a long-time Girls Chase reader, or you’re educated in the female psychology and relationship dynamics space more generally, you are probably aware of the divergence in what men and women prioritize infidelity-wise.

Numerous studies have shown that

Men care more about and are more hurt by women’s SEXUAL infidelity

Women care more about and are more hurt by men’s EMOTIONAL infidelity

You don’t want her fucking someone else.

She doesn’t want you to fall in love with someone else.

We can extrapolate out a little farther from these:

You don’t want her to cuckold you, getting pregnant by another man while staying with you and tricking you into thinking it’s yours (greatest male fear).

She doesn’t want you to fall in love with another woman and run off, abandoning her and any offspring she may have with you (greatest female fear).

(and yes, I know there are sexually laissez-faire, love-focused men who are more hurt by women’s emotional than sexual infidelity, and there are high testosterone, sex-focused women more hurt by men’s sexual than emotional infidelity. We’re talking the norms, which are going to be the case for the vast majority of people)

What changes with engagement and marriage that lessens the fears around infidelity for women, but does not lessen these fears for men?

Simply this:

For HER, past the commitment point, you are now socially and legally bound to her, not to mention have given her a high investment sign of commitment. She feels much safer that you love her and are not going to fall in love with another woman; and even if you did, it would be difficult for you to simply run off, and much more likely that she would ‘win’ against another woman in being able to keep you. She can relax some of her vigilance about trying to guard against you cheating on her.

On the other hand, for YOU, past the commitment point, you are just as invested – even MORE invested, in fact – in her, and her getting pregnant by another man would be extremely bad for you. It would be messy, you’d have to go through an entire divorce just to get away from her and her cuckoo child, potentially not find out until after years of investment that one or more of your children was not your own, and be forced to rebuild from scratch. You CANNOT relax your vigilance about trying to guard against her cheating on you.

So, she can ease up on touch post-commitment. You must not, though.

If you fuck a few other girls, it’s not the end of the world to her. Her BIG fear is you fall in love with another girl and run off or divert a bunch of your resources to that woman and away from herself/your children with her. This is a REAL RISK for her in a serious-yet-uncommitted relationship. But once you pass a commitment point with her it’s a lot less likely to occur. She is (or feels) ‘safer’.

For your part, engagement and marriage offer you no such protection. If she fucks another guy or two after getting engaged or married to you, it is a BIG PROBLEM. So, just like you took more steps to avoid her being unfaithful once things got serious than you probably did with girls you dated casually, you will continue to take those steps once she becomes your fiancée, and, later, your wife.

 

Cool Touch Effect: Touch Recipients Get Greater Reassurance
It boosts her feelings more when you touch her than when she touches you.

I’ll give you one more study that puts a neat little bow on our ‘touch as an anti-infidelity tool’ hypothesis here.

Here is a 2017 study on who gets stronger feelings: the one who does the touching or the one who’s being touched?

Both stroking the partner and self-stroking were performed within a velocity range optimal for activating C-tactile cutaneous afferents. Being stroked, stroking the partner, and self-stroking were all perceived as pleasant. However, being stroked entailed the significantly highest pleasantness ratings, and being stroked was the only condition that significantly decreased heart rate. Individuals in satisfying relationships were more pleased to be touched by their partner and showed a greater decline in heart rate when being touched.

So:

It feels good both to touch and be touched

Being touched feels much better than doing the touching

Being touched is the only one that calms a troubled heart

In other words, receiving touch feels much better and is far more reassuring.

We arrive at a synergistic effect between male-female touching in committed (engaged/married) relationships:

The man touches the woman to calm her, satisfy her, and raise her love and commitment levels and protect against sexual infidelity from her.

The woman receiving the man’s touch takes it as an indication of his love for her (recall our earlier studies: touch shows love; men touch her more when they love her), which reassures her of his ongoing emotional fidelity to her. He is not going to touch much if he’s in-love with someone else; him touching her tells her she still has his heart.

The man touching the woman helps hedge against both sexes’ infidelity fears: it lowers the risk of female sexual infidelity and professes the male’s emotional fidelity.

Why do women touch more in serious relationships then drop off past commitment?

A serious, but uncommitted relationship is the relationship in which women are at the greatest risk of losing a man due to sexual competitors. She is highly invested in him in a serious relationship, but has far less assurance he cannot just run off. If he starts fucking other women, he may fall in love and dump her. Past the commitment point, she no longer needs to worry as much about sexual infidelity as a ‘gateway drug’ to emotional infidelity (her real concern), so long as he continues to touch her and reassure her of his emotional fidelity.

And that is how the cookie crumbles.

 

Does Touch Guard Against Sexual Infidelity? It Appears to Do So

If ‘perpetual victim’ men read this article, the FIRST thing they will focus on is, “Men have to do more work in a marriage than women, touching them after women stop touching as much! Marriage protects women’s interests, and not men’s. Marriage is a bad deal for men!”

As always, comparing yourself to women is pointless and futile, unless you actually want to be a woman and get men all up in you and caring for you and protecting you.

READ MORE: Do Not Compare Yourself to Women

It doesn’t matter if women have it easier. You are not a woman. You are a MAN.

The point here is not “men have to do more work than women do.”

In fact, women lower their effort in regard to touch and accept more risk:

The male continues to touch, lowering his risk of infidelity

The woman relaxes her touch, raising her risk of infidelity

The move makes sense though because:

Sexual infidelity doesn’t matter as much to women

Touch is a more useful anti-infidelity strategy when used by men than by women

Commitment reassures women more of emotional fidelity, which is what they actually care about

Humans, like all animals, are biologically driven to conserve energy; we don’t expend it when we don’t judge the effort worth the reward.

For men, ensuring their woman stays loyal (and doesn’t end up with someone else’s kid in their wombs) is worth the extra ‘work’ of touching and being affectionate with their fiancées and wives.

So, they touch in serious relationships, keep touching their fiancées, and keep touching their wives, even as their wives chill out a bit on touch post-engagement.

No ‘victims’ here; just practical evolutionary strategy.

Now… what if you really, really want your woman to touch you more?

In that case, you might just want to let her know your ex-girlfriend’s coming to town. That ought to stir up a little fear of emotional infidelity – and turn her a good bit touchier 😉

As for the takeaway:

If you want to slash your woman’s odds of infidelity, touch her.

Touch her often, touch her lots, touch her lovingly, touch affectionately. Touch sexually, too. Give her a nice ol’ slap on the behind!

Nothing in life is 100%, of course; if you’re dating a nymphomaniac you can touch her 24/7 and she’ll still find an excuse to cheat. So it goes with the sex fiend gals.

But for most normal sex drive women, touch her well and she’ll probably not want to stray.

Cheers,

Chase Amante

Title: Leaving on a High Note: The Art of Great Last Impressions | Girls Chase
content:
A great last impression makes women eager to see you again. It’s the ultimate flake reduction strategy. Turn far more of your approaches into dates & lays!

Everyone knows about the importance of first impressions.

Well, everyone knows it in theory. I see all these videos men are posting of themselves making ultra-basic approaches to women in-person with poor approach angles, poor opening body language, monotone voices, generic looks-based compliments, and straight-to-the-number-grab tactics, and it’s obvious that “Stick that first impression!” is not paramount in most guys’ minds.

Today I am going to give you one of the great ‘cheat codes’ in dating and the social arts in general. It is one I have used since the very beginning of my forays into socializing. Nevertheless, it’s been with me so long I rarely think about it, and rarely think to mention it.

If you apply this strategy to your approaches, you will have girls messaging you more eagerly, coming out onto dates more easily, and getting together with you romantically more consistently. You can even use it in same-day pickups to create maximum attraction during takeaways/absences.

This strategy is the under-discussed, over-powered strategy of leaving on a high note; otherwise called making a great last impression.

 

George Leaves on a High Note

In 1998, when I was 15 years old, I watched the Seinfeld episode “The Burning” and took special note of the technique it taught. In it, Jerry Seinfeld’s friend George discovered he could raise his image in everyone’s eyes simply by leaving on a high note. He learned the art of making a fine last impression.

Here’s one clip of George leaving a business meeting after hitting a high note:

Here’s another showing multiple clips from the episode – it shows:

Before George learned to leave on a high note (he hit high notes only to not leave, then follow them with low notes – thus, his last impression was a low note and he left no great last impression)

George learning to leave on a high note and create that solid last impression

The comedic aftermath of George’s last impression management (where his boss comes to view him as highly capable… and, in true comedic fashion, offloads a ton of work onto him)

This effect is real. It is not just comedy.

At the point I saw this episode, I’d already been cracking jokes and telling stories for several years and had gotten quite good at it. I well knew the ‘up then down’ effect that happens when you land a real zinger, but then keep going and the next ones don’t hit as well.

I had already learned that if I cracked a joke that got my whole high school class laughing hard, I should then SHUT UP for a lengthy amount of time and let that last impression of “Chase is a really hilarious guy” cement rather than risk it with another joke that likely wouldn’t hit anywhere near as hard as the last one did.

That Seinfeld episode confirmed this lesson for me, but also made me realize I could apply the strategy to areas outside of telling jokes. What if on everything I did I just left after a high note? Could I create mountains of great last impressions just by doing this?

I decided that everything I knew about human psychology suggested I probably could, and it became a sort of guiding principle to my interactions after that:

Just stay in as long as you need to UNTIL you hit a high note… then when you hit it, ride out on high!

But can it really be that easy?

 

Last Impressions and the Recency Effect

Last impressions in many ways carry as much weight as first impressions do. This is due to the dueling effects of primacy vs. recency. To quote:

In psychological terms, the tendency to remember first and last impressions are called the primacy or recency effect. In short, our brains tend to remember the first item (primacy) and last item (recency) in a series.

When people think back on you, one of the clearest memories they have of you is however they recall interacting with you last. This is the last impression you made – the impression freshest in their minds; the one with the most recency.

To quote another article:

[Those focused on creating a lasting good impression] want to make sure you feel respected and well treated at all times, but especially at the end.

 

The reason for this is, we humans don’t remember things in the right sequence, we remember the most significant part and then how it ended. While a lot of important details are sometimes missed.

Shep Hyken, who discusses the impact of a ‘departure meeting’ on creating repeat clients, whipped up this little comic, which nicely encapsulates the power of a sound final impression:

Finally, this 2008 study from the University of Quebec in Montreal found that “perceived quality and trust were found to be influenced by the initial impression, whereas satisfaction was mostly impacted by the final impression.” That is to say:

How high quality she views you comes from your first impression

How much she trusts you comes from your first impression

How satisfied she feels with you comes from your last impression

Thus, while the recency of the last impression doesn’t rule all (and you still need to stick that first impression), it plays a major role in the impressions you leave – most importantly in another person’s satisfaction with you, which we really, really need if we want girls to come out onto a date later or behave more compliant with us.

 

Your Last Impression Is Part of Your First Impression

When you talk to a new girl, the final impression you make before you leave gets encoded as part of your first impression. For instance, if you leave in a cool and romantic way, she will view you as a cool and romantic guy, even if you were only cool and romantic at the end; this gets baked into her overall first impression of you (especially if the first impression was short – say under 10 minutes).

Think back on how you met some of the most significant women in your life: you may not be able to remember everything you said during the approach (especially if it’s been a while), but I bet you can remember the beginning of the approach, and also how it ended. That ending – the last impression – is a permanent aspect of your first impression of her.

This gives it some added importance during the initial approach:

What she thinks about you once you’re no longer at her side is determined to a large extent by the tone and way you left her side. That determines:

How excited she is to see you again

How responsive she’ll be to your messages

How open she’ll be to a re-approach by you

How readily she’ll agree to a date (and show up)

Go out with a strong last impression if you want to cement a strong initial impression.

 

You Can Do This in Everything

Anything where you hit a high note you can walk away to leave a strong impression.

Back when I was a tire salesman, my district sent me to help out at a tire store in inner city Philadelphia for a week when all that store’s salesmen and managers were unavailable.

The guys working in the shop were all inner city blacks, one of whom regaled me with his stories of youthful carjacking, and later working security at an Atlantic City casino and monitoring the female thieves. They’d spot a guy winning at his gambling, get on his arm, get themselves invited up to his comped hotel room, get him to leave his winnings in the safe unlocked or watch him put the combination in, bang his brains out, then once he was passed out from all the sex they’d go clean the safe out and leave with the money. The casino would try to stop the thieves from draining all these poor marks dry (after all, that was the casino’s turf… they wanted that guy to lose the money again the next day back in the casino!).

Anyway, the guys invited me back to play a game of cee-lo, which I only knew of from listening to Nas previously: “Or either on the corner bettin' Grants [$50 bills] with the cee-lo champs.”

Men playing cee-lo.

The way cee-lo works is you roll three dice, aiming to achieve a certain score. If you roll a 1-2-3, you instantly lose; if you roll a 4-5-6, you instantly win; anything else you tally the points a certain way (a way that differs between hoods). I picked up the dice, shook my hand for about 15 seconds, concentrating with all my might and willing that 4-5-6, then rolled the dice – and my first ever cee-lo roll (and my last ever) was a 4-5-6! The guys went nuts, I’d won the game in a single roll, acted like it was fully expected (I did, after all, will it to be 😏), then casually spun on my heels and marched back to the front of the store to await the next customer.

I heard the guys mention it a few times throughout the rest of the week. I half imagine they’re still talking about how that middle class white boy rolled a 4-5-6 the one time he ever played cee-lo. Had I stuck around and continued to roll the dice the impression would’ve been far more muted (I very much doubt I’d continue to have rolled a 4-5-6 every time).

 

Making a Strong Last Impression: How to Leave on a High Note

Back to meeting girls.

How do you go out on a high note and create that powerful last impression?

Aside from the George Costanza “throw your hands up and announce ‘That’s it for me!’ and make your exit after a great idea or joke” approach, we have some other tools in our seduction toolbox.

Harvard Business School suggests a trio of “fireworks” designed to keep people coming back in for more with your last impression:

Improve the experience steadily over time. Your interaction with her should get better as it goes: more interesting conversation, closer communication, more touch, more laughter. The aim is to “increase excitement and achieve better overall satisfaction.”

Add one surprise along the way. There should be a moment in the interaction where she feels genuinely surprised. One of the simplest ways to do this in conversation is with a cold read. A single on-the-mark cold read (like “I bet you’re a reader, aren’t you?” to which she excitedly agrees and feels amazed that you knew) can make a huge difference.

End with a bang. This is what George does in that Seinfeld episode – he makes his exit promptly after a high note. If you can elicit a great, big, lusty laugh from her or get her to give you doe eyes, that’s the time to ask her out, grab her number, then exit.

I will also add: on the exit, to leave on a higher note still, my personal preference is to take a girl’s hand into a handclasp in mine, squeeze it, and give a very slight bow with a smile. It’s different, memorable, close to what she sees in old timey period piece romance films, but without going too overboard. You can instead spin her on the exit, fold your hands and give a slight bow, blow a kiss at her – anything that leaves a MARK.

The most difficult of these for less experienced men is likely going to be “improve the experience steadily over time.” Typically one of the big challenges when you’re new is keeping the conversation going and the girl hooked and engaged for long.

 

Staying in Until You Reach a High Note
Keep in there until that high note’s reached.

Part of the real secret sauce of making a great last impression is to stay in-set until you are able to create a high note to leave on.

That is to say: if it’s going okay but you aren’t hitting high points, you keep testing angles until you get a hit. Then you milk it a bit, close, and make your exit.

Example 1 (day game number close):

You approach a girl on a sidewalk and have a nice chat. She’s friendly and polite but she isn’t hooking. Should you just ask her number? No! You stay in and keep looking for a high point.

You might try teasing her. You might try a cold read. Maybe you tell her a little story that relates to something she said. Finally, after you hit upon something, she gets clearly into it; she’s hooked! She excitedly relates to what you’ve shared, then laughs pretty hard at the joke you make after.

Now it is time to close. You tell her the two of you should hang out sometime; she agrees; you swap numbers with her. Romantic handclasp on exit; last impression made.

Example 2 (night game takeaway):

You approach a girl in a bar and have a fine chat. You talk to her and her friend both. Both girls are polite but so far you haven’t hooked. Should you just move on? No! You stay in a bit longer and look for a higher point.

You chat with her a little about herself then make a couple of cold reads and she’s surprised. You segue that into a tease and she laughs.

Now is the time for the takeaway. You tell her you’re going to go scout the venue out, give her a smile and a wink, and walk off. Last impression made. You can reopen her a little later on and most likely get a very warm reception (with her interest levels much higher on your return).

 

How Long to Stay In Post-High Note

If you notice in both the examples I shared, you stayed with her for a little bit after the high note. Unlike George in those clips, you did NOT instantly leave after the high point. Why not?

George was in a social circle situation with people he knew well and was guaranteed to see again. They already have a fairly set impression of him, and him taking off after a good idea or a good laugh simply gives him a slight upgrade to the previously-formed opinion they have of him each time.

Yet when you’re talking to a girl who barely knows you, or does not know you at all, you do not want to go through two minutes of “struggling to connect” conversation, then hit a high point, then immediately leave. It will feel strange to her, like you sort of connected at the very end, but not really, since you didn’t connect the whole rest of the time.

Instead, for a golden last impression, you want to make sure she feels like at least a third of the interaction (i.e., the final third) was very good & solid.

If you talk for two minutes and it’s awkward, then she hooks, you need to talk another minute at least before you exit. That gives it some time to cement the hook as no fluke; because now, the two of you are vibing.

This is the timing element of the last impression. It’s not just “hit a high point then bounce.”

You must be sensitive to the impression you’re leaving:

A strong enough impression that when she looks back, she says to herself, “Wow, that was getting pretty good. I wonder where it might lead next?”

 

What If You Can’t Reach a High Note?

You’re not going to perfectly connect with every girl you talk to. Nor do you want to hang around for 20 minutes in a going-nowhere-fast conversation trying to force a high note when none are coming.

You must be able to play this a bit by ear. If she’s really not into you, and you’re not feeling it with her, you don’t have to stick around for a high note. You can just eject. Or if the conversation is unfailingly flat and uninteresting, eject.

What if the conversation goes all right, and the girl is somewhat compliant, but those high notes just stubbornly refuse to manifest? Well than you close her anyway and see if you can’t make lemonade out of the approaching lemon. Sometimes girls are just awkward.

If you need help figuring out when to stay in with a girl versus when to eject, see my article on exactly that subject.

The better your approach, conversation, and hook game, the easier it is to create those high points with girls, and the more reliably you can leave great last impressions.

 

A Great Last Impression Leaves Her Wanting More
She’ll be counting the hours until she sees you again.

Ultimately, this is what it’s really about:

Giving her enough that she enjoys being around you – then removing your presence before she can get TOTALLY enough.

It’s a rookie mistake to hang around with a girl to the point where she decides she’s gotten all she needs from you. It’s overproviding good feelings. That’s not what you want to do.

Instead, you want to give her a taste of what being around you is like, and let her enjoy it long enough she knows it’s no fluke… then take the taste away from her to let her crave for more.

If you can make girls crave your presence, getting them back out onto dates is cake.

Getting them to blow wide open to you when you reopen them later is a cinch.

She wants MORE, and when you reappear, she is excited that now she might get it.

That’s the power of a superb final impression: it makes her hardly able to wait for the chance to see you again.

Chase Amante

Title: Love Is Blind | Girls Chase
content:
They say love is blind, and blindfolded Cupid with his fickle arrow shots makes it seem so. But what drives people’s often seemingly random pair-ups?

The ancient Greek god of love, Cupid, is sometimes depicted as being blindfolded.

He flies about on a pair of wings to emblemize the flighty, fickle nature of lovers, and is a young boy to show the irrational nature of love.

One of the great ironies of life is how much time and energy men put into making themselves seem deeply, unfailingly rational, yet how inexplicable their decisions often seem to others – and even (when they’re being honest) themselves.

I am probably one of the most ‘strives for accuracy’ and ‘ferociously logical’ people you know and read. But the more I understand, the deeper into my own thinking I go, the more I realize even many of my own decisions are driven by logic inaccessible to my conscious mind. Of course, I can tell you the ‘reasons’ why I do what I do… but so many of our reasons are ex post facto ones: we make our decisions first, then find logic to explain it after.

This is yet another reason I believe it is so important to pay attention to your girl selection and level of abundance: because love is blind, and ‘you’ (the conscious you) never really know for sure what girl you will end up with long-term until you end up with her.

 

People’s Relationships Make No Sense

I have seen a lot of people enter into various relationships over the years with people I could not (at least at first) understand why they were with.

Playboys able to get any girl who settled into something with unattractive girls they were punching far below their weight to date.

High value dudes with lots of women after them who chose broken women over healthy ones – broken women who ended up abusing them, cheating on them, or ditching them (predictable to me a mile away; often even pointed out to the guy, only for him to ignore it!).

I’ve watched beautiful, intelligent, vivacious girls I knew date unattractive, weird, nerdy men, and scratched my head at it.

I’ve seen unattractive loser acquaintances show up with attractive, intelligent, amazing partners.

You just see it all and you go, “What the heck. How does any of this make sense?”

People endlessly post about their standards online.

Women talk about their stringent standards for men. Fat, low socioeconomic level women claim to only date men who are 6’5” making $500,000 per year. Spinsters in their 30s list out their demands for men going forward. You hear this and assume, “Well THERE’S a chick who’s going to be alone forever!” but she isn’t alone forever; instead she just dates some guy who doesn’t match any of her professed standards at all (and if you point it out to her, she’s unable to grasp your point).

Women who rant about their dating rules do so because they’ve been burned.

She had a guy — probably several — she liked a lot, and it did not work out.

The guy didn’t commit.

So she over-corrected and tried to enforce strict rules.

The result of that is the only guys she ends up with are either total studs who laugh off her rules and bed her anyway, only to not stick around… or deeply submissive “Yes ma’am!” types she won’t be able to feel attraction to no matter how hard she tries.

Her egg count is too low because she waited too long.

She’ll end up having a “last call” baby with the closest she can find to a stud with provider potential, then probably divorce him after a few years because she won’t have screened him properly (but she did what she had to do to reproduce).

Everybody needs to learn the ins and outs of dating — men and women — or else all you end up being able to do is roll the dice and pray. https://t.co/LGJRCXk3WJ

— Girls Chase 🏃‍♀️💨 (@GirlsChase) October 24, 2024

Likewise, men will talk incessantly about how they will only date skinny, submissive 20 y/o virgins without a college education… then you see they are getting married to a single mother in her 30s who could stand to lose a few pounds. And you go, “Dude, WTF?” but this guy just tells you “this chick’s different.”

Most men are fairly clueless about what they actually go for.

It is funny that the red pill guys harp so much on women’s standards, but do the same thing women do:

They claim to have a bunch of sky-high standards, which they then turn around and brutally violate 💀

Over the… https://t.co/XE2TfLq4jD

— Girls Chase 🏃‍♀️💨 (@GirlsChase) January 25, 2025

On the surface, most people’s relationships seem to make no sense whatsoever. They go for people you’d rate as not on their level, totally befuddling you.

If you ask them to explain their choice in mates, most people will babble out some incoherent list of traits or impressions, like, “She’s great! She blah blah [some things that could be said of 40% of other women as well]!”

It’s obvious there is something going on, because these people have the mates they do, and picked them and stuck with them, but if they can’t explain it, and you can’t decipher why they’re with these people, what’s going on?

 

Subconscious Reasons People Pick Their Mates

Years ago I noticed that a lot of couples actually had fairly similar faces to each other.

100 IQ looksmaxx guys try to argue that “That’s because people date based on facial hotness levels” without having any idea what they’re talking about. We’re not talking about “hotness levels.” We are talking about distinctive facial features, matched.

A horse-faced man with a big nose, a high forehead, and droopy ears might be a ‘6’ on the 1-to-10 looks scale. A square-faced woman with a tiny nose, a short brow, and sticking out ears might also be a ‘6’ on the 1-to-10 looks scale. But he’s unlikely to date her. Instead, he’s much more likely to date a horse-faced woman with a big nose, a high forehead, and droopy ears, whether she is a ‘5’ or an ‘8’ on the 1-to-10 looks scale.

The reality I discovered (and later on found scientific research to back up) is that people mate assortatively on facial similarity. Nobody knows he is doing it. I have never met someone who said, “I like to date people who look like me,” or, “I like to date people who look like my Mom/Dad.” This is totally subconscious.

I’ve always been extremely attracted to brunettes who wear their hair in large curls. When I’m with a brunette and she decides to put her hair in curls one day, let’s just say she’ll be walking funny the next day. I’d completely forgotten my mother (a brunette) wore large curls in her hair my entire childhood until I saw some old photos, and put two and two together. I’m not attracted to my mother (needless to say); however, I am attracted to women who remind me of her. And not just physically – personality aspects, I’ve since realized, too.

Scientists have found that 40% of people are very attracted to mates who resemble them facially; another 20% of people are repelled by people who resemble them facially. The remaining 40% of people have no strong preference.

It turns out that the 40% who most prefer those who look like them are the ones with the best relationships with their families; the 20% repelled by those who look like them are those with the worst relationships with their families. But next to no one is consciously aware that “I pick people who look like my family and me because I love my family” or “I pick people who look nothing like my family and me because my family hates me.”

Here's another one: scent plays a large role in human mating. Males and females alike both prefer to reproduce with mates with MHC immune genes dissimilar to their own (the reason why is because switching up immune genes gives offspring healthier immune systems and greater survivability). MHC immune genes are determined through scent; but never have I heard a woman or man say, “I’m with this person for her/his immune genes.”

Also on the scent dimension: women can smell both men’s testosterone and cortisol levels. Women (so long as they are not on birth control pills) are more attracted to men with higher testosterone (the masculinity hormone) yet less attracted to men with higher cortisol (the stress hormone). I started to wonder about this after knowing a playboy who always had a strong musk clinging to his person, and decided to try skipping soap and developing my own musk. The result was stronger, more animalistic attraction from some women (and more standoffish behavior from other women; women who likely wouldn’t have been interested in me anyway – stronger attraction from the interested girls, stronger repulsion from the disinterested ones. An acceptable tradeoff, I’d say!).

Likewise, men can tell when women are ovulating (partly by scent, and partly by other indicators), and are significantly more attracted to them. I’ve never heard a man say, “We got together because she was ovulating,” even though plenty of couples presumably have.

There are plenty more under-the-radar reasons than these, too.

 

Attachment Styles and Relationship Formation

I didn’t get interested in attachment styles until fairly late in my seduction career. For a long time I just didn’t pay them much mind.

But the more I’ve learned about them, the more I’ve realized how large a role they play in who gets (and stays) together with whom:

People with anxious attachment styles (emotional, clingy, needy) get all twisted up by and completely repel people with avoidant attachment styles (distant, independent, commitment phobic).

People with avoidant attachment styles struggle to date other avoidant attachment style people though because often the relationship just totally dissolves from both partners failing to ever increase the intimacy of the relationship.

People with disorganized attachment styles (vacillating between anxious and avoidant) are crazy-making and drive everyone away except for very patient personality types.

Nobody says, “I picked this person because s/he has a complementary attachment style to mine,” but that is what is happening much of the time.

Until you become aware of it, though, the reason this person went for that person can look inexplicable to you.

Why did my player friend who had so much choice with women go for a girl who was always depressed and needy for him? Because he had an anxious attachment style and a girl like that made him feel needed and safer.

Why did my vivacious female friend who always had so many men chasing after her (and slept around with so many of them while refusing commitment to any of them) settle down with a nice guy who took it slow? Because she had an avoidant attachment style, and unlike all the other guys she’d sleep with who’d get utterly hooked on her, he took it very slow with her, didn’t push her for anything, and avoided triggering her skittish ‘relationship flight response’.

The fact that this guy actually got her to walk down the aisle amazed me.

Why do I prefer the girls I do for relationships, while quickly breaking up with other girls (whom many other men might describe as ideal relationship material)? Once again, when I examine my own attachment style and those of the girls I accept or reject, it makes a lot more sense. The best I could tell you before I understood attachment styles was just that I liked certain personalities/dynamics better than others, but now I know why.

Next to no one is consciously aware of these factors. If you ask people, “Why are you with the person you are with?” they nearly never say anything about how their attachment style complements their partner’s attachment style.

Once again, invisible factors rule the roost, making it appear that ‘love is blind’.

 

Relationship Goals as Another Key Factor

I’ve written multiple times about the importance of matched-up long-term romantic, lifestyle, and reproductive objectives in men and women. If you want to travel the world but she wants to stay at home, it’s not a good match. If you want to live in the big city but she wants to live in the countryside, it’s not a good match. If you want sex six times a week but she wants sex once every two weeks, it’s not a good match. If you want a dozen children but she wants to remain childless, it’s not a good match. Any of these will lead to endless strife and unhappy compromises.

Many people get very disillusioned when they meet someone with different romantic goals/predilections than they have and find that out early. e.g., a guy who doesn’t want kids yet finds out a girl he’s with is evaluating him as a potential father to her children may feel ‘unseen’, as if she only values him as a ‘breeder’. But a guy who wants kids himself who realizes the girl he’s with is evaluating him as a potential father to her children, so long as he also evaluates her favorably as a potential mother to his children, is going to respond to that by getting a MASSIVE HARD-ON and wanting to raw dog her immediately and not pull out.

I have watched a lot of relationships fracture or rapidly deepen when the partners realized their life goals were either in conflict or aligned. People are somewhat more aware of this one – this is one of those invisible factors that bubbles up into conscious awareness – but not always fully; and it also happens later than the initial in-love tryst.

Regardless, people will still often dress up their reasons for leaving or deepening the relationship with many other rationales, even when to you it is obvious it all started coming apart OR coming together when they found out how different or similar their long-term goals were.

Once again, love is blind, at least somewhat; people stumble into or out of love affairs only somewhat aware of why they do so.

 

Correcting for Love Blindness: What You Can Do
Take the right steps to guard against total love blindness.

When I was in my early 20s I dated many girls and slipped into some relationships with girls who were awesome in some ways but imperfect in some others.

At one point I was seriously considering long-term monogamy / marriage / a family with a girl who was nine years older than me. She was great in a lot of ways, but that age gap in the wrong direction was a big problem. I knew she was that much older than me from the start (when I was 23, she was 32), but at the time I was a newer dater, she was hotter than any other girl I’d been with yet, and I decided that so long as I wasn’t doing monogamy it’d be okay.

In the end, I very narrowly avoided a monogamous commitment years later, and in another universe I’d possibly have married her and had a family with her, and today might have a wife nearly a decade older than me, and now at an age where the age difference would be very visible (when she was in her early 30s, it was not too bad, and many thought she was younger than me – but women age rapidly between 35 and 40).

From that relationship and others I formed a few important rules:

I won’t date women past a certain age. Usually, I will not even sleep with a girl who is too old. Some occasional exceptions for hotties past that age limit. Women a bit beyond my age limit may look fine and be sexy but these older women are all on the ‘commitment fast track’, plus if a woman is still single after a certain age there is always something wrong.

I won’t date girls who club, party, or drink. I will still sleep with them! I just won’t date them. These girls just introduce too many wildcards into your relationship. If you want to read my full logic for why I have this rule, read this article.

I won’t sleep with any girl I know has pills or issues. I learned that one early on from a few girls who were NUTS. Sane, mentally healthy women for me only, please. More on that rule here.

I won’t sleep with any girl I have ANY mixed feelings with on more than two occasions. It’s just much easier to nip something in the bud than it is when it’s flowered into a full-blown relationship.

Do those rules sound extreme? Perhaps! But they have allowed me to keep around only women I’m least likely to end up in a problematic ‘love blind’ relationship with.

You don’t have to follow my rules. Any of them you disagree with you can ignore for yourself. Any you think should be there that you don’t see on my list you can add. Don’t be so extreme you unnecessarily limit yourself; but don’t leave out the important stuff either.

But look, here is how to think about it: you cannot control which women you fall for and which women you don’t. Love happens at a level below conscious awareness, on factors you don’t even realize you’re assessing. There are women out there you will fall for who WILL BE bad for your life, just because they hit some MHC gene compatibility or attachment style compatibility attraction switch or something else along those lines that no other girl you’re currently seeing does. While it is possible to forcefully extricate yourself from these relationships, it is painful and difficult.

If you are a man who has choice with women (and if you are reading this website and applying its material, or the material in my book or my One Date system, then you are a man who has choice), you should aim to have around you only women who are least likely to cause you pain or regret if Cupid should think to shoot his arrow blindly into your breast and make you fall for one of them.

Because trust, sooner or later, you WILL FALL for one of the girls you get with!

It is simply human nature.

 

Don’t Get Cupid-Stupid; Corral Your Choices!
Round up them pretty lil’ doggies.

You cannot pick whom you’ll fall in love with. Everyone falls in love.

I have seen guys trying to pick women to be future wives using the Internet, only to meet up with most of them and have no ‘spark’. Then the girl they do feel that sudden attraction to ends up not being one they would’ve expected to have it to at all.

I’m a big believer in going for girls you experience that undefinable draw towards. Yet, I also very much believe in using your reasoning mind to consciously select women who have the traits and features you want in a long-term mate.

The best way to do this, in my opinion, is simply to limit your dating pool to women you’d find it acceptable to fall for. Not so limited you lack abundance; but not so unlimited you let yourself fall for girls who’re bad for you.

(you can limit yourself less with one-night stands; go by your own behavior. Personally, I avoid disordered girls / girls on pills for ONS just because these are also the women most likely to cause a lot of problems if you decide not to keep seeing them after. Something about me just makes chicks want to keep me, but younger and saner women have this less, are less clingy, and more chill about you not immediately turning them into wives)

You must have a certain level of abundance with women to be able to do this effectively. So don’t worry about this overmuch if you’re just starting out. Don’t beat yourself up if you have relationships with girls who, in retrospect, were “all wrong” for you – or mostly right but with a few wrong things; this is how you learn.

Just keep in mind, Cupid fluttering about with his blindfold on, shooting arrows every which way, with you never knowing which girl they’ll make you smitten with.

There are many women out there you COULD fall in love with; limit your dating pool only to women you’d be happy to fall in love with, and you’ll end up with a girl who makes your heart beat faster and ticks off all (or most of) your on-paper boxes.

Lovingly yours,

Chase Amante

Title: Boyfriend Disqualifiers: Must They Fully Disqualify You? | Girls Chase
content:
A boyfriend disqualifier gets a girl to think of you as just a lover, not a boyfriend. When you use these, must you ‘go all the way’ in having her disqualify you – or not?

Lately there’s been a fair bit of discussion on the Skilled Seducer Forum about how far you need to go in disqualifying yourself as a boyfriend. Guys report various problems when disqualifying themselves for the boyfriend role, and other guys are telling them not to go so far in doing so.

I have mixed thoughts about boyfriend disqualification. Obviously it's a core part of seduction that enables rapid escalation. Without it, it's an uphill battle getting out of the "potential boyfriend" category and putting yourself in the "lover" category.

At the same time, I feel like there are girls of this generation who will lose interest if you completely disqualify yourself - at least in my recent experience with young Gen Z girls. As we've discussed, hook-up culture is rapidly changing, social skills are deteriorating, and mainstream values are trending towards conservative.

I’m one of a few guys in seduction who still regularly talks about boyfriend disqualification. That is to say, who still regularly talks about communicating to a girl that you are ineligible for a boyfriend/husband/long-term role.

I think we’re due for some clarification though, because I see a lot of guys using this tactic wrong. So let’s talk boyfriend disqualifiers: just how hardcore do your boyfriend disqualifiers need to be?

 

What Is a ‘Boyfriend Disqualifier’?

First off, when we say ‘boyfriend disqualifier’, we are NOT talking about ‘boyfriend destroyers’.

A boyfriend destroyer takes aim at a woman’s current boyfriend. It positions the seducer as a potential lover to the attached woman, in opposition to her boyfriend, whom the seducer positions as a boring, supplicating, and/or unsexy provider.

A boyfriend disqualifier is something the seducer says or does that causes a woman to discount him as ever being a potential boyfriend or long-term partner.

READ MORE: Telling Women You're NOT Boyfriend Material

You just wouldn’t be very good in that role.

For instance, some crystal clear boyfriend disqualifiers include:

You’re in her city on travel and are only there for three more days/nights

You’re unemployed and not planning to seek a job any time in the foreseeable future

You’re in a long-term relationship or married (the famous wedding ring trick)

‘Nuff said.

The reason to use a boyfriend disqualifier is to simplify her decision making process.

A woman who finds you very, very sexy, but also sees a potential future with you, will slow things down, hit the brakes, and vet you much harder to

make sure you are indeed the right guy for her, long-term, plus

make sure you don’t think she’s too easy and rule her out as a long-term mate.

Meanwhile, a woman who finds you very, very sexy, yet sees NO potential future with you, is far more likely to simply hop right into bed with you. No need to vet you for long-term; and who cares whether you think she’s easy or not? Besides – you’re a man-whore. You’re not going to judge her, and it’d be crazy if you did!

That’s the basis of boyfriend disqualification. Got what it is now? Perfect.

Now let’s talk about the nuances of it – like how far you should take it.

 

Pros and Cons of Total (or Near-Total) Boyfriend Disqualification

Some seducers construct personas for themselves that have total boyfriend disqualification baked into their presentation. In essence, these men come across so wild, sexual, unstable, and player-ish that women automatically disqualify them for anything long-term right from the get-go.

Think of the super sexy tattooed bad boy who starts setting sexual frames and touches her aggressively with a firm hand on her waist within seconds of meeting her. If he keeps this up and keeps his focus mainly on creating arousal plus building compliance, with minimal attention paid to similarity/connection building, this girl will never see him as anything other than a dick on legs.

There are benefits and drawbacks to this. The benefits are:

Rapidly screening out girls who are not down to fuck

Women who are out looking for sex make themselves known to him

Last minute resistance tends to be low or nil

The drawbacks are:

Girls who are not DTF are totally put off

If the guy is not a good closer, he’ll disappoint the DTF girls and get nothing

Sky-high retention problems; girls don’t see him as a long-term mate, remember?

Men who are extremely boyfriend disqualified tend to hang to specific haunts that contain high proportions of girls who are DTF. Meet market bars and nightclubs, for instance, or tourist areas in town to find girls who are on vacation.

Totally boyfriend disqualified men have a high strike-out rate doing day game in regular parts of regular towns; but they can do very well day gaming on the Las Vegas Strip, filled with out-of-towner girls just looking for a good time.

Sourcing girls to sleep with is usually never a problem for total boyfriend disqualified men. For a man to get to the point where he’s just totally disqualified himself boyfriend-wise, in a kind of total DTF-girl game optimization, he has to have venues with a steady supply of horny and ready girls. Without their availability, no man is able to push his persona to that extreme. DTF girl availability + extreme boyfriend disqualification go hand-in-hand.

The big problem comes when he tires of no-strings hookups and begins to long for a more settled relationship. Totally boyfriend disqualified men often enter ‘crisis mode’ here when they realize they’re simply not able to keep the girls they want around:

Girls who are looking for/open to a relationship they don’t tend to get with at all. Most of these girls get put off by their deep player personas.

Girls they sleep with who were DTF but are also nevertheless looking for relationships don’t view them as potential relationship partners. They just view the DTF guy as a fun sexual diversion while they continue their hunt for a serious guy with other candidates.

The rest of the women they sleep with tend to be high count, high testosterone, and/or avoidant attachment style girls who simply do not want to get roped into relationships or are highly resistant to it.

The totally boyfriend disqualified seducer may try to show a girl he likes and wants to keep around ‘another side’ of himself, but by this point he’s usually so deep into his boyfriend disqualified persona it’s hard to persuade women they were wrong all along and that in fact he’d actually make an acceptable boyfriend.

In the end, totally boyfriend disqualified men either end up changing their personas and approach to be less extreme, or they end up in a relationship with a high count, high testosterone, avoidant-type girl who gradually eased into the relationship with them on the basis of them being kind of ‘the same’: she fears commitment and he’s not commitment-worthy – a match made in heaven!

Unless you are going for this guy’s lifestyle and results, however, you are going to want something LESS than ‘total disqualification as a boyfriend’.

 

Explicit Boyfriend Disqualification
Tell her explicitly you are out of the running and you limit your dating pool.

One other thing to address before we talk about boyfriend disqualification calibration.

That is that, for attainability’s sake, you must let girls disqualify you as a boyfriend themselves – not YOU explicitly tell them you don’t fit the boyfriend role!

I see a lot of guys trying to disqualify themselves as boyfriends by telling girls OUTRIGHT to ‘not consider’ them for the boyfriend role:

“I’m not looking for anything serious”

“I don’t do relationships”

“I prefer to keep things casual”

This can work fine with some sexually experienced, sex positive women. It often works okay with feminists, women engaged in sex work, polyamorous women, women in the kink community, and other women who sleep around a lot. For these women, this kind of talk is ‘normal’, and it often won’t carry an attainability penalty.

With any other type of woman, however, this kind of talk is generally going to penalize you heavily. That is because unlike high count, sex positive, feministic types, ‘normal’ girls do not live in a universe where it’s normal and common for men to keep things totally sexually casual with the door bolted shut to any kind of long-term relationship whatsoever.

Telling someone “I don’t do X” or “I’m not available for Y” is also often going to come across as a rejection. If you make a girl feel like you’ve rejected her for something she might’ve wanted with you herself, she is often going to auto-reject.

Thus, when you tell women, “I’m not looking for anything serious,” it risks coming across as a rejection, and even if it doesn’t, it risks being unrelatable, like you are some kind of freewheeling sexual maniac who does not have normal human relationships, only romance-devoid hedonistic trysts. Your rejection and unrelatability creates a large gap of dissimilarity with them, which carries a heavy attainability penalty (which, again, may lead to auto-rejection).

Therefore, unless you are doing the ‘totally boyfriend disqualified’ thing where you just screen for DTF girls and screen out everyone else, I strongly recommend against explicit self-disqualification as a boyfriend. It simply creates too many attainability problems and costs you too many girls.

Instead of be explicit about it, I recommend you arrange your boyfriend disqualification in a way where the girl feels like it is her idea, based on what she has unearthed about you, to take you out of boyfriend contention and leave you solely in a ‘potential future lover’ candidacy.

 

Letting Her Disqualify You as a Boyfriend

Remember: unless you’re going for high count, sex positive girls, and perhaps even then, you should not explicitly disqualify yourself as a boyfriend.

Instead, you are going to share things about yourself that lead her to conclude you ‘probably aren’t a guy for long-term’.

 

Examples: Proper Boyfriend Disqualification

Let’s say you travel often. When talking to girls, to get them to disqualify you boyfriend-wise, you will simply play that up a bit:

HER: What do you do?

YOU: I’m a people person. I put people together. I manage business conferences, arrange all the logistics, and make the magic happen so my clients can network and good things can happen. It also means I’m on the road ALL the time and basically don’t even really have a home!

HER: Wow, that’s so cool. Where do you get to travel to?

YOU: Oh, you know, [LIST OF CITIES]. I’m in hotels so much my place here is barely even furnished; I’m just never really around.

At this point, with two references in now that paint this picture of you as a man who lives his life on the road, you’ve set yourself up to be a pretty unattractive long-term candidate. How many women want to date a man who’s never around? Very few.

Two references to this is generally all you need to set the frame very clear. If she’s especially dense, you might want three, or you might want to sprinkle in a gentle (non-explicit) reminder later, but you don’t need to hit this frame hard for women to notice. Women pay very close attention to details that affect a man’s long-term eligibility.

What if you don’t travel a lot? One boyfriend disqualifier available to pretty much any man is to imply (without stating) that you have a girl you’re seeing in some capacity. The way you do this is to several times mention doing ‘date-like’ things with ‘your friend’ whom you also let slip is a woman.

YOU: I went skiing last weekend with my friend, have you ever gone? Well, my friend, she’s not very experienced so the weekend ended up turning into a training session on the bunny slopes. But now it’s got me thinking about becoming a part-time ski instructor!

15-20 minutes later…

YOU: I was at this wine tasting several weeks back with a friend of mine. I’m a big red wine guy but she’s a white wine aficionado so we spent half the time debating over which wines were the best.

Two little stories like this about doing things with your ‘friend’, who is a girl, where the things sound ‘date-like’, put a lot of questions into the mind of any girl romantically intrigued by you:

Is that girl your girlfriend?

Is she your friend with benefits?

Either way, surely you are sleeping with her, right?

She is going to seriously wonder what your relationship with this other woman is.

She might ask you outright what your relationship is to this woman. If so, just seem completely casual and, with a little smile, tell her, “Ah, she’s just a friend,” in a way that dismisses the question but doesn’t REALLY reassure her of anything (you do not want to reassure; you want to seem like you’re just shrugging it off, like there might actually be a sexual relationship there you’d simply not divulging).

She also might not ask, but simply wonder. In that case, it’s good too. Even if she says nothing, she WILL pick up on a couple of references to a female ‘friend’ who went with you on date-like activities. She will notice it, and partly or largely disqualify you as a boyfriend.

Did you notice how in NEITHER of these examples did we say ANYTHING about “not doing serious relationships” or “not looking for a relationship right now” or “preferring to keep things casual”? This is the way that I recommend using boyfriend disqualifiers: doing it in such a way that you lead the girl to largely disqualify you from the boyfriend role on her own!

This is how you maintain attainability: it isn’t you imposing a frame on her, but her slowly realizing you probably won’t be a fit for one role (the boyfriend role) – but you might still be a fit for another (the lover role).

 

What If You’re Not Super Sexy Yet?

If you are not a very sexy man yet (and there’s no need to stress over this; it takes time to become a sexually compelling guy!), I suggest you do not go too far in ruling yourself out for boyfriend potential.

The examples in the last section are too much for an average dude of average sexiness. He’ll disqualify himself as a boyfriend but he won’t be sexy enough to qualify as a lover. What’s left? Nada mucho.

When you’re a dude of average sexiness, you need to calibrate to that. If you’ll use boyfriend disqualifiers, they should only aim to lightly disqualify you, just enough that she views you as slightly elusive boyfriend-wise, but far from being totally unqualified as a boyfriend candidate.

You are still going to need to rely on boyfriend value to some degree to bed girls until you’re sexy enough to go without it.

 

How Far Should You Disqualify Yourself?

The rule of thumb is:

The sexier a potential lover you are, and

The more likely you judge her to be open to no-strings sex,

The more you can disqualify yourself as a boyfriend.

For instance, if you are a super sexy guy who meets a girl on vacation from far away who’s never going to be in your city again, you can completely disqualify yourself as a boyfriend and it will not hurt you a lick. In fact, it is going to help you, by communicating to her that you are down for what she likely wants – while being attractive for that role to boot.

On the other hand:

The less sexy a potential lover you are, and

The less likely you judge her to be open to no-strings sex,

The less you should disqualify yourself as a boyfriend.

As an example, if you are just starting out as a beginner seducer and not especially good at setting sexy vibes and frames, and you are talking to a girl who lives in your town, is around your age, of similar background and socioeconomic level to yours, who has a history of long-term relationships and is eight months removed from her last one now (so you know she’s probably on the hunt for one), you do not want to do any more than a little very light boyfriend disqualification.

You might tell a single story about doing something date-like with your female ‘friend’, then not mention the friend again. Then if she asks about the friend, you dismiss the friend in a very sincere way: “No, no! She’s just a friend. Really.” The result is you give her a bit of an emotional roller-coaster (as she worries that you might be a player) but is reassured in the end that you’re still available for what she thinks she might want you for (i.e., a proper romantic relationship).

 

Wrap Up: Have Things Changed?

The discussion on the forum has been whether things have changed and you shouldn’t use boyfriend disqualifiers anymore.

The truth is, all the guys who go around explicitly disqualifying themselves as boyfriends misunderstand the technique. It’s never been about being explicit. It has always been about simply leaving enough clues that the girl disqualifies you herself.

Your disqualification must be calibrated to the girl. The wilder she is, the more totally you can disqualify yourself. The tamer she is, the more caution you must take with your boyfriend disqualification.

Use just the right amount of boyfriend disqualification to get the girl.

You need to be sensitive to how women react when you bring up various topics and what they suggest they are looking for. If a woman is hard-driving about how she’s looking for something serious, just laughing that off a bit as, “Wow, I’d better watch myself around you, I feel like you’re sizing me up to drag me off to the chapel to get married right now!” tells her to cool it a bit and suggests you’re not quite as qualified a long-term partner as she perhaps wants (i.e., her ideal man for that is going to be just as jazzed about marriage as she is). For her, that plus you behaving sexual around her may be all you need to end up in her ‘mostly a lover’ zone.

Know this: you do not need to be totally disqualified as a boyfriend for women to go to bed with you! Only disqualified enough that they are doubtful about your chances as a boyfriend – doubtful enough for them to say, “Eh, why not sleep with him? He might be a boyfriend but it’s not a strong possibility. Just a sort-of maybe one.”

Ultimately that is all you really need to achieve: just enough disqualification that she doesn’t jam on the brakes trying to rope you in as her future serious boyfriend.

Hit the right nuance on it, don’t go too far for the girl you use it with, and you’ll achieve the seductive frame.

Chase Amante
