Title: Romantic Dates Can Still Pull | Girls Chase
content:
Romantic dates can be utterly magical. But doesn’t escalating on them break the magic? Won’t girls slow-game you to not lose a magic love? Not if you do things right!

In the vein of our ongoing One Date promotion (you can grab One Date at 30% off PLUS my two very Limited Edition Date Flows™ on the Café Date and Stargazing Date BEFORE midnight this Tuesday, January 21st, 2025; current One Date owners can pick both up free here), I want to talk about a topic that dovetails very nicely: dates that are romantic yet still pull.

When I was a young seducer, I was sometimes torn between making a date too romantic or not. “If I make it too romantic, won’t that make her want to make sure she doesn’t lose me – and thus make her hit the brakes on us getting together too soon?” I worried.

(if you aren’t sure why you want to get together with girls sooner rather than later, read this)

There was another problem, too: when I made dates very romantic, sometimes it felt like making moves to get a girl into bed popped that romance bubble. The two of you had this romantic seduction where both of you were so synced up… then all of a sudden you’re trying to make moves while she tries to resist. Back out of sync. How do you keep that romantic, synced up feeling while still making moves?

As you know from the title, I’m going to tell you that romantic dates can still pull – and can do so very well. Further: the ‘secret’ to both problems I posed above is one and the same.

 

A Very Romantic Date
Love was in the air.

A girlfriend of mine told me about a guy she’d gone on a date with shortly before meeting me. He was an officemate of hers who’d pursued her for months, helping her out at work, offering her tips on the job, and basically putting himself at her service. Finally, he asked her out on a date.

The two of them ended up at a popular lakefront, where they walked slowly around peering up at the stars. Then they stopped into a lakefront bar; after a beer the girl grew a little tipsy. Outside, it had just started snowing, and as she watched the snowflakes fall under the streetlights outside the windows of the bar, her officemate reached out and brushed her hair back. When she described this to me, she called it the most magical moment of her life.

Ever the perfect gentleman though, her officemate dutifully ferried her home and bid her goodnight – no further moves made. A week or two later she met me, and I promptly zipped her right up to my bedchambers. The officemate, having no idea about me, continued to pursue her fruitlessly for over a year before she finally told him she was seeing someone else.

Could this girl have been her officemate’s, instead of mine? Absolutely. All he had to do was pull. Well, that and one thing else.

At the time, this girl was single, lonely, frustrated by squabbles with her annoying female roommate, and having some difficulty with her very competitive job. She was ripe for the picking – something that worked in my favor a short time later, but could have totally been leveraged by the officemate days or weeks before I ever had a shot with her. He could’ve had her locked down and out of my reach… but he didn’t.

Now, I didn’t create the same kind of romantic magic he did on my date with her, though I did create a different kind. I skipped the stars and snowflakes and brought her to my local café instead, where I deep dived her, chase framed her, touched her as much as I was able to get away with, and finally after a couple of hours pulled her back home. At some point during the date she commented that she felt “free” talking to me – she’d been under too much pressure from work, her roommate, and family. That date with me, she thought, felt liberating.

Half an hour after she told me this, I liberated her of her panties.

Two magical, romantic dates, one that ended in intimacy, one that didn’t – but what was different between the two?

 

Romance Should Include Getting Physical
It is not truly romantic if it is not physical.

The troubles I had as a newbie seducer with romantic dates feeling awkward when they shifted to escalation were not because of the romance. At the time, I thought they were… it felt like I was bait-and-switching girls by creating this sense of ‘pure’ romance, then dropping that pretense to 'go for it'. I wonder if that officemate was stopped by something similar; I have to suspect he was.

There is a certain romance itself to the purely platonic romance: the one where two souls feel fated and bound together, and yet, nothing physical ever comes of it. In a way, this kind of dreamlike, ephemeral romance is ‘purer’: no ulterior motives, no tension of the physical, nothing but a melding of hearts and minds in a union too pure to last in our carnal world of flesh and grime. In time, the two lovers must be torn asunder, as each enters into a more worldly union of the flesh with alternate mates – but they will always remember that magical connection they once shared.

This romantic notion is a bit misguided though. Such ‘pure’ connections only seem romantic due to the unanswered question that lingers after they’re gone: “What if?” “What if we HAD gotten together? Might it have been even better than how it was with the person I actually got together with?”

No true romantic should leave that question unanswered. The true romantic knows that a real romance – one where the lovers consummate the romantic connection – is far more powerful than some wispy, phantom-like connection.

The most influential movie seducer on your author’s young imagination was Val Kilmer’s protagonist Simon Magus in 1997’s The Saint. Both of Simon’s seductions in the movie are romantic seductions. Both seductions he consummates. There is no platonic romance here.

Both of the two Date Flows I’m including with all purchases of One Date (before midnight Tuesday) are focused on romantic date setups: the Café Date Flow (where I walk you step-by-step through creating a deeply connective date in a coffee shop or café) and the Stargazing Date (which is arguably the most magical date you can take a girl out on; just look at how that girlfriend of mine described the date with her officemate). I am a big fan of romantic dates; they can work very well for pulling girls and getting them into bed.

However you dice it, romance should end in consummation; without this, it is nothing more than an unanswered question.

Let’s talk about how you answer that question for her.

 

How to Lead Romantic Dates to Physical Intimacy
Lead things toward intimacy and consummate your romance.

You want to get intimate with women, but perhaps you’re worried about those ‘problems’ I posed at the start of the article:

If it’s too romantic, won’t she want to never lose you – so hit the brakes on intimacy?

How do you not ‘come out of sync’ when you try to switch the vibe from ‘romance’ to ‘physical escalation’?

The key to both of these is surprisingly simple:

You must be setting sexual frames and escalating with her physically THROUGHOUT the date.

I stress this heavily in the Café Date and Stargazing Date Flows.

I’m stressing it heavily here:

You must be setting sexual frames, getting touch, and escalating touch as you go.

You should also setting sexual frames and presenting yourself as a sexual man + being sexy.

You want her to tie the emotions of this budding, burgeoning romance to sexual feelings and physical touch with you. This alters the tone of the romance.

Instead of it being a ‘romance of the mind’, it is a ‘romance of the mind and flesh’.

She is both enamored with the experience of falling for you… AND excited about where it seems to be leading (sexually/physically).

The better a job you do at tying increasingly physical/sexual intimacy to the escalating romantic vibe, the clearer it is to her where this romance is headed, and the less of a ‘jump’ it is when you finally make that big move (i.e., you kiss her) – in fact, do it smooth enough, and it may not even feel like a ‘jump’ at all.

She’s not going to hit the brakes on a romantic scoundrel who’s been acting sexual, discussing sex, and touching her more and more the entire time because she ‘wants to keep him around’ – she knows what a man like this expects if he is to stick around. She knows a man like this is far less likely to stick around if the vibe is interrupted. And if she allows the sexual and physical escalation to proceed throughout the date or courtship, without trying to shut it down or squirm away, she is likely to let it continue to proceed in the seduction location, too.

She’s not going to feel like there’s a disconnect, or you and her are out of sync, when you make that move, if you’ve already been making moves throughout the date, and when it’s tied in her mind to how she views this romance. She already knows you’re a sexual man; she knows you like to touch; and the thing is, if she’s allowed it to continue, and has let the vibe grow ever more intimate, she likes it too.

This is the key to running romantic dates that pull:

You simply anchor the romance to physical, sexual escalation by having both romance and physical/sexual stuff throughout the date, escalating both the romance and the sexuality + touch at the same time.

 

Just Don’t Have Romances ‘Of the Mind’ & You’ll Do Fine
Make your romance one of the flesh as well as one of the spirit.

People today are a lot more cerebral and in-their-heads than they have been in previous decades. They’re less comfortable with touch and more awkward about escalation. If you’ve had any of these ‘mind romances’ where you created a very romantic feel with a woman, but did not escalate physically/sexually and failed to pull, you’re not an outlier or anything. You may even be the norm.

Romance does not exist to be a platonic affair. Humans did not evolve romance to just live in their minds dreaming about the “What if?”s. Romance is an adaptive mechanism to enable copulation. It exists to get man and woman together, bodies intermingled – this is true romance. The one that is purely of the mind is not.

You do women a service by consummating your romance with them. These romances are the ones they really remember.

I talked years later to that girlfriend who told me about the magic night with her officemate. As it turned out, I remembered her date with him far better than she did. In fact, she’d largely forgotten about it; I had to fill in the details for her. She still remembered our first date though, and exactly how it made her feel. At the time when we’d first gotten together, it was clear she felt more romance on the date with her officemate than she had with me, but because I was the one who consummated that romance, in time she still remembered the one with me – but the one with the man she did not go to bed with she forgot.

Creating a romantic feel on your dates can be a big helper in making your pulls and escalations smoother, IF you make sure to link these to sexual frames and physical escalation throughout.

And if you don’t have the One Date that gets girls yet, now’s the time to pick it up – get it before midnight on the 21st and you’ll get those two magic-making Limited Edition Date Flows™ too. You can watch my video on One Date here, or head straight to checkout to pick it up now (if you already own One Date, just go here to add the two Limited Edition Date Flows™ to your account for free). Just make sure you do it before midnight on the 21st, because the discount AND the Date Flows vanish after that (just like your chances with a girl you fail to close)!

Yours,
Chase Amante

Title: Peacocking Strategy: Right Mood, Right Frame, & Social Proof | Girls Chase
content:
Peacocking can offer a boon to your attraction meeting women. Yet your mood, frame, and social proof play a major role in the effectiveness of your peacocking too — or its liability.

Hey guys, and welcome back.

Lately, I have been discussing the concept of “peacocking.” Peacocking refers to dressing in a way that captures women’s attention, often wearing flashy clothing and eye-catching accessories. While this approach gained popularity in the 2000s when pickup and seduction entered the mainstream, it has faced criticism recently. Many have commented on odd-looking, uncalibrated men roaming the clubs, leading to the perception that it appears silly and meme-worthy. This backlash stems from the observation that those who attempt peacocking lack solid fundamentals and struggle to pull it off effectively.

Last week, we discussed how to peacock, providing examples of items you can wear. We covered the different dimensions that ensure you do not come off as clown-like and tacky but instead appear cool and edgy.

The “how to peacock” was covered last week. The history of peacocking, what it is, how it works, and why was covered two weeks ago.

In this article, the focus is on how peacock influences your game. It will affect your presence, people’s reactions, and the overall dynamic of your interaction to affect your overall strategy.

Let’s dive in.

 

The Right Mood
You do not want to be the sad, peacocked loner.

Do you need to peacock in night game? The answer is NO. You don’t have to. However, I still recommend dressing well in a style that suits the venue. Always strive to dress your best, as this can enhance your confidence and interactions, but it does not have to be flashy. Peacocking is a useful technique to draw all the attention to yourself, but whether that is desirable or not may depend on your mood and preferences.

Peacocking requires you to be in a social mood, and you need a strong social game to support it—typically one that is very extroverted. You will not perform well if your state is low and are not feeling energetic and confident. When you peacock, all eyes are on you, so it’s essential to exude confidence and engage effectively with others.

Experiencing too many rejections and poor interactions can be especially damaging when trying to peacock, as the spotlight magnifies all missteps. You cannot afford mistakes, so it’s crucial to be at your best. While peacocking has numerous benefits, failing to do it well can lead to harsher consequences.

 

Always Be Interacting

If you are not in a social mood and do not feel like interacting much, peacocking is not the way to go. If you do not continue your momentum and keep interacting with others, you only come off as this lonely, clownish weirdo wandering alone. So, it is crucial to interact with people as you peacock. This is essential to distinguish yourself as an edgy rockstar instead of a creepy guy who dresses oddly.

It’s fine to take a break from social interactions for a while. However, the momentum can quickly become unfavorable if you have not interacted with anyone—especially girls—for a while. Not engaging with girls for too long can create a negative vibe, particularly in smaller venues or those with a single room where you are more visible. It’s easier to blend in the crowd in larger, chaotic venues and go unnoticed. This is not the case when you stand out, as being visible puts more attention on you.

Mistakes and being seen alone doing weird stuff get punished harder.

So, what’s the point of peacocking? Well, it offers several advantages: girls opening you, making opening and hooking easier. Other girls easily see you interacting with other girls, so it becomes easy to build social proof with peacocking. You get more rewards, but if you mess up, your visibility means things will spiral downhill quickly.

There is an argument that it is wise to dress flashy when not in a social mood. A striking outfit can help trigger responses from others, encouraging girls to open you and helping to lift your mood. If that happens, great! But if it doesn’t, and you find yourself in a low mood while wearing flashy clothing but not interacting with anyone, then, my friend, that’s essentially social death.

By all means, peacock to help repair your mood, but understand that this is not without risks. I recommend not peacocking if you are tired, stressed, or in a bad state, as nothing you do will repair it. I prefer playing it safe and not peacocking on those nights. I still dress well, but that’s it. This way, I feel less pressure and can play a low-key game, usually with passive screening and target selection.

Strategy and making the right calls before you go out is crucial. However, making the right calls while in the field is equally important.

 

Peacocking and In-field Strategies
Come in the right way and be noticed.

It all comes down to making the correct entrance. When you make a statement and enter a venue confidently, all eyes will be on you. Walk in as if you own the place. The moment you step inside, you’ll notice a spike of attention on you. Use this to your advantage. Start interacting immediately—whether in the wardrobe line, at the bar, or scouting the venue, engage with girls around you. It’s easier to strike up a conversation if you get a look first. We call these “approach invitations” for a reason.

Build momentum early with multiple, short interactions. It may sound challenging, but it becomes easy if you dress to peacock, maintain confidence, and stay in a positive mood.

Get the ball rolling and interact as much as you can. If you get a solid hook, stay and try to escalate the vibe. However, it’s not your priority. First, you want to win over the venue. When peacocking, that’s your advantage—attention and lots of it. It makes winning over the venue and snowballing massive amounts of social proof much easier. Small interactions, jumping from girl to girl, re-engaging later, and introducing past leads with others to build jealousy plots and even more social proof is the name of the game. If you want to learn more, check out these posts on how to run a social proof-styled game:

Hit and Run Social Proof for Girls You Meet at Bars

Social Proof in Nightclubs: Jumps, Momentum, and Girl Circles

Using Social Proof to Get Laid: A Report (with Demonstrations)

The key is to keep building social proof until you feel you have reached enough social status, then pick a girl and escalate the vibe.

I recommend escalating the moment you start noticing a significant hook, then try to isolate and escalate. Do not fall into the trap of wanting to build more and more social proof. I realize this can be tempting, but it’s a dangerous trap. Eventually, your girl will leave, and you will end up lonely. Social proof is a means to an end to get quick openings, solid hooks, and plenty of compliance with a strong frame. The end goal is to isolate and escalate. Do not forget that.

 

When Things Do Not Go as Planned
What do you do when you’re peacocked to the gills but things aren’t going your way?

Sometimes, things may not work out. Maybe you did not get to build social proof; you started well, but your state crashes, or you end up not interacting with girls for a while, and your social value plummets. Trust me, your night can take a nosedive quickly when you peacock. How can you salvage the situation?

 

Remove the Peacocking

A simple solution whenever you feel things are going downhill is to remove the flashy portion of your outfit. Are you wearing a flashy blazer? Take it off and put it in the wardrobe—ditto for accessories like scarves and hats. Place smaller accessories like jewelry into your pocket. Now, you can switch from peacocking to a laidback game style. You lose the benefits of peacocking, but if you face a situation where you are not benefiting from it, or worse, being punished, stop peacocking.

It's a good tip to follow if you want a break from all the attention and the intense social game.

However, if too much time passes and you appear lonely and do not socialize, taking off your peacock outfit may not work, as people will have seen who you are. You may not be able to simply “take it off.”

If it is too late for that, there’s another option.

 

Change Venues

When it’s not working out, and your social value plummets, it‘s usually beyond repair. You may stay in the venue, hoping to get lucky. Some random girl arrives and happily jumps into your arms. However, everyone who has been there for a while and seen flashy you act like a lonely loser will be uninterested in interacting with you. Getting to meet them will become an uphill battle.

If this happens, there is no real way to turn things around.

But you can leave and head to another venue. It gives you a fresh start. You get to make a new entrance, and because it is a later, people will be in a more social mood, making everything easier.

It can be a great option. Few things feel better than entering a venue one hour before closing and you are all decked out, taking over the show in no time. It’s an amazing feeling.

 

Frame Control Is a Must
The flashier you are, the more you must control the frame.

The more you peacock, the better your frame control.

Because you have so many eyes on you, challenges will arise. Are you the real deal, or just some goofy guy wearing flashy clothes? People will challenge you, and you must prepare.

You will need strong frame control.

Men will use your flashy clothes to tool you, even if you are the highest-value guy in the room. You are a clear target. Some guys like to put other men down to raise their status (bully mentality), and you are not only the easiest target (so they think) but also the target they think they can gain the most reward from.

Sometimes, I would hang out in venues where high fashion people went. I observed that most men who dressed well reacted poorly to me approaching them and complimenting their style. In time, I realized this was a defense mechanism. They know most males do this to attempt to tool them. The tooling process tends to be passive-aggressive: “Cool style, bro!” (conveyed sarcastically or followed by a witty comment).

My advice? Move on. They are not worth your time. Guys coming up to you in clubs rarely have good intentions. Dust them off and continue with your night.

Here are examples of passive-aggressive comments men may use and potential responses. While ignoring such remarks is usually best, you may feel inclined to respond. The comments are listed on the left side, and the suggested responses are provided on the right.

“Dude, awesome jacket!” – “Thanks, same to you!” (delivered in an ironic tone while walking away)

“Bro, can I buy your jacket?” – “Go online and buy one yourself at www.asos.com; you are welcome, bro.”

“Hey, how much for that jacket?” – “I don’t know; a girl gave it to me; you can ask her.” (implied social proof)

“Bro, can I buy your jacket?” – “It wouldn’t suit you, no offense.”

“Are you trying to be X person?” – “No, but I need to ask: Are you trying to dress up like a bureaucrat?”

“Why are you wearing this?” – “Why are you wearing the same clothes you wear daily?”

“What the heck is this outfit” – “What the heck is this outfit? (point at his outfit) We are out partying, FYI!”

Women will also test you. However, unlike men, their intentions are less ill-intended. It is often a test to see if you are the real deal. Trust me, when you peacock, you get tested more, much more. So, who likes tests? And why peacock? The truth is, the more you get tested and pass them, the more you win attraction points. Tests are only a problem if you do not know how to handle them. But, they benefit you if you know how to tackle them (and that’s why you need great game to peacock). Tests? Bring them on! I love them! They allow me to turn her from being curious to outright attracted! Sidenote: have you noticed how experienced guys rarely complain about tests?

Examples of female questions with potential responses:

“Why are you wearing this?” – “Because I am out partying and want to enter a unique headspace, liberate myself, and have fun.”

“Are you gay?” followed by “Are you sure you are not gay?” – “Is that because I dress well? I will take that as a compliment.”

“Can I have your jacket/Can I try it on?” – “No.” (unless you get into an interaction with her, then you can use it as a lock-in prop)

“What is this outfit?” – “I am out to party and like to dress for the occasion to distinguish from my daily life and get into a different headspace.”

“What is the occasion?” – “To party; I love dressing up for a party. People around us dress so boring, and I hate boring parties. I want to make it fun and be a part of what contributes to a great vibe.”

“Do you always wear such clothes?” – “No, it is my alter ego, my party ego, my rockstar ego; maybe you’ll get to meet boring me one day.”

The point is, expect tests when you peacock. It’s why your frame control needs to be strong. At the end of the day, frame control is something you will learn to master, whether you peacock or not.

 

Parting Words
Mind your strategy and use your peacocking to aid in (rather than hamper) your seductive efforts.

Now you know how to strategize your outings and can handle the implications of peacocking. It’s essential to understand and has been under-discussed until now.

As you can see, peacocking is much more than just “wearing something fancy.” It is an art, and it is not easy to pull off. However, when pulled off correctly and confidently, it can be deadly.

Writing this post made me realize I had more to say about peacocking, particularly how it changes when you go out with others. I will discuss this further next week as an extension of this series. Today’s post focused on solo game, which is generally the best way to run game, and is the preferred style of most experienced guys. However, if you have a wingman or are out with friends, how does that influence your peacocking decisions? I will cover that topic next week.

Until next,

Alek

Title: The Rise of Blue Pill 2.0: Money, Muscles, & Rizz | Girls Chase
content:
The male space today tells men to build muscle, stack money, & deprioritize women, or rely on ‘rizz’, while PROMISING women as the eventual reward. This is BLUE PILL.

Contents

1. Blue Pill 1.0: Nice Guys

2. Introducing Blue Pill 2.0

Money + Muscles
Neo-Direct Rizz Game
Single Moms/Weak Dads

3. The Real Red Pill

4. Blue Pill Is Avoidance

5. Blue Pill No More

“You’ve been living in a dream world, Neo.”

“It is the world that has been pulled over your eyes to blind you from the truth: that you are a slave, Neo.”

A few decades ago, men started waking up from the Matrix that was the nice guy friend zone. They rejected the blue pill that would’ve kept them in platonic orbiter land, and took the red pill to start becoming ALPHA MALES.

But what if I told you the red pill most of them thought they were taking was really just another blue pill – one that simply moved them from one enslaving Matrix over into another?

Don’t worry. This article is not one claiming men should not be dominant men (they should) or that being a nice guy or hanging around in the friend zone are good things (they aren’t).

Instead, in it, I’m going to show you how along the way to enlightenment men en masse got Shanghaied, hoodwinked, and bamboozled right from one blue pill ideology straight into another – albeit one that dressed itself up all the while as ‘red pill’.

 

In the quaint olden times of 1990s and early 2000s romantic comedies, men watched tale after tale about how the nice guy friend wins the girl’s heart in the end.

Nice guy gets the girl. After the bad boy is done with her, of course.

Sure, the girl he’s in love with makes bad choice after bad choice, sleeping with one irascible bad boy after another. And sure, it hurts – him watching her go for these scoundrels who we all know will only break her heart. If only she could see what an amazing catch the nice guy protagonist is! How he’s always there for her!

But in the end, she DOES see it! She renounces her foolish ways, swearing off salacious scoundrels forever, and falls into the embrace of the patient, long-suffering nice guy, who will ecstatically accept this girl he’s been pursuing for years as his blushing bride.

This wasn’t simply a Hollywood trope, of course. There were legions of men in the real world following precisely this gameplan:

Be a girl’s friend

Be always available for her

Comfort her as she cries about her bad boy lovers

Continue to hang around her as she goes from guy to guy

Hope that eventually she realizes how great + reliable you are and chooses you

My understanding, after speaking to a large number of ‘former nice guys’ is that every guy that falls into this trap pretty much comes from one of two different backgrounds:

Raised by a single mother, OR

Raised by a domineering mother + a retreating nice guy dad

I didn’t have an upbringing like this. My father was always the man of the house. He flirted with my mother and he flirted with other women. The idea of hanging around a woman in some kind of platonic capacity seemed absurd to me and I didn’t know why you’d do it. When a girl I asked out in junior high suggested, “Let’s be friends first,” I just took that as an outright rejection and didn’t talk to her anymore. I was able to read between the lines; there was no reality in which I took a woman’s words at face value.

Yet I discovered as I got older that a lot of guys did take women’s words at face value, and they did try to do this nice guy friend zone thing to get them. Seemed like a whole bunch of wasted time and effort to me. The crowning confirmation came one night in college when I overheard a crying just-broken-up girl getting comforted by her girlfriend. Her girlfriend suggested, “What about Tom? He really likes you!” (or whatever the guy’s name was; I don’t remember anymore)

The crying girl sniffled and said, “Tom? Oh no, I couldn’t date him. He’s too nice. I’d be afraid to hurt him.”

Poor Tom. Hanging around in the friend zone for God-knows-how-long. Just sitting there patiently waiting his turn. Only for the girl he was in love with to break up with her boyfriend, sob in her loneliness, and reject the idea of ever dating Tom because he was “too nice” and she’d probably “hurt him.”

Today, unlike back then, I’d say the majority of men have figured out they do not want to be nice guys hanging around in women’s friend zones trying to portray themselves as the ideal husband material.

There are still some poor saps out there who are trapped in friend zones competing for the husband role. These guys are at least a decade out of date at this point, and apparently missed the message everybody else received.

They are the laggards in the ‘red pill adoption cycle’:

The cycle of adoption.

But for the most part nowadays men are very prickly about falling into women’s friend zones, becoming their nice guy orbiters, or being seen as husband material. They read all these as signs of women viewing them as less masculine and less irresistible – they are not, in other words, the sexy Chad she cannot refuse, but rather than unsexy ‘clean up man’ she turns to when she can’t get Chad to commit. No thanks!

Yet the men of today are having even LESS sex than they were before.

They are more single than ever before.

They are less likely to even be TRYING than before.

They are, simply put, more ALONE than ever before.

That’s because the men of today never really took ‘the red pill’.

Instead, they traded in their blue pills for an even deeper shade of blue.

The Blue Pill 2.0.

 

I have been utterly floored by the number and popularity of men in the ‘red pill’ space today who are advising men to outright ignore women and focus on money and muscles. These men then claim that if you take care of money and muscles, the woman problem gets automatically solved.

The guys who actually spend years in ‘monk mode’ developing their muscles and businesses/careers then post long, pained laments about how they have turned themselves into ‘high value males’ yet women just do not want them.

They did everything they were supposed to do, according to ‘the red pill’, yet, tragically, it was not enough.

Within the red pill, there is another branch of men who focus on what they call ‘rizz’. While ‘rizz’ is supposed to be a catchall term for charismatic flirtatious abilities, almost every video you see on ‘rizz’ is of some guy making a totally uncharismatic, barebones neo-direct approach upon a girl and receiving a ‘brush off phone number’ – i.e., when a girl gives you her number just to make you go away (then never responds to your texts).

What you will notice with both the red pill money, muscles, and looks guys and the rizz guys is that after they put enough time into their respective ‘red pill life paths’ and they do NOT get women, they become extremely frustrated and conclude the same thing:

Something must be wrong with women.

Intriguingly, it is the same exact thing blue pill men in the nice guy era also concluded:

“Something’s wrong with girls. They just aren’t interested in nice guys!”

“Something’s wrong with girls. They just aren’t interested in fit guys with good jobs!”

“Something’s wrong with girls. They just aren’t interested when you hit them with rizz!”

Yet it isn’t women that something is wrong with.

Women are doing the same things they have always done, pursuing the same men they have always pursued, responding to the same stimuli they have always responded to the, the same way they always have.

READ MORE: How to Get Girls: The Last Post You'll Ever Need

Read it and understand.

It is the operating systems the men are working from that have led them astray.

Because just like women don’t fall in love with nice guys in their friend zones, they also don’t flock to guys with muscles and money, and they don’t fall all over themselves for guys doing ultra-basic generic compliment + phone number grabs they call ‘rizz’.

While men in the latter camp call themselves ‘red pill’ to feel cool, they haven’t really taken a red pill into ‘reality’ at all.

Instead, they have merely traded one blue pill for another – Blue Pill 1.0 for Blue Pill 2.0.

 

Money + Muscles Is the Blue Pill
These pills are blue.

“Girls like guys with a good job.”

“Girls want men who are healthy.”

This is blue pill mainstream advice anyone would have happily shared with you in 1995.

Meanwhile alcoholic drug abusers with employment problems were shagging loads of sexy girls while the healthy guys with good careers went dutifully off to work then stood around looking like nebbish prairie dogs during happy hour.

Fast forward a couple of decades. What’s the ‘red pill’ advise men to do today?

“Ignore women. Focus on money and fitness. Then the women will come.”

Meanwhile the alcoholic drug abusers with employment problems are shagging loads of sexy girls while the gymcel money bros with fat bank accounts spend all day shuttling back and forth between the gym and their home office, devoid of human contact, swiping on dating apps where they match with low caliber slutty girls 2-3 points lower than them on the looks scale.

Focus on money and muscles then the women will come is BLUE PILL. This is Blue Pill 2.0; the same as Blue Pill 1.0, simply dressed up in slightly more masculine fittings.

You can literally take any 1990s ‘blue pill’ cliché, put a more masculine spin on it, and have it fit in with today’s ‘red pill’ (i.e., Blue Pill 2.0):

“Just be yourself” = “Be true to yourself, bro. Don’t try to be someone you’re not”

“If it’s meant to be, it’ll be” = “If she’s not enthusiastic for you just move on, bro”

“Girls like guys with a good job” = “Stack your paper and the women will come”

“Girls like guys who are healthy” = “Muscles are the ultimate peacock”

“If you build it, they will come” = “Focus on YOU and the girls can smell it”

“Be her friend first” = “You have to let her see your value”

It’s so amazing to me that most guys don’t see it. Am I the only one who sees this red pill stuff is really just ‘blue pill, BUT MANLIER’? It’s really obvious when you spell it out, isn’t it?

All this ‘just do money + muscles’ stuff is Blue Pill 2.0.

 

Neo-Direct ‘Rizz Game’ is the Blue Pill
Neo-direct is, sadly, blue pill.

When I first found the seduction community in 2005, I discovered a little seduction book by a guy named Roy Valentine called The System. The System broke women down into three (3) categories:

Women who aren’t interested in or available to you at all

Women who are somewhat interested (grab their numbers)

Women who are HIGHLY interested (same-day lay them!)

I thought this was a pretty good distinction. I didn’t see it stressed much in the seduction community proper. Nevertheless, I adopted it as an operating system of my own. Rather than aim to seduce every girl, I focused on being highly attuned to women to screen them for compliance and receptivity – that way I could focus my energies on those girls most interested in me.

I never ruled out going for closed off girls entirely. In fact, I enjoy picking them up – but only sometimes. If you’re not in the mood to go all out, then you filter for more interested girls.

Today, the mainstream (‘red pill’ / i.e., Blue Pill 2.0) advice for men is that if a girl is not enthusiastically into you from the jump (that is, those Girls C from Roy Valentine’s System) you should just not even bother with her.

The problem is that you do not know how receptive she is to you usually until you’ve gamed her for at least a couple minutes. Most girls you will meet most of the time are going to be in their heads and not in social mode when you approach. If your entire approach to meeting girls is like what you see in ‘rizz videos’, you are not even giving girls a chance to actually switch into even considering you as a prospective mate.

This is terrible game.

All these rizz guys do the same exact thing, and it bombs every time.

The awful, uninspired approaches these guys make get them flakey numbers, ghosts, or even (in this guy’s case) the girl’s boyfriend’s number.

Tragic. pic.twitter.com/5NMRWMpwWI

— Girls Chase 🏃‍♀️💨 (@GirlsChase) January 17, 2025

‘Rizz men’ make super simple approaches, typically with poor approach angles, generic openers, and inexpressive voices, and leap straight to asking the girl for her number.

This is not game, at all, whatsoever.

If it’s not really game, then, what is it?

It is offering yourself up for judgment based on appearance alone:

“Here I am, look at me, would you like to date me?”

Only problem: women are not visual screeners. Unlike a man who sees a hot woman and says, “Oh yes; her!” women need time to figure out if they are attracted to a man’s behavior. Even if they think he looks cute they are not making decisions based off his appearance alone.

Rizz guys – who are, in fact, blue pill (in that they are not aware of the reality of how women work) – are blind to this.

All the rizz stuff, like the muscles and the money, is Blue Pill 2.0!

 

How Much of This is Due to Single Mothers / Weak Fathers?

I strongly suspect a lot of the popularity of Blue Pill 2.0, as with Blue Pill 1.0, comes down to its appeal to men of those same backgrounds:

Raised by a single mother, OR

Raised by a domineering mother + a retreating nice guy dad

Are there many men raised by strong fathers whom women were attracted to who themselves avoid women, preferring to bury themselves in gym or business, or approach women with super simple, ineffectual neo-direct ‘rizz game’?

I’d be very surprised.

I suspect what happened was men slowly woke up to Blue Pill 1.0 being ineffectual, tried to switch to something better, only to end up concocting a different sort of Blue Pill for themselves (2.0) because it just naturally fit their internal belief systems better.

The irony is that Blue Pill 1.0, as dumb as it was, actually served men better than Blue Pill 2.0.

At least with Blue Pill 1.0, men were still around women, hoping for ‘their shot’, and had positive impressions of women and relationships with them.

Under Blue Pill 2.0, there are entire swaths of men now who’ve cut themselves off from women because “I would never sink so low as to be a pussy beggar hanging around in a woman’s friend zone.” Yet because these guys have developed no other attractive qualities, no REAL ‘rizz’, they basically have no route to getting women and end up totally celibate, frustrated, and bitter.

 

Since the beginning of the movement, the red pill has contained a mix of actual truths jumbled up together with a bunch of avoidant attachment style nonsense. While it started as basically a collection of pickup artists, MGTOWs, and MRAs (men’s rights activists), it then turned political, then got BIG, and basically became a new mainstream.

At that point, all the ‘blue pill’ guys invaded, bringing their same mentalities along but outfitting them with cooler masculine wording and tough guy positioning. Like any movement that grows too big, the influx of the masses watered the red pill down.

Red pill was always sort of a club / ideological purity test, as I discussed back in 2014. But nowadays, except for some corners of it here and there, much of its lifestyle advice has dovetailed back to being mainstream ‘blue pill’ advice.

The real red pill is this:

Money doesn’t help you very much with women. You can pick up girls broke (and may even find it easier; I certainly did). Money really only becomes more important in retention; it is difficult to keep a wife and raise a family when you are totally broke. Having some money at this point becomes fairly necessary.

Muscles do not really help you much with women at all. Muscles make you look a little better, but unless you’re in a muscle shirt most people cannot tell under your clothes what you look like. Your face looks better when you are in-shape, but you can achieve most of this effect just by slimming down if you are fat.

Neo-direct / rizz ‘compliment then ask for her number’ approaches have sky-high failure rates. You either won’t get the number at all (“Sorry, I have a boyfriend”), and she will just reject you, or she will insist on pawning you off to her Instagram to make you a follower on IG (never to DM you again). If you’re lucky, you may get a phone number… which she then flakes on responding to.

Blue Pill 2.0 guys get very frustrated after dumping a lot of time into these avenues, only to find they do not lead to women… just as Blue Pill 1.0 guys get very frustrated after devoting so much effort to being nice, doing favors, and making themselves ultra available to women as friends only to watch the girls they like pick a sexy bad boy over them yet again.

The Blue Pill guy concludes “Well there is something wrong with women, because I know that I sure am doing everything right! It’s what all the mainstream/red pill bros told me!”

That’s deep blue pill thinking. “I’m doing what I’m supposed to so if I don’t get the results the problem isn’t me.” Blue pill.

Here is actual, reality-based, real ‘red pill’ thinking:

“If what I’m doing isn’t working, then I am doing the wrong thing.”

That’s the red pill.

If a guy is frustrated and talking about how it “shouldn’t be this way”, it’s not reality pilled.

 

Look at all these things:

Hanging around a girl for months/years being subservient and nice

Avoiding girls to go in the gym and lift for years to get really swole

Avoiding girls to focus on your hustle to stack paper and get rich

Approaching girls with zero flirtation and immediately trying to number grab

What do all these things have in common?

Every single one of them, if done with the hope or intention of ending up balls deep in women in the end, is AVOIDANCE.

It is AVOIDANCE because it avoids doing the thing that actually gets you balls deep in women: engaging in the human courtship ritual.

There’s a seeming conflict of interest with a paid instructor: if he’s paid to do it, can he really be disinterested? Someone who gives instruction totally unpaid seems more trustworthy!

This article is about why this mindset is aggressively stupid and traps the idiots who subscribe to it in valleys of ineffectuality and lackluster returns.

Remember: with advice, as with anything else, you get what you pay for.

 

The Best Advisors Are ALWAYS Paid

Two weeks ago, you sliced open your hand. You bandaged it up and figured it’d heal. But now it’s swollen, very painful, and oozing puss. You’re worried it might be infected. What are the odds you could lose your hand?

You have an option of two people to choose as your advisors:

Your neighbor Phil, an arborist (i.e., someone who works on trees) who plays Dungeons & Dragons in his spare time and always has an opinion on everything, who tells you swelling is normal in an injury and just to wipe away the puss and rebandage the wound.

A medical doctor from the local hospital who treats multiple swollen, weeping, and potentially infected injuries every week, and has for decades, who tells you the wound is infected and prescribes you a round of antibiotics to kill the infection so he doesn’t have to amputate your hand.

Will you choose opinionated neighbor Phil or the hospital’s medical doctor as your advisor?

In case you do not know: a swollen, weeping injury is an infected one. If you listen to Phil, you lose your hand. And that is only if you give up and go to the doctor quick enough. If you delay, you lose your arm, or even (if you allow the infection to progress all the way up the arm into your chest) you lose your life.

Even if Neighbor Phil has read a lot of medical articles and thinks he knows his stuff, the reality is he is not a practitioner and has not dealt with swollen, puss-oozing wounds day-in, day-out for years or decades. He has not seen a multitude of cases that present in a multitude of ways, nor has he learned to diagnose unclear situations. He has no true, experienced-based roadmap for determining what is a medical emergency versus what is something you can just relax about.

This is the difference between true professionals and ‘armchair advisors’ in EVERY FIELD KNOWN TO MAN.

If it is something you do not want to screw up in, YOU GO TO A PROFESSIONAL.

Do You Really Need to Learn Game to Get Girls?

How to Get Girls: The Last Post You'll Ever Need

Males of Every Species Must Learn Game to Mate

Real Empiricists Test

Sales

Writing
Copywriting
Pickup
Relationships

On top of that, every highly opinionated non-expert non-professional advisor tends to be deep in the Dunning-Kruger. Dunning-Kruger:

The effect whereby unknowledgeable people who know very little consider themselves to have mastery over a subject and think highly of their non-existent ‘expertise’… meanwhile masters of a field, despite their massive advantage in experience, ability, competence, and comprehension, realize just how vast their field is and how much they still don’t know, so are much more careful in their advice and more open to considering the possibility that they may be wrong.

Is it also GOOD ADVICE? YES!

Ricardus, one of our early contributors, spent years consuming pirated ‘make money online’ courses he didn’t pay anything for, and never did anything with that material because it was ‘free’ and he didn’t value it highly.

One day, he decided to change his approach: he purchased Jeff Walker’s $2,000 Product Launch Formula (despite only having $10,000 in the bank) and committed himself to going through it. Because he’d paid for it, he treated it much more seriously; he followed the instructions to the letter, researched a niche to launch a business in, researched his target market, researched his customer avatar, started building his launch list, polled his audience for what would help them most, then built the product.

Then he bought Jon Benson’s 3x VSL (today called ‘NowVSL’) for another $2,000 and learned how to create a video sales letter (VSL) that would really sell. He wrote his VSL, PLF-launched his product, made $20,000 on the launch, relaunched again the next month for $30,000, and pretty soon had an evergreen product he could relaunch once per month for a cool $30,000 every time. He went onto more business success, made some good investments, and now he never needs to work again. He credits all that success to finally paying for advice, which got him to actually commit to using it.

(by the same coin, Ricardus also credits paying Captain Jack, a playboy from Mystery’s circle who was laying crazy amounts of girls from nightclub pulls in Texas, for taking his game with girls to the stratosphere. Ricardus had self-taught himself seduction for years with forum posts, articles, videos, and pirated content, but it wasn’t until he paid Captain Jack to train him that his results really took off)

It is possible to become a success without paying. I have heard from men who never paid for anything and have used only free materials to achieve great success. If you can do it, that is awesome.

For the rest of us mere mortals, however, there is something about paying that adds an extra incentive to make sure you get SERIOUS about implementation – and on top of that, paying simply gives you access to the BEST stuff, more coherently designed for implementation (assuming you choose the right professional).

The final note here is that in any market, there are always going to be ‘professionals’ who are not very skilled. Some of them are expert marketers who just have ‘okay’ products and services (merely good enough offerings that they do not drown in refunds) while others can even be outright scammers. There are also a whole lot of ‘professionals’ in every field who just are not very good.

I had hernia surgery last year. I guess my form wasn’t good enough back in my weight-lifting days, because I’d had a bit of intestine poking out of my abdominal wall muscle for over a decade. One of the things you learn about hernia surgery is it is very, very IMPORTANT to choose a surgeon who is extremely experienced and has done thousands of hernia surgeries.

Ideally, you want a surgeon who simply repairs hernias day-in, day-out, every day, and just does lots and lots of these and is used to doing them. If you ever watch a laparoscopic hernia surgery video on YouTube you will quickly understand why skill is so important in this surgery; the surgeon is navigating around in your insides, cutting through fat while barely being able to see anything, and must have very clear ideas about where certain nerves and vessels are likely to be hiding in the fat, and able to identify them from small hints as he maneuvers around in there. Then there is the placing of the mesh to close up the hole in the abdominal wall: no simple feat, and if it is placed wrong, it may come loose, or even pinch a nerve (which will cause you pain forever).

You can read hernia horror stories from people with everlasting pain due to the placement of their meshes, or others where surgeons severed one of their nerves intentionally to ‘not cause discomfort’ because of where the surgeon put the mesh (now the patient has a permanent numb spot in that area on his body). That’s what you get with a cut-rate surgeon.

When I was in the hospital, in the middle bed in my hospital room was a man of about 60 who’d been in the hospital for a month. When I asked why (with hernia surgery, you’re out of the hospital the same day you have the surgery), he said he’d gone to a cheaper surgeon at his local hospital outside the city, but the surgeon messed his surgery up. Now he was here, in the good hospital we were at, and I don’t know why it was taking them so long to patch him up, but I saw them cleaning him in the morning, around the part of his intestine that was actually sticking OUT of his body (not just bulging against the skin like mine; his was poking out!), and it’s obvious it was excruciating.

(that’s not the only hernia horror story I have. A coworker of mine in my tire salesman days had an uncle whose inexperienced hernia surgeon accidentally severed one of his testicles when going up through the scrotum, then in his fumbling attempt to continue chopped the remaining testicle in two. The experienced surgeon who’d been overseeing him took over after that. When I signed up for my hernia surgery, I made it explicitly clear with the surgeon that there would be no surgeon trainees doing my surgery, and that only he, the very experienced surgeon, would do the work!)

I use the medical field here because it’s more familiar to most people and it’s easy to see how the results come from the specific surgery or surgeon, but the same logic applies to anything you pay for a professional in.

There are always ‘professionals’ who are only in it for the money, who do not take their craft seriously, who just look at it as a job, and who do not care about client outcomes. The job of the potential student or client is to do his homework and ensure the professional he chooses is one worth paying for his products or services.

Seduction-wise, normal men often have a pretty bad radar for what is ‘good’ seduction vs. what is not (just look at the hare-brained ‘rizz’ trend on social media + all that neo-direct), so if you want to improve your radar on that, check out Alek Rolstad’s article on doing so.

READ MORE: How to Tell If a Guy is a Good Seducer

What you should look for.

We have an updated testimonials page on the new theme we’re coming out with, but you can see the testimonials I have for One Date on our testimonials page here.

The process of choosing a professional is always going to be one of sifting treasures from trash; good apples from bad.

If you make the right choice, however, the benefits can be life-changing; something that will never be available to the folks who think anyone who charges for his products or services is no one you ought ever to heed.

You get what you pay for!

Yours,
Chase Amante

Title: Tactics Tuesdays: 3 Ways to Disarm Your Drawbacks | Girls Chase
content:
You might be short, poor, bald, ugly, dumb, or out-of-step; we’ve all got drawbacks. Yet how do you deal with these when women bring them up?

It’s pretty common for men to feel insecure about whatever drawbacks they may have:

Too short
Too ugly
Too bald
Too broke
Too young
Too old
Too much of a nobody
Too unaccomplished
Too awkward
Too dumb
Too out-of-step with the culture

Guys will put off approaching girls, skip approaching altogether, and otherwise remain stuck in safe spaces out of fear of rejection over their drawbacks.

When they do make an approach on a girl, they often look for ways to self-deprecate, which only highlights their weakness and makes them look insecure; or else they act defensive if it gets brought up, which again makes them seem insecure.

How, then, do you defuse your disadvantages when you approach new girls – or even when you go on a date, or are inside a relationship?

In this Tactics Tuesdays installment, I’ll provide you with three (3) separate (but each one of them useful) ways.

 

Disarm #1: High Status Snub
One way to nonverbally snub.

The first way to disarm a drawback of yours is to wait for someone to bring it up, then respond with a bit of a snub that comes across haughty and high status.

For example, say you’re talking to a girl, and she tests you indirectly on one of your drawbacks:

HER: Do you like travel?

YOU: Yeah. I’ve been down to Texas and Florida, and as far west as Minnesota.

HER: [laughs] That’s it? You haven’t left the country?

YOU: [break eye contact to the side, shrug eyebrows & shoulders; use a skeptical look] Perhaps someday…

What you have done here is to signal her in a high status way that she is losing you.

Another way to snub.

What makes it high status is its adherence to the Law of Least Effort. When you communicate to her in a clear (this will be clear to her as a woman) yet minimal effort way your displeasure, you achieve the maximum result for the minimum effort, and exhibit high social power… and status.

If you want, you can also be slightly more direct, though note that this MAY invite more challenges/tests (fine to use if you’re prepared for this):

HER: Do you like travel?

YOU: Yeah. I’ve been down to Texas and Florida, and as far west as Minnesota.

HER: [laughs] That’s it? You haven’t left the country?

YOU: [break eye contact to the side, shrug eyebrows & shoulders] [sigh] You’re losing me.

Although you mix words in so you can tell her directly, making this snub somewhat more effortful, you also prize yourself by telling her that “she is losing you.” i.e., you are the prize, she is not, and if she wants to not miss out on the prize, she needs to step things up.

All told, the High Status Snub is the simplest way to defuse a woman bringing up one of your weaknesses. Yet it is still high-powered. This makes it a great choice for beginners and masters of the social arts alike.

 

Disarm #2: Agree & Amplify

A classic test response, the value of agree and amplify is how adeptly it can turn the test or tease back upon the tester/teaser.

The one downside to agree & amplify here is you must use it properly to not come across defensive. That is to say, your timing and delivery are especially important.

The real caveat here is that she should be testing you on your weakness playfully to use this one.

Here’s what that looks like:

HER: [somewhat playful tone] Are you too broke to buy a lady drinks?

YOU: As soon as I get them to remove the lien on my bank account your drinks are all yours.

In this case, agree and amplify works because her testing was playful. She isn’t actually trying to use this disadvantage of yours to disqualify you; merely to test you.

Agree and amplify does not work if she’s actively trying to disqualify you:

HER: [serious tone, serious face] I don’t think you have enough money to date someone like me.

YOU: I don’t have enough money to date your TOENAILS! Boy, those look expensive. But who said anything about dating?

In this case, agree and amplify does not work because the woman was serious and trying to use her judgment to get rid of you.

The more playful she’s being, the more agree & amplify can work. The more serious she’s being, the more you must use something else.

That said, if she is dead set on rejecting you, none of these drawback defusers will work, because it is not about the objection – it is about a rejection. Remember: girls don’t reject for any reasons they can rationally define. She may choose a drawback of yours as the scapegoat to explain her rejection; but that is all it is, a scapegoat. She does not know how to say, “I found your approach too off-the-wall and miscalibrated, your humor offensive instead of funny, and did not like the way you danced around in the polite zone not touching me; the tension gap you created made things very awkward. I don’t feel similar to you at all, you’re not arousing me, and I see no reason to comply with you, therefore I am also not attracted. Goodbye.”

 

Disarm #3: Test or Compare Her Back

Our final tactic to defuse a drawback test is to test (or compare) the girl right back.

For instance:

HER: You’re too short for me. I only date men over 6’.

YOU: [bored look on face; place your hand flat atop her head, then move it through the air until it touches the spot on you that corresponds to her height; then act extra surprised/flummoxed at the result]

This is basically a high status snub, with a twist: here you are showing her that, really, she is much shorter than you (your hand is probably going to stop at your nose or even chin), which makes her entire objection seem ridiculous.

Most likely she will start trying to explain herself, which puts you in the driver’s seat. You can just tell her, “Uh-huh, right. Okay. Sure,” and let her continue to qualify her reasoning.

Here’s another example:

HER: I don’t think you’re smart enough for me.

YOU: [bored look; place hands around the outside of your skull; slowly move over to her skull and place around her skull at a distance equal to the size of your skull; move hands back and forth between this position and her actual skull size while looking at her in a quizzical way, showing confusion at how much smaller her skull is than yours]

What you are suggesting, of course, is that her skull is smaller than yours (which it will be; she is a woman and she is smaller, right?), so she must be dumber than you. Even if she tries to argue she is not, actions speak louder than words, and all she has been able to do is talk; you, on the other hand, have made a demonstration.

(is the demonstration accurate? No, head circumference does not reliably denote intelligence. You know it, she knows it, everyone around her knows it, but there in the moment no one can really explain WHY that is true, and human social behavior is governed much more by appearance than truth. You demonstrate in a simple action why she ‘should not be’ as smart as you, and in so doing it actually makes you look cleverer and of the higher social power)

This disarm is slightly mocking, and often requires some degree of touch (which is doubly risky because it is done in a slightly mocking way; much easier for her to simply brush your hand aside and call you a creep if you do not know what you’re doing).

For that reason, I only recommend this disarm for somewhat higher level practitioners of game.

 

Never Bring Up Drawbacks Yourself!

I often see beginners dredge up their own drawbacks, presumably to get in front of them.

If you already pointed it out, now how can anyone else??? seems to go the logic.

This is flawed logic. It is apparently based upon comedians, who do this a lot; but most comedians are not objectively high status men. Instead, they are approval-seeking men whose entire lives revolve around crafting lines they hope people will find funny, standing on stage delivering them hoping that people will laugh, getting depressed and having to change their lines if people don’t laugh, and finally putting together a big moneymaking show based on the material they tested at various smaller shows and found that people will laugh at.

The only reason famous comedians appear high status in society is because they are famous. Yet as far as famous people go, they are among the lowest status famous people, because everybody knows they’re try-hard.

You do not want to be try-hard, like the ‘trying too hard’ comedian. You want to be confident. Confident men don’t bring up their flaws because they forget they have them unless and until someone brings them up.

Confident short men don’t walk around worrying about, “I’d better defuse my shortness just as soon as I can!” Instead, they don’t even think about it until someone brings it up, at which point they treat that person as rather tone deaf and potentially lower status.

READ MORE: Dating as a Short Guy: What to Know and Do

How to win with girls in spite of being a man who’s short of height.

Bringing up your own drawbacks tells people a few things:

You think about your drawbacks
You worry about your drawbacks
You worry about social approval

None of these are the marks of a socially powerful man.

Instead, you simply do not bring up anything that anyone might consider as a drawback. If anyone should bring it up, you handle it there and then.

 

Everybody Has Drawbacks

If you’re a guy crippled by indecision over his drawbacks, just keep it in mind:

We all have drawbacks.

Trust me, we all have drawbacks. Women are probably more self-conscious than you are.

There is not a man (nor a woman) on the planet who does not have SOME drawback that is painfully obvious within a minute or two of talking to that person.

Sure, some people may have more obvious drawbacks than others, but we’ve all got ‘em, and a single drawback is all you need to become the target of a test like this, and there is not a single person of either sex who is immune to it.

What you will find when you approach is many women are surprisingly oblivious to whatever the thing you’re most worried about is.

I used to worry women would dislike my:

Ridged nose
Pale skin
Red hair
Widow’s peak
Crooked lower front teeth
Left leg birthmark
Keloid-scarred shoulders

… yet I found women almost never commented on any of this. When I started out, I was FAT (now I’m not), and worried this would hinder me with women, but women never said anything.

Have those attributes made me less attractive to some women? Probably. But I have no way to know which women cared and which women didn’t. I have still dated and slept with many beautiful and wonderful women over the years. The first few really stunning girls I kept asking myself, “How the heck did this girl go for ME? ME?” but after a few like that you just stop questioning it. You just accept that people care about different things, and even if something might’ve put you off dating someone else if she had it, it often won’t be a dealbreaker for every woman you meet when it comes to assessing you.

If you’re plagued by worrying about your drawbacks, the only thing I can tell you is as I told you yesterday: put your focus outside yourself, onto the woman, and stop worrying about yourself, what others think about you, and how others might judge you.

And that’s a wrap for our three (3) ways to disarm your drawbacks!

Stay skeptical, stay high status, and make those silly girls sorry they ever tried to test you on them!

Chase

Title: Secrets to Getting Girls: Focus Outward | Girls Chase
content:
If you want to attract girls, you need to focus on girls – not yourself. Get out of your head, into the moment, and focused upon the opposite sex!

I had a guy message me with some concerns that he may not be good enough for girls.

It was hard for him to motivate himself to approach women, he said, because he just did not see why anyone would value him or want to talk to him.

What most people would probably focus on is trying to buoy the confidence of a man in his position. “Think about your good qualities!” “Focus on the bright side!” “There’s surely a girl who will like you for you!”

What I advised him on was, instead, one of the Secrets to Getting Girls:

To switch his mentality from an inward focus to an outward one.

 

Successful Romantics Focus Outward

To charm a woman, to bewitch her, to pull her into your world, there is one thing you absolutely cannot be: inward-looking; in your head; inner-focused; navel-gazing.

Seduction is an outward focused activity. It revolves around one’s focus upon other people. So long as a man stays focused on himself, he cannot seduce.

There is nothing in a man’s nature that forces him to be inward-looking. I was the King of the Navel-Gazers for the first few decades of my life; until I switched my focus. Any man can.

How do you charm a woman? You do so by:

Conveying genuine interest in her

Picking and probing her in conversation to learn more

Drawing out the interesting aspects about her

Expressing sincere appreciation for her better qualities

Qualifying her on the things you learn that you enjoy

None of these can you do when you are trapped inside your head!

Think fast: who’s the most interesting man in the world to a woman?

He is NOT:

The man who travels the world and explores faraway places

The man who drives expensive cars and throws yacht parties

The man who name-drops the celebrities he’s friends with

Each one of those men CAN BE obscenely boring to women.

“But if a man like that’s not interesting, who possibly can be?” I hear you say.,

This man:

The man who gets a woman to open up.

To her, THAT is the most interesting man in the world.

That’s because, to each and every one of us, the most interesting topic is ourselves… and the most interesting person is the one who lets us talk about ourselves, and understands us, and approves.

You cannot do this when you are focused inward, on yourself.

You can only do it when you are focused outward, on her.

 

Seduction Is Not About ‘You’ at All
Quit focusing on yourself.

One of the biggest mindset shifts between a neophyte and a skilled seducer is that the seduction has very little to do with the man himself, and very much to do with the experience he creates for a woman.

She is looking for something: a certain stimulus, a certain moment, a certain kind of experience.

When she receives it, she will fall for the man who gives it to her, go to bed with him, and enter a relationship with him if he so wishes.

This is seduction. Seduction is NOT ‘show up and let a woman pick you’. Seduction is ‘uncover what she wants and use that to lead her to intimacy’.

Most men try to make romance all about themselves, about trying to get women to ‘pick’ them. “Pick me, pick me!” men seem to say. “Look at me – I’m interesting!” “I lead a cool life!” “I’d be devoted to you!” “I’d rock your world!”

When a woman isn’t interested, such men take the rejection as personal, feeling that they have put their wares on display and been passed by for another seller. They become angry, bitter, sad, and depressed.

But seduction is not about ‘being picked’. It is about ‘drawing in’. About connecting, charming, and leading. That is what it is TO SEDUCE.

The seducer knows seduction is not about him.

It does not matter what he has to offer, aside from the experience he creates.

It does not matter whom he is.

In fact, she does not even need to know his name.

All that matters is whether he is capable of creating an EXPERIENCE for her – or not.

 

Outward-Focused Men Are Charmers
You’re much more appealing when you’re focused on others.

It is impossible to charm when you are inward focused, because charm requires a sensitivity to others the inward-focused man lacks.

When a man focuses inwards, his attentions are turned to himself. He critiques himself, examines himself, advises himself, and judges himself. He is quite excellent, he thinks; so why do women not like him more? Or, he is lacking in attractive qualities, he fears; it’s no wonder he’s so alone!

Can a man thinking thus attract a woman, a new friend, or a coterie of admirers? No, he cannot. The inward-focused man simply lacks the mental bandwidth to do so; he is much too busy thinking about himself.

Think of any preacher, politician, salesman, comedian, or storyteller you have watched who was good. When you watched this master in action, what do you think he was focused on? Do you think he was judging himself? Or do you think he was scrutinizing every action and reaction of the people in front of him, adjusting his presentation on the fly to better lead his audience to directly where he wanted them to go, right to what he wanted them to feel?

An outward focus enables a man to turn his mental horsepower onto the issue of adjusting his communication and presentation to his interlocutors or audience. It enables him to tweak and optimize in real time to better convey what he wants to convey, to course correct when he missteps, and to respond to challenges and interruptions.

An outward focus is a telephone booth that turns Clark Kents into Supermen every time they enter into it.

 

You Do Not Need to Give Up Being Introspective

Adopting an outward focus for socializing and seduction does not mean you can no longer introspect.

Instead, it means that rather than introspect all the time, you will instead use the right tool for the right situation:

Early morning, when planning out your day: review your plans, decide whether you are on-track or off-track, ask yourself how you feel, if you are doing what you need to do in life, what you must focus on today to get you closer to where you need to go. Inward focus.

During exercise, whether calisthenics or lifting weights: inner OR outer focus. Personally I find I can push myself to go further in exercise when using an outer focus; but sometimes it is nice to just exercise while also thinking deep thoughts, too.

Socializing, when talking with women, men, business contacts, etc.: focus on other people. It’s the whole point of this article! It is a secret to getting girls!

Evening, when reviewing the day’s events, analyzing social outings, assessing sticking points, making action plans: inner focus. Once again, you will introspect and analyze inside your head. It’s fine to do!

There is nothing wrong with introspection, and you can make many leaps and bounds by doing it.

HOWEVER – you must use the correct tool for the correct problem.

Socializing and romance are problems to be solved with outer focus, rather than inner… at least in the moment, when facing other people.

 

Switching to an Outer Focus

It takes some work for a beginner to start focusing consistently on the people he is talking to, rather than always worrying about himself.

Any man struggling with approach anxiety, for instance, is also struggling to escape an inward focus. When you are outward focused, you are not worried about approaching, because there is nothing to fear; there is only adjusting the approach you make to try to optimize the girl’s reaction. And, if it flops, adjusting so your next approach goes better.

Look at this typical thought process of a man with approach anxiety:

“Oh man, I have to go talk to that girl. But I’m not sure what to say! What if she’s rude and rejects me. What if she doesn’t like me. What if she has a boyfriend and rejects me and everyone sees. Oh! It would be so embarrassing!”

This man is focused on his emotions and feelings. He is inward focused.

Contrast that against the inner thoughts of a man about to approach who is outward focused:

“Is that girl available? She seems like she is. Let’s see if there’s a good opening to talk to her. Okay, there’s how to approach her. Let’s go in.” [approach] [open]

He is not thinking about his own emotions. He is not worrying about saving face. He is just searching for the best angle to approach, and maybe the best opening line to use, while also not wasting time because he doesn’t want to miss his chance or go back into his head (i.e., slip into inward-focused mental masturbation).

So how do you do this?

Through a specific mental training program.

Here is the program:

Every time you go out, every time you are in SOCIAL SITUATIONS, whenever you start to introspect, recognize it, and force yourself not to. Think, “I am introspecting again. Time focus on other people.”

Start by just making observations about other people. If you tell yourself “focus on other people” but get no more specific than that, you will fail, because that’s too vague, and by the way, you’re nervous. Instead, MAKE OBSERVATIONS. Even simple ones are good. “He is tall” “she is short” “it looks like that girl is with her boyfriend” “I think those three are friends” “that guy is all over her but she doesn’t look interested” “it seems like that girl is open to meeting someone” etc. After a few minutes of this you will start to notice your anxiety drifting away as you focus more and more on other people.

Develop mental defenses against getting in your head. At this point (as a naturally introspective guy) I have trained myself up to have particular defenses against navel-gazing. For instance, as soon as my thoughts start drifting inward in social situations, some part of my brain fires off an alert and goes “Whoa! Looking inward! Must talk to others and focus on other people!” I will then immediately look for someone to talk to, and if I can’t find anyone, start making observations about the people and situation until I can find a conversation partner. It took me perhaps a year in-field to get this automatic alert embedded (after many outings where I’d go out, get into my head, be unable to continue, and either slink home in defeat or hang around in my head and miserable for hours).

On that last: hanging around when you are in your head and figuring out how to get back out of it is a critical learning experience to have. If you’re prone to introspection, you need to strengthen those “getting out of your head” muscles, and the only way to do that is by exercising that ability. You need to be out in social situations, feel yourself sliding into or already inside of an inward focus, and take the steps to pull yourself back out of it.

With time, this gets easier and easier and more automatic for you to do.

 

The Outward-Focused Charmer
Focus on her, instead of yourself, and she’ll find you far more difficult to resist.

If you want to charm women, seduce them, attract them, and be cool, you need to be outward focused.

Not all the time. You don’t need to be it when you are by yourself, reviewing your life, or introspecting for your own enjoyment. But when you are with other people, do yourself and everyone else a favor and focus on them.

By ‘focus on them’ I do NOT mean:

What you think they think of you
What you think they might like about you
What you think they want to hear from you

… because all that is really just you thinking about you, albeit via the intermediary of what you IMAGINE is going on in someone else’s head.

‘YOU’ need to be completely out of the picture. You need to focus on THEM!

That means:

What passions does she have?
What motivates her to do [something she does]?
How did she end up the way she is?
Where does she see herself in the future?

Curiosity about HER!

This is the part where some people tell me, “But Chase, I’m just not interested in other people.”

For that, the only thing I can say is you’d better cultivate some interest if you want to be socially successful. Or, if you don’t want to, then why do you care about being socially successful?

I didn’t care about tires at all when I became a tire salesman, but you’d better believe that in order to meet my sales numbers I became the most studious tire afficionado you ever met. I haven’t sold a tire in almost twenty years but I still point out things about tires I notice whenever I’m talking to people and there are tires around (and then I shake my head at how unknowledgeable others are about tread depth and wear patterns. For shame).

You cannot be a seducer if you are uninterested in those you wish to seduce.

You don’t necessarily have to be interested in every aspect of them.

I, for instance, am bored to death by popular culture. But some guys love it. I have known multiple seducers who built their methods around popular culture references. Girls love it, they love it; match made in heaven.

I’m deeply interested in what makes people tick. Why does she think the way she does? Why has she embarked down the life path she has? Deep diving and eliciting values works amazing for me. Not only does it build loads of chemistry with her but it tells me all the stuff I want to know!

Alek Rolstad is fascinated with sex. I haven’t asked him this specifically, but I would bet you he finds it very interesting to hear about women’s various sexual desires, escapades, and fetishes. Because he does, that is what he talks about with them: sex talk, sex stories, and so on.

Find something that interests you about women, and talk to them about it!

Put your focus upon it.

Focus yourself outward.

Then, not only will you have a much easier time getting past your own doubts and anxieties…

… but you will be significantly more charming and attractive to the women you meet as well!

Best,

Chase Amante
